summary.en: Murasaki Shikibu, a lady-in-waiting at the Heian court, wrote this long prose narrative of the life and loves of the "Shining Prince" Genji. It was circulating by 1008 and is often called the world's first novel.
summary.zh: 平安宫廷女官紫式部创作了这部描写“光源氏”一生与情爱的长篇物语。至1008年该书已在宫中流传，常被誉为世界上第一部长篇小说。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: The Tale of Genji
Murasaki Shikibu, Murasaki Shikibu nikki (Diary, c. 1010)
Richard Bowring, Murasaki Shikibu: The Tale of Genji (Cambridge University Press, 2nd ed. 2004)
Wikipedia: The Tale of Genji

events.note: Wikidata gives 1010 as inception; the earliest datable reference to the work, in Murasaki's diary, is from 1008. Composition dates are not known precisely.

name.zh: 布里哈迪希瓦拉神庙落成

summary.en: Rajaraja I dedicated this granite Shiva temple at Thanjavur, whose 66-metre vimana was among the tallest buildings of its age; its inscriptions record the Chola state’s revenues, staff and endowments.
summary.zh: 罗阇罗阇一世在坦贾武尔建成这座花岗岩湿婆神庙，其66米高的主塔在当时世界上数一数二；庙中铭文记录了朱罗王朝的税收、人员与捐赠。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage List: Great Living Chola Temples
K. A. Nilakanta Sastri, The Cōḻas, 2nd ed. (1955)
Wikidata Q916943

name.en: Lý Thái Tổ moves the capital to Thăng Long

summary.en: In his Edict on the Transfer of the Capital, Lý Thái Tổ moved the court from Hoa Lư to the site of the old Tang citadel of Đại La, renaming it Thăng Long ("Ascending Dragon"), the future Hanoi.
summary.zh: 李太祖颁布《迁都诏》，将朝廷从华闾迁至唐代大罗城旧址，并改名升龙（意为“腾飞之龙”），即后来的河内。

sources.title: Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư (Complete Annals of Đại Việt, 1479; 1697 ed.)
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Central Sector of the Imperial Citadel of Thang Long – Hanoi
Wikipedia: Edict on the Transfer of the Capital

wiki.en: Edict on the Transfer of the Capital

image.artist: Ly Thai To - the founder of Ly dynasty of Vietnam

summary.en: In Tus, Ferdowsi completed the Shahnameh ("Book of Kings"), an epic of some 50,000 couplets recounting Iran's myths and history down to the Arab conquest. Written in Persian with few Arabic loanwords, it became Iran's national epic.
summary.zh: 菲尔多西在图斯完成《列王纪》，以约五万联诗句讲述伊朗从神话时代到阿拉伯征服的历史。全诗以少用阿拉伯借词的波斯语写成，成为伊朗的民族史诗。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Shah-nameh
Encyclopaedia Iranica: Ferdowsi
Wikipedia: Shahnameh

events.note: Wikidata dates the work c. 1000; the final version is dated 1010 in the poem itself.

name.zh: 伊本·海什木著《光学之书》

summary.en: Working in Fatimid Cairo, Ibn al-Haytham wrote the Kitab al-Manazir, arguing that vision results from light entering the eye and testing his claims with controlled experiments. Translated into Latin around 1200, it shaped European optics from Roger Bacon to Kepler.
summary.zh: 伊本·海什木在法蒂玛王朝治下的开罗撰写《光学之书》，主张视觉源于光线进入眼睛，并以可控实验检验自己的论断。约1200年该书被译为拉丁文，影响了从罗吉尔·培根到开普勒的欧洲光学。

sources.title: Britannica: Kitab al-manazir
Britannica: Ibn al-Haytham
Wikipedia: Book of Optics
A. I. Sabra (trans.), The Optics of Ibn al-Haytham, Books I–III (1989)

events.note: Composed c. 1011–1021, mostly after the death of the caliph al-Hakim; exact dates are uncertain.

summary.en: The Song state took over the privately issued jiaozi notes of Sichuan merchants and set up an official Jiaozi bureau at Yizhou (Chengdu), creating the world's first government paper currency.
summary.zh: 北宋于益州（成都）设交子务，将四川商人私发的交子收归官办，成为世界上最早的官方纸币。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《宋史》卷181 食货志下三 会子
Britannica: Jiaozi / paper money in China

events.note: The bureau was decreed in 1023 and the first official notes issued in 1024.

name.zh: 朱罗王朝远征室利佛逝

summary.en: Rajendra Chola I’s fleet raided the Srivijaya maritime realm, sacking ports in Sumatra and the Malay Peninsula including Kadaram (Kedah) and capturing its king; the Tanjore inscription of 1030–31 lists the places taken.
summary.zh: 拉金德拉一世的舰队袭击海上强国室利佛逝，洗劫苏门答腊和马来半岛诸港，包括羯荼（吉打），并俘获其国王；1030—1031年的坦贾武尔铭文列出了所攻占之地。

label.zh: 马纳卡瓦拉姆（尼科巴群岛）

sources.title: K. A. Nilakanta Sastri, The Cōḻas, 2nd ed. (1955)
Hermann Kulke, K. Kesavapany & Vijay Sakhuja (eds.), Nagapattinam to Suvarnadwipa: Reflections on the Chola Naval Expeditions to Southeast Asia (2009)
Wikidata Q16957926

events.note: The inscription lists conquered places but not an itinerary; the route order is a reconstruction.

summary.en: Avicenna (Ibn Sina) completed al-Qanun fi al-Tibb, a five-book synthesis of Greek and Islamic medicine written in Hamadan and Isfahan. Translated into Latin in the 12th century, it remained a standard medical textbook in Europe and the Islamic world for centuries.
summary.zh: 伊本·西那在哈马丹和伊斯法罕写成五卷本《医典》，集希腊与伊斯兰医学之大成。12世纪译为拉丁文后，数百年间一直是欧洲和伊斯兰世界的标准医学教科书。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: The Canon of Medicine
Encyclopaedia Iranica: Avicenna
Wikipedia: The Canon of Medicine

events.note: Completion date c. 1025 is approximate.

image.file: Handwritten Arabic Manuscript of Canon Medicinae - BuAli Sina (Avicenna) Mausoleum - Hamadan - Western Iran (7423558016).jpg
image.artist: Adam Jones from Kelowna, BC, Canada

name.zh: 加兹尼的马哈茂德洗劫索姆纳特

summary.en: Climaxing some seventeen raids into India, Mahmud crossed the Thar desert, took the Somnath temple on the Gujarat coast and carried off its treasure; the episode became a contested symbol in later memory.
summary.zh: 马哈茂德前后约十七次入侵印度，此役穿越塔尔沙漠，攻陷古吉拉特海岸的索姆纳特神庙并掠走其财宝；此事在后世记忆中成为争议性的象征。

sources.title: Romila Thapar, Somanatha: The Many Voices of a History (2004)
C. E. Bosworth, The Ghaznavids (1963)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Mahmud of Ghazna
Wikidata Q123488342

events.note: Mahmud left Ghazni in late 1025; the temple fell in January 1026.

summary.en: Brought to Ghazni by Mahmud of Ghazni, al-Biruni learned Sanskrit and wrote a systematic study of Indian religion, philosophy, astronomy and customs, completed around 1030. Its comparative, source-based method has led many to call him a founder of Indology and anthropology.
summary.zh: 比鲁尼被伽色尼的马哈茂德带到伽色尼后学习梵文，撰写了一部系统研究印度宗教、哲学、天文和风俗的著作，约1030年完成。书中依据原典进行比较的方法，使许多人称他为印度学和人类学的奠基者。

sources.title: Britannica: al-Biruni
Encyclopaedia Iranica: BĪRŪNĪ, ABŪ RAYḤĀN
Wikipedia: India (Al-Biruni)

events.note: Wikidata gives 1017, the year al-Biruni reached Ghazni; the book was completed c. 1030, shortly after Mahmud's death.

summary.en: The Tangut leader Li Yuanhao declared himself emperor of Great Xia at Xingqing (Yinchuan), introduced a Tangut script, and fought Song to a standstill before the Qingli peace of 1044.
summary.zh: 党项首领李元昊于兴庆府称帝，国号大夏，创制西夏文；与宋连年交战，1044年订庆历和议。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《宋史》卷485 夏国传上

events.note: No Wikidata item exists for this event itself; Q7427 denotes the state and is linked from polity-western-xia, so no qid is set here.

summary.en: Seljuk Turkmen led by Tughril and Chaghri Beg routed the Ghaznavid sultan Mas‘ud I near Merv, winning Khurasan and launching the Seljuk empire that took Baghdad in 1055.
summary.zh: 图格里勒与查格里率领的塞尔柱突厥蛮人在梅尔夫附近击溃伽色尼苏丹马苏德一世，夺取呼罗珊，开启了1055年进入巴格达的塞尔柱帝国。

sources.title: C. E. Bosworth, The Ghaznavids: Their Empire in Afghanistan and Eastern Iran (1963)
Abu’l-Fazl Bayhaqi, Tarikh-i Bayhaqi
Wikidata Q26493

summary.en: Papal legates led by Cardinal Humbert laid a bull excommunicating Patriarch Michael Cerularius on the altar of Hagia Sophia, and the patriarch replied in kind. The mutual excommunications came to symbolise the lasting split between the Roman Catholic and Eastern Orthodox churches.
summary.zh: 以枢机主教洪贝尔为首的教宗使节将绝罚君士坦丁堡宗主教米海尔·色路拉里乌斯的诏书置于圣索菲亚大教堂祭坛上，宗主教随即予以反绝罚。这次相互绝罚成为罗马天主教与东正教长期分裂的象征。

sources.title: Britannica: Schism of 1054
Henry Chadwick, East and West: The Making of a Rift in the Church (2003)

events.note: The rupture was a long process; 1054 is its conventional symbolic date.

summary.en: Duke William of Normandy defeated and killed King Harold II near Hastings, opening the Norman conquest of England. William was crowned at Westminster on Christmas Day 1066, and a new French-speaking aristocracy transformed English government, language and architecture.
summary.zh: 诺曼底公爵威廉在黑斯廷斯附近击败并杀死英格兰国王哈罗德二世，开启诺曼征服。威廉于1066年圣诞节在威斯敏斯特加冕，说法语的新贵族阶层由此深刻改变了英格兰的政治、语言和建筑。

sources.title: Anglo-Saxon Chronicle (MSS D and E), entry for 1066
William of Poitiers, Gesta Guillelmi
Britannica: Battle of Hastings

name.zh: 巴格达尼扎米亚学院开办

summary.en: The Seljuk vizier Nizam al-Mulk founded a network of endowed colleges teaching Shafi'i law and Ash'ari theology. The Baghdad Nizamiyya, opened in 1067, became the most famous, with al-Ghazali among its teachers, and the endowed madrasa spread across the Islamic world.
summary.zh: 塞尔柱首相尼扎姆·穆尔克创办了一批由宗教基金资助、讲授沙斐仪派法学和艾什尔里派教义的学院。1067年开办的巴格达尼扎米亚学院最为著名，安萨里曾在此任教，这种由基金资助的经学院随后遍及伊斯兰世界。

sources.title: Britannica: Nizam al-Mulk
Wikipedia: Nizamiyya of Baghdad
Wikipedia: Nizamiyya
George Makdisi, The Rise of Colleges: Institutions of Learning in Islam and the West (1981)

events.note: Founded in 457 AH (1065) and inaugurated in Dhu al-Qa'da 459 AH (September 1067); the record marks the opening.

summary.en: Emperor Shenzong backed Wang Anshi's reforms – state loans to farmers, hired labour service, militia and trade measures – to enrich the state. Opponents led by Sima Guang reversed them in 1085–86, opening decades of factional strife.
summary.zh: 宋神宗任用王安石推行青苗、免役、保甲、市易等新法以富国强兵；1085年后司马光等尽废新法，新旧党争延续数十年。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《宋史》卷327 王安石传
Britannica: Wang Anshi

name.zh: 穆拉比特王朝建立马拉喀什

summary.en: The Saharan Almoravid movement established Marrakesh as a fortified camp below the High Atlas, and Yusuf ibn Tashfin made it the capital of an empire stretching from Senegal to al-Andalus. The city later served the Almohads and Saadians as capital.
summary.zh: 来自撒哈拉的穆拉比特运动在阿特拉斯山脚建起马拉喀什营地，优素福·伊本·塔什芬以之为帝国首都，疆域从塞内加尔延伸至安达卢斯。此后穆瓦希德王朝和萨阿德王朝也定都于此。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Marrakesh
Amira K. Bennison, The Almoravid and Almohad Empires (2016)
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Medina of Marrakesh

events.note: Disputed: Ibn Abi Zarʿ and Ibn Khaldun give 1062 (454 AH); Ibn ʿIdhari gives 1070, followed by Bennison and most recent scholarship. Britannica says only “mid-11th century”; Wikidata gives 1065. The founder may have been Abu Bakr ibn ʿUmar rather than Yusuf.

summary.en: The Seljuk sultan Alp Arslan routed the Byzantine army near Manzikert, north of Lake Van, and captured Emperor Romanos IV Diogenes. The Byzantine civil strife that followed let Turkish groups settle across Anatolia, beginning its gradual Turkification.
summary.zh: 塞尔柱苏丹阿尔普·阿尔斯兰在凡湖以北的曼齐刻尔特附近大败拜占庭军队，俘虏皇帝罗曼努斯四世。此后拜占庭陷入内乱，突厥部众得以遍布安纳托利亚，开启了该地区逐步突厥化的进程。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Battle of Manzikert
C. Hillenbrand, Turkish Myth and Muslim Symbol: The Battle of Manzikert (2007)
Wikipedia: Battle of Manzikert

summary.en: At the Shashe–Limpopo confluence, Mapungubwe became southern Africa’s first class-stratified state, trading gold and ivory to the Indian Ocean for glass beads. Its elite hilltop burials, including the famous gold rhinoceros, precede the rise of Great Zimbabwe.
summary.zh: 马蓬古布韦位于沙谢河与林波波河交汇处，是南部非洲首个阶层分化的国家，以黄金、象牙与印度洋贸易换取玻璃珠。其山顶精英墓葬（包括著名的金犀牛）早于大津巴布韦的兴起。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Kingdom of Mapungubwe
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Mapungubwe Cultural Landscape
Thomas N. Huffman, Mapungubwe: Ancient African Civilisation on the Limpopo (2005)

events.note: Dates are archaeological (radiocarbon) estimates.

summary.en: After nineteen years of work, Sima Guang presented the 294-chapter Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, a chronicle from 403 BCE to 959 CE, to Emperor Shenzong.
summary.zh: 司马光历时十九年编成294卷编年体通史《资治通鉴》，起战国三家分晋（前403）迄五代（959），进呈宋神宗。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
司马光《进资治通鉴表》
脱脱等《宋史》卷336 司马光传

summary.en: Written in retirement at his Mengxi garden in Runzhou (Zhenjiang), Shen Kuo's notebook records the magnetic needle compass and magnetic declination, Bi Sheng's movable clay type and ideas on land formation drawn from fossils. It is a key source for Song science and technology.
summary.zh: 沈括退居润州（今镇江）梦溪园时撰写的这部笔记，记载了磁针指南及磁偏角、毕昇的泥活字印刷术以及依据化石推断地貌变迁等内容，是研究宋代科学技术的重要史料。

sources.title: Britannica: Shen Kuo
沈括《梦溪笔谈》（维基文库）
Wikipedia: Dream Pool Essays

events.note: Written c. 1088 onward; Bi Sheng's movable type, which it describes, dates from the Qingli era (1041–1048).

name.en: Founding of the University of Bologna

summary.en: Bologna's law school, traditionally dated to 1088, grew from teachers of Roman law into a university organised by student associations. Often regarded as the oldest university in continuous operation, it became a model for others across Europe.
summary.zh: 博洛尼亚的法学院按传统说法创立于1088年，由讲授罗马法的教师群体发展为由学生团体组织的大学。它通常被视为持续办学至今最古老的大学，并成为欧洲各地大学的典范。

sources.title: University of Bologna: Our history
Hastings Rashdall, The Universities of Europe in the Middle Ages, vol. 1 (1895)
Britannica: University of Bologna

events.note: 1088 (Wikidata inception) is a traditional date fixed by a committee in the 1880s; teaching of law at Bologna is documented from the late 11th–12th century.

summary.en: Answering Pope Urban II's call at Clermont in 1095, armies of western knights marched through Constantinople and Anatolia, took Antioch in 1098 and captured Jerusalem in July 1099. The crusade founded Latin states in the Levant.
summary.zh: 响应教宗乌尔班二世1095年在克莱蒙发出的号召，西欧骑士大军经君士坦丁堡、穿越安纳托利亚，于1098年攻占安条克，1099年7月攻陷耶路撒冷，并在黎凡特建立了一系列拉丁国家。

label.zh: 十字军集结莱茵兰（科隆）
大军经君士坦丁堡渡海

sources.title: Gesta Francorum et aliorum Hierosolimitanorum
Anna Komnene, Alexiad, Books X–XI
Britannica: First Crusade

events.note: Wikidata's 'point in time' of 1090 appears erroneous; its start/end (1096–1099) are used. Event placed at Clermont, where the crusade was preached.

summary.en: Answering Pope Urban II's appeal, Western European armies marched through Anatolia and Syria, took Nicaea, Antioch and finally Jerusalem, and founded the crusader states of Edessa, Antioch, Jerusalem and later Tripoli.
summary.zh: 响应教皇乌尔班二世的号召，西欧军队穿越安纳托利亚和叙利亚，先后攻占尼西亚、安条克，最终夺取耶路撒冷，建立了埃德萨、安条克、耶路撒冷以及稍后的的黎波里等十字军国家。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: First Crusade
T. Asbridge, The First Crusade: A New History (2004)
Gesta Francorum et aliorum Hierosolimitanorum
Wikipedia: First Crusade

events.note: Event point placed at Antioch, the crusade's longest siege.

summary.en: Crusader forces stormed Jerusalem, then held by the Fatimids, on 15 July 1099 after a five-week siege. The capture was followed by a massacre of many Muslim and Jewish inhabitants, and Godfrey of Bouillon became the first ruler of the Kingdom of Jerusalem.
summary.zh: 经五周围攻，十字军于1099年7月15日攻破法蒂玛王朝控制下的耶路撒冷，随后屠杀了大批穆斯林和犹太居民。布永的戈弗雷成为耶路撒冷王国的首位统治者。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Crusades
Ibn al-Athir, al-Kamil fi al-Tarikh (trans. D. S. Richards)
Wikipedia: Siege of Jerusalem (1099)

summary.en: King Suryavarman II built Angkor Wat as a temple to Vishnu and probably his own funerary monument. Its five lotus towers, moat and kilometre-long bas-reliefs make it the largest religious monument in the world.
summary.zh: 苏利耶跋摩二世修建吴哥窟，供奉毗湿奴，很可能也是其陵庙。五座莲花状宝塔、护城河与绵延近一公里的浮雕回廊，使其成为世界上最大的宗教建筑。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Angkor Wat
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Angkor
George Cœdès, The Indianized States of Southeast Asia (University of Hawaii Press, 1968)
Wikipedia: Angkor Wat

events.note: Wikidata gives an inception of 1200; scholarly consensus places construction in the reign of Suryavarman II (1113–c. 1150).

image.artist: The original uploader was Fuzheado at English Wikipedia.

summary.en: King David IV "the Builder" of Georgia defeated a large Seljuk-led Muslim coalition at Didgori, west of Tbilisi. The victory allowed him to take Tbilisi in 1122 and opened Georgia's golden age.
summary.zh: 格鲁吉亚“建设者”大卫四世在第比利斯以西的迪德戈里击败塞尔柱人领导的穆斯林联军。此役使他于1122年收复第比利斯，开启了格鲁吉亚的黄金时代。

sources.title: Kartlis Tskhovreba (The Georgian Chronicles): Life of David, King of Kings
D. Rayfield, Edge of Empires: A History of Georgia (2012)
Wikipedia: Battle of Didgori

summary.en: Jin armies invaded Song in 1125, besieged Kaifeng twice and took it in early 1127, carrying off the emperors Huizong and Qinzong and thousands of courtiers. Prince Zhao Gou re-established the dynasty at Yingtian as the Southern Song.
summary.zh: 金军1125年分两路南下，两围东京，1127年初攻破开封，掳徽、钦二帝及宗室北去，北宋亡；康王赵构于应天府即位，建立南宋。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《宋史》卷23 钦宗本纪 靖康二年
徐梦莘《三朝北盟会编》

image.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Plastictv~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims).

summary.en: A series of strong earthquakes struck northern Syria in October 1138, wrecking the citadel of Aleppo and nearby fortresses such as Harim and Atharib, held by Muslim and Crusader garrisons alike. Chroniclers reported heavy losses; the often-quoted toll of 230,000 rests on a later conflation with other quakes.
summary.zh: 1138年10月，一系列强烈地震袭击叙利亚北部，阿勒颇城堡及哈里姆、阿塔里卜等分别由穆斯林和十字军驻守的要塞遭到严重破坏。编年史家记载伤亡惨重；常被引用的23万死亡人数源于后世与其他地震的混淆。

sources.title: Wikipedia: 1138 Aleppo earthquake
M. Sbeinati, R. Darawcheh & M. Mouty, "The historical earthquakes of Syria: an analysis of large and moderate earthquakes from 1365 B.C. to 1900 A.D.", Annals of Geophysics 48 (2005)
N. N. Ambraseys, Earthquakes in the Mediterranean and Middle East (2009)

events.note: The 230,000 figure comes from Ibn Taghribirdi (15th c.) and probably merges this event with the 1137 Jazira and 1139 Ganja earthquakes.

summary.en: The Qara Khitai under Yelü Dashi crushed the Seljuk sultan Sanjar and his Karakhanid vassals near Samarkand, becoming overlords of Transoxiana; garbled reports of the battle fed the European legend of Prester John.
summary.zh: 耶律大石率领的西辽军队在撒马尔罕附近大败塞尔柱苏丹桑贾尔及其喀喇汗附庸，成为河中地区的宗主；关于此役的讹传助长了欧洲“约翰长老”的传说。

summary.zh: 金海陵王完颜亮南侵欲渡长江，文臣虞允文于采石收拾散兵，以车船与霹雳炮击败金军渡江；不久海陵王为部下所杀。

summary.zh: 平氏与源氏两大武士集团之间的内战。1185年平氏水军在坛之浦覆灭，源赖朝由此成为日本最有权势的人物。

summary.zh: 普里特维拉杰·乔汉率领的拉其普特联军在哈里亚纳的塔拉奥里附近击败古尔王朝的穆罕默德，使其负伤，暂时阻止了他向恒河平原的推进。

summary.zh: 已在镰仓统领武士阶层的源赖朝于1192年被任命为征夷大将军。幕府掌握军事与地方治安，与京都朝廷并存，形成公武二元体制。

summary.en: Eleven monolithic churches were carved down into volcanic rock at Roha, the Zagwe capital, traditionally under King Gebre Mesqel Lalibela as a “New Jerusalem”. They remain an active Ethiopian Orthodox pilgrimage centre.
summary.zh: 扎格维王朝都城罗哈的十一座独石教堂由火山岩向下凿成，传统上认为是国王盖布雷·梅斯克尔·拉利贝拉为建造“新耶路撒冷”而修。至今仍是埃塞俄比亚正教的朝圣中心。

summary.zh: 斡难河源头召开的大忽里勒台推举铁木真为成吉思汗，将草原上的蒙古及突厥诸部统一为“也客·蒙古·兀鲁思”，即大蒙古国。

summary.en: Facing baronial rebellion, King John of England agreed at Runnymede to a charter limiting royal power and guaranteeing certain legal rights. Though annulled within months, its reissued versions became a foundation of English law and a symbol of constitutional government.
summary.zh: 面对贵族叛乱，英格兰国王约翰在兰尼米德同意颁布一份限制王权、保障若干法律权利的特许状。该文件数月后即被废止，但其后的重订版本成为英格兰法律的基石和宪政的象征。

summary.en: After Otrar’s governor Inalchuq massacred a Mongol trade caravan in 1218 and the shah executed Genghis Khan’s envoy, the khan’s sons besieged the city for months; its fall opened the Mongol conquest of Khwarazm.
summary.zh: 1218年讹答剌守将亦纳勒术屠杀蒙古商队，花剌子模沙又处死成吉思汗的使者；成吉思汗诸子随后围城数月，此城陷落揭开了蒙古征服花剌子模的序幕。

summary.zh: 成吉思汗大军摧毁花剌子模帝国，相继攻破布哈拉、撒马尔罕、玉龙杰赤、梅尔夫和内沙布尔，并追击札兰丁至印度河；此役杀戮极重，河中与呼罗珊从此归于蒙古统治。

summary.en: The Shona-speaking capital of the Kingdom of Zimbabwe built the largest dry-stone structures in sub-Saharan Africa, including the Great Enclosure. Wealth from cattle and gold exported via Sofala and Kilwa sustained perhaps 10,000–18,000 people before the site declined in the 15th century.

summary.en: Under Hulagu's patronage, Nasir al-Din al-Tusi founded an observatory and library at Maragheh. Its astronomers compiled the Zij-i Ilkhani tables and developed planetary models closely resembling those later used by Copernicus.
summary.zh: 在旭烈兀资助下，纳西尔丁·图西在马拉盖建立天文台和图书馆。那里的天文学家编成《伊利汗天文表》，并提出与后来哥白尼所用模型极为相似的行星模型。

summary.en: After Möngke’s death his brothers Kublai and Ariq Böke were each elected Great Khan; Kublai won by cutting Karakorum’s grain supply from China, but the empire’s unity was lost and it split into four khanates.
summary.zh: 蒙哥死后，其弟忽必烈与阿里不哥分别被推举为大汗；忽必烈切断汉地对哈拉和林的粮食供应而获胜，但帝国统一从此瓦解，分裂为四大汗国。

summary.en: In the Jezreel Valley in Palestine, the Mamluks of Egypt under Qutuz and Baybars defeated a Mongol army left in Syria by Hulagu. It was the first major check to Mongol expansion in the west and secured Mamluk rule over Syria.
summary.zh: 在巴勒斯坦的耶斯列谷，忽都思和拜巴尔斯率领的埃及马穆鲁克军击败了旭烈兀留在叙利亚的蒙古军。这是蒙古西进遭遇的第一次重大挫败，确立了马穆鲁克王朝对叙利亚的统治。

summary.en: For six years Mongol-Yuan forces blockaded the twin Han River fortresses of Xiangyang and Fancheng; counterweight trebuchets built by Muslim engineers finally forced Lü Wenhuan to surrender in 1273, opening the Yangtze to the Yuan.
summary.zh: 元军围困汉水两岸的襄阳、樊城六年，借回回炮破樊城，1273年吕文焕以襄阳降，长江门户洞开。

summary.en: Having won the succession war against his brother Ariq Böke, Kublai Khan adopted the Chinese dynastic name Da Yuan, taken from the Book of Changes, and made Dadu (Beijing) his capital.
summary.zh: 忽必烈战胜阿里不哥后，取《易经》“大哉乾元”之义建国号大元，定都大都。

summary.en: Kublai Khan's Yuan dynasty, with Goryeo ships and troops, twice invaded northern Kyushu. Both attacks at Hakata Bay were contained by samurai defenders (in 1281 also by the new coastal wall), and storms—later called kamikaze—wrecked much of the 1281 fleet.
summary.zh: 忽必烈的元朝联合高丽船只与兵力两次进攻九州北部。两次在博多湾的登陆都被武士阻挡（1281年另有新筑的石垒），1281年的庞大舰队更多被台风（后称“神风”）摧毁。

summary.en: Repeating Ngô Quyền's tactic, Trần Hưng Đạo staked the Bạch Đằng River and trapped the withdrawing Yuan fleet under Omar at low tide, destroying it and ending the third Mongol invasion.
summary.zh: 陈兴道效仿吴权的战法，在白藤江中埋设木桩，趁退潮困住撤退中的元朝乌马儿舰队并将其歼灭，结束了元朝第三次入侵。

summary.en: Kublai Khan sent a fleet to punish King Kertanegara of Singhasari for mutilating his envoy. Raden Wijaya allied with the Yuan to defeat the usurper Jayakatwang, then turned on and expelled them, founding Majapahit.
summary.zh: 忽必烈派遣舰队惩罚曾黥面元使的新柯沙里国王格尔达纳卡拉。罗登·威查耶先与元军联手击败篡位者查耶卡旺，随后反戈驱逐元军，建立了满者伯夷。

summary.en: The gravestone of Malik al-Salih, first Muslim ruler of Samudera Pasai in northern Sumatra, is dated 696 AH (1297). Marco Polo, passing in 1292, found nearby Perlak already Muslim; Pasai became the first major Islamic sultanate of Southeast Asia, visited by Ibn Battuta in 1345.
summary.zh: 苏门答腊北部须文答剌-巴赛首位穆斯林统治者马利克·萨利赫的墓碑纪年为伊斯兰历696年（1297年）。1292年途经此地的马可·波罗记载附近的八儿剌（佩尔拉克）已信奉伊斯兰教；巴赛成为东南亚第一个重要的伊斯兰苏丹国，1345年伊本·白图泰曾到访。

summary.en: Alauddin Khalji’s army met a large Chagatai Mongol force under Qutlugh Khwaja at Kili near Delhi; the Mongols withdrew after heavy fighting, one of several invasions the sultanate repelled around 1300.
summary.zh: 阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉的军队在德里附近的基利迎战忽都鲁·火者率领的察合台蒙古大军，激战后蒙古人撤退；这是约1300年前后德里苏丹国击退的多次蒙古入侵之一。

summary.en: The Geʿez “Glory of the Kings”, compiled under the early Solomonic dynasty, tells how Menelik I, son of Solomon and the Queen of Sheba, brought the Ark of the Covenant to Aksum. It became Ethiopia’s national epic and the ideological charter of Solomonic kingship.
summary.zh: 吉兹语《列王的荣耀》编成于所罗门王朝初期，讲述所罗门与示巴女王之子孟尼利克一世将约柜带到阿克苏姆的故事。它成为埃塞俄比亚的民族史诗和所罗门王朝君权的意识形态依据。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Kebra Nagast

summary.en: Dante Alighieri completed the Commedia, an allegorical poem in three parts—Inferno, Purgatorio and Paradiso—written in the Tuscan vernacular during his exile. It became a founding work of Italian literature and of the literary Italian language.
summary.zh: 但丁在流亡期间完成了以托斯卡纳方言写成的寓言长诗《神曲》，分为《地狱篇》《炼狱篇》《天堂篇》三部。该作品成为意大利文学和意大利文学语言的奠基之作。

sources.title: Giovanni Boccaccio, Trattatello in laude di Dante
Britannica: The Divine Comedy

events.note: Composed c. 1308–1321; Wikidata gives c. 1320. Paradiso was finished at Ravenna shortly before Dante's death in September 1321.

summary.en: Mansa Musa of Mali crossed the Sahara with a vast retinue and so much gold that, al-ʿUmari reports, its value fell in Cairo for years. The hajj put Mali on Mediterranean maps such as the 1375 Catalan Atlas and brought scholars and architects back to the Sahel.
summary.zh: 马里的曼萨·穆萨率庞大随从穿越撒哈拉，携带黄金之多，据乌马里记载使开罗金价多年低落。这次朝觐使马里出现在1375年《加泰罗尼亚地图集》等地中海地图上，并带回学者与建筑师。

summary.en: On his return from Mecca, Mansa Musa commissioned the Andalusi poet Abu Ishaq al-Sahili to build a great mosque of earth and timber in Timbuktu. Rebuilt many times, it anchored the city’s growth as a centre of Islamic scholarship.
summary.zh: 曼萨·穆萨朝觐归来后，委托安达卢斯诗人阿布·伊斯哈格·萨赫利在廷巴克图用泥土和木材建造大清真寺。该寺历经多次重建，成为廷巴克图发展为伊斯兰学术中心的支柱。

summary.en: A series of wars between the Plantagenet kings of England and the Valois kings of France over the French crown and English lands in France. English victories such as Crécy and Agincourt were reversed after Joan of Arc helped relieve Orléans in 1429; by 1453 England held only Calais.
summary.zh: 英格兰金雀花王朝与法兰西瓦卢瓦王朝围绕法国王位及英格兰在法领地展开的一系列战争。英军虽有克雷西、阿金库尔等大捷，但1429年贞德助解奥尔良之围后局势逆转；至1453年英格兰仅保有加来。

sources.title: Jean Froissart, Chronicles
Jonathan Sumption, The Hundred Years War (5 vols., 1990–2023)
Britannica: Hundred Years' War

events.note: Placed at Orléans, the war's turning point (1429).

summary.en: Syriac gravestones of a Church of the East community near Lake Issyk-Kul record a spike in deaths in 1338–39, some from 'pestilence'. In 2022 ancient DNA from these burials identified Yersinia pestis ancestral to the Black Death strains, pointing to this region as a source shortly before the plague reached Europe.
summary.zh: 伊塞克湖附近景教社群的叙利亚文墓碑记录了1338至1339年死亡人数的激增，部分碑文称死于“瘟疫”。2022年对这些墓葬的古DNA研究鉴定出鼠疫耶尔森菌，属于黑死病菌株的直系祖先，表明此地是黑死病传入欧洲前不久的源头之一。

sources.title: M. A. Spyrou et al., "The source of the Black Death in fourteenth-century central Eurasia", Nature 606 (2022)
Wikipedia: Black Death

events.note: Marker at Burana, one of the two cemeteries (with Kara-Djigach near Bishkek) sampled in the 2022 study. Whether the outbreak spread widely from here is debated. No Wikidata item exists for the event.

summary.en: Plague carried on Genoese ships from the Black Sea reached Sicily in October 1347 and swept across Europe within four years, killing perhaps a third to a half of the population. The catastrophe reshaped labour, religion and society across the continent.
summary.zh: 随热那亚船只从黑海传来的鼠疫于1347年10月抵达西西里，四年内席卷欧洲，可能造成三分之一至一半人口死亡。这场浩劫深刻改变了整个欧洲的劳动力、宗教与社会。

summary.en: Conscripted labourers repairing the Yellow River rose under the White Lotus leaders Han Shantong and Liu Futong at Yingzhou. The red-turbaned armies spread across the Yuan realm; one of their commanders, Zhu Yuanzhang, founded the Ming.
summary.zh: 元末征发民夫治黄河，韩山童、刘福通以白莲教在颍州起事，红巾军遍及各地，其部将朱元璋终建明朝。

summary.en: In retreat at Qalʿat Ibn Salama in present-day Algeria, Ibn Khaldun drafted the introduction to his universal history. Its theory of ʿasabiyya (group solidarity) and the rise and fall of dynasties is regarded as a founding work of historiography and sociology.

summary.en: The fugitive Palembang prince Parameswara settled at Malacca around 1400. With Ming recognition and its command of the strait, the port grew into the greatest entrepôt of Southeast Asia and a centre for the spread of Islam.
summary.zh: 流亡的巨港王子拜里米苏拉约在1400年定居马六甲。凭借明朝的册封和对海峡的控制，这座港口发展为东南亚最大的转口贸易中心，也是伊斯兰教传播的中心。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Sultanate of Malacca
Sejarah Melayu (Malay Annals), trans. C. C. Brown (1952)
Tomé Pires, Suma Oriental (1512–1515), trans. Armando Cortesão (Hakluyt Society, 1944)
Barbara Watson Andaya & Leonard Y. Andaya, A History of Malaysia (Palgrave, 3rd ed. 2017)
Wikipedia: Malacca Sultanate

events.note: Founding dates between c. 1396 and 1402 are proposed.

summary.en: Timur defeated and captured the Ottoman sultan Bayezid I near Ankara. The Ottoman state nearly disintegrated in the civil war that followed (1402–1413), delaying its expansion and the fall of Constantinople by half a century.
summary.zh: 帖木儿在安卡拉附近击败并俘虏奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德一世。奥斯曼国家在随后的内战（1402—1413年）中几近瓦解，扩张和攻取君士坦丁堡因此推迟了半个世纪。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Battle of Ankara
C. Finkel, Osman's Dream: The History of the Ottoman Empire (2005)
Wikipedia: Battle of Ankara

image.file: Timur Review His Troops Before the Battle of Ankara, Zafarnama 1436.jpg

name.zh: 古尔-艾米尔陵（帖木儿陵）

summary.en: Built for Timur’s grandson Muhammad Sultan, who died in 1403, the ribbed turquoise-domed mausoleum became the dynastic tomb of Timur, Shah Rukh and Ulugh Beg and a model for Mughal tombs.
summary.zh: 此陵原为1403年去世的帖木儿之孙穆罕默德·苏丹而建，其带棱纹的青绿色穹顶陵墓后成为帖木儿、沙哈鲁和兀鲁伯的王朝墓地，并成为莫卧儿陵墓的范本。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage List: Samarkand – Crossroad of Cultures
Lisa Golombek & Donald Wilber, The Timurid Architecture of Iran and Turan (1988)
Wikidata Q1256223

summary.en: Between 1405 and 1433 the eunuch admiral Zheng He led seven fleets of large treasure ships from Liujiagang through Southeast Asia and the Indian Ocean to Hormuz, Arabia and the East African coast, enrolling dozens of states in the Ming tribute order.
summary.zh: 1405至1433年，郑和七次率宝船队自刘家港出发，经东南亚、印度洋远达忽鲁谟斯、阿拉伯与东非，招徕数十国朝贡。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷304 宦官传一 郑和
马欢《瀛涯胜览》
《天妃灵应之记》碑（长乐，1431）

summary.en: More than two thousand scholars under Xie Jin and Yao Guangxiao compiled the Yongle Encyclopedia in Nanjing: 22,877 chapters copying some seven to eight thousand earlier works. Only about four percent survives.
summary.zh: 解缙、姚广孝主持两千余人在南京编成《永乐大典》二万二千八百余卷，辑录古籍七八千种，今仅存约百分之四。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷147 解缙传

summary.en: The allied armies of the Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania under Władysław II Jagiełło and Vytautas crushed the Teutonic Knights; Grand Master Ulrich von Jungingen was killed. The defeat began the long decline of the Teutonic Order's state in Prussia.
summary.zh: 波兰王国与立陶宛大公国联军在瓦迪斯瓦夫二世·雅盖沃和维陶塔斯指挥下大败条顿骑士团，大团长乌尔里希·冯·容金根阵亡。此役开启了条顿骑士团国家在普鲁士的长期衰落。

sources.title: Jan Długosz, Annales seu cronicae incliti Regni Poloniae, Book XI
Britannica: Battle of Tannenberg (1410)

name.en: Ulugh Beg Madrasa on the Registan
name.zh: 雷吉斯坦广场兀鲁伯经学院

summary.en: Ulugh Beg founded this madrasa on Samarkand’s Registan, where astronomy and mathematics were taught alongside religious sciences; it is the oldest of the three madrasas framing the square.
summary.zh: 兀鲁伯在撒马尔罕雷吉斯坦广场创建这所经学院，除宗教学科外还讲授天文与数学；它是环绕广场的三座经学院中最古老的一座。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage List: Samarkand – Crossroad of Cultures
Lisa Golombek & Donald Wilber, The Timurid Architecture of Iran and Turan (1988)
Wikidata Q492144

summary.en: Lê Lợi raised a rebellion against Ming occupation at Lam Sơn in Thanh Hóa. After a decade of guerrilla war and the destruction of a Ming relief army at Chi Lăng in 1427, the Ming withdrew and Lê Lợi founded the Later Lê dynasty.
summary.zh: 黎利在清化蓝山起兵反抗明朝统治。经过十年游击战，并于1427年在支棱歼灭明朝援军后，明军撤离，黎利建立后黎朝。

sources.title: Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư (Complete Annals of Đại Việt, 1479; 1697 ed.)
Keith W. Taylor, A History of the Vietnamese (Cambridge University Press, 2013)
Wikipedia: Lam Sơn uprising

summary.en: With the Forbidden City completed in 1420, the Yongle Emperor formally made Beijing the principal capital from New Year 1421, leaving Nanjing as the auxiliary capital; Beijing remained the capital until 1928.
summary.zh: 紫禁城于1420年建成，永乐十九年正月明成祖正式迁都北京，以南京为留都；北京此后为都城至1928年。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷7 成祖本纪三 永乐十八年、十九年

events.note: Q11087884 (zhwiki 永乐迁都) is the relocation itself; the image shows the Forbidden City, completed in 1420.

summary.en: Ulugh Beg’s three-storey observatory housed a huge meridian arc of about 40 m radius; his team, including al-Kashi and Qadi-zada al-Rumi, compiled the Zij-i Sultani star catalogue, the most precise since Ptolemy.
summary.zh: 兀鲁伯的三层天文台内建有半径约40米的巨型子午仪；他与卡西、卡迪扎德·鲁米等学者编成《苏丹历数书》星表，是托勒密以来最精确的星表。

sources.title: Aydın Sayılı, The Observatory in Islam (1960)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Ulugh Beg
Wikidata Q608580

events.note: Construction is usually dated 1424–1429 (Wikidata: 1420s); the Zij-i Sultani was completed c. 1437 and revised to 1449, when the observatory was abandoned.

image.file: Обсерватория Улугбека, Самарканд (Ulugh Beg Observatory, Samarkand).jpg

summary.en: An Ayutthayan army besieged and took the Khmer capital. The Khmer court soon moved south toward the Phnom Penh area, closing the Angkorian era.
summary.zh: 阿瑜陀耶军队围攻并攻陷高棉都城。高棉王廷随后南迁至金边一带，吴哥时代就此结束。

sources.title: David Chandler, A History of Cambodia (Westview, 4th ed. 2008)
Royal Chronicles of Ayutthaya, trans. Richard D. Cushman (Siam Society, 2000)
Wikipedia: Fall of Angkor

events.note: The 1431 date comes from later chronicles; historians see Angkor's decline as gradual and the date as conventional.

summary.en: King Sejong completed a new phonetic alphabet in 1443 and promulgated it in 1446 in the document Hunminjeongeum, "the correct sounds for instructing the people", so that commoners could read and write Korean.
summary.zh: 世宗大王于1443年创制了一套新的表音文字，并于1446年以《训民正音》（意为“教百姓以正确的字音”）颁布，使平民也能读写朝鲜语。

sources.title: Annals of the Joseon Dynasty (Joseon wangjo sillok), National Institute of Korean History
UNESCO Memory of the World Register: Hunmin Chongum Manuscript
Ki-baik Lee, A New History of Korea (Harvard University Press, 1984)
Wikipedia: Hunminjeongeum

summary.en: Persuaded by the eunuch Wang Zhen to campaign in person, the Zhengtong Emperor was routed by the Oirat leader Esen at Tumu fortress and taken prisoner. Minister Yu Qian enthroned his brother and defended Beijing.
summary.zh: 明英宗听信宦官王振亲征瓦剌，于土木堡被也先击溃俘虏；兵部尚书于谦拥立景泰帝，固守北京。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷10 英宗前纪 正统十四年
张廷玉等《明史》卷170 于谦传

summary.en: Under Mali and Songhai rule, scholars of the Sankore, Djinguereber and Sidi Yahya mosques built family libraries of Arabic and Ajami manuscripts on law, theology, astronomy, medicine and history. Hundreds of thousands survive; many were smuggled to Bamako during the 2012 occupation.
summary.zh: 在马里和桑海统治下，桑科雷、津加里贝尔和西迪·叶海亚清真寺的学者建立家族图书馆，收藏以阿拉伯文和阿贾米文书写的法学、神学、天文、医学和历史手稿。存世手稿数以十万计，2012年城市被占领期间许多被秘密转移到巴马科。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Timbuktu
Britannica: Timbuktu
Wikipedia: Timbuktu Manuscripts

events.note: Span is conventional: the scholarly peak from the mid-15th century to the Moroccan conquest of 1591. Most surviving manuscripts were copied later, in the 16th–19th centuries.

summary.en: After a siege of about seven weeks, the Ottoman army of Sultan Mehmed II stormed Constantinople; the last emperor, Constantine XI Palaiologos, died in the fighting. The conquest ended the Byzantine Empire and made the city the Ottoman capital.
summary.zh: 经过约七周的围攻，苏丹穆罕默德二世的奥斯曼军队攻破君士坦丁堡，末代皇帝君士坦丁十一世·巴列奥略战死。此役终结了拜占庭帝国，该城随后成为奥斯曼帝国的首都。

sources.title: Kritoboulos of Imbros, History of Mehmed the Conqueror
Steven Runciman, The Fall of Constantinople 1453 (1965)
Britannica: Siege of Constantinople

image.file: Le siège de Constantinople (1453) by Jean Le Tavernier after 1455.jpg

name.zh: 谷登堡《圣经》与活字印刷

summary.en: In Mainz, Johannes Gutenberg's workshop completed the 42-line Latin Bible, the first major book printed in Europe with movable metal type. Printing spread to more than 200 European towns by 1500, transforming the circulation of knowledge.
summary.zh: 约翰内斯·谷登堡在美因茨的作坊完成了四十二行拉丁文《圣经》，这是欧洲首部以金属活字印刷的重要书籍。到1500年，印刷术已传播至欧洲两百多个城镇，彻底改变了知识的传播方式。

sources.title: Albert Kapr, Johann Gutenberg: The Man and His Invention (1996)
Britannica: Gutenberg Bible

events.note: The Bible has no colophon; it is dated c. 1454–55 from a letter of Enea Silvio Piccolomini (March 1455) and a rubricator's note of 1456. Wikidata has no date.

image.file: Gutenberg Bible, Lenox Copy, New York Public Library, 2009. Pic 01.jpg

summary.en: Mehmed II besieged Trebizond, capital of the last Byzantine successor state, and Emperor David Komnenos surrendered in August 1461. Its fall ended the Empire of Trebizond, founded in 1204, and the last Byzantine rule in Anatolia.
summary.zh: 穆罕默德二世围攻最后一个拜占庭继承国的首都特拉布宗，皇帝大卫·科穆宁于1461年8月投降。特拉比松帝国（建于1204年）随之灭亡，拜占庭在安纳托利亚的统治宣告终结。

sources.title: Kritovoulos, History of Mehmed the Conqueror (trans. C. T. Riggs, 1954)
F. Babinger, Mehmed the Conqueror and His Time (1978)
Wikipedia: Siege of Trebizond (1461)

events.note: Wikidata starts the siege in September 1460; the 1461 campaign and surrender (15 August 1461) are used for the year.

name.en: Kerei and Janibek found the Kazakh Khanate
name.zh: 克烈与贾尼别克建立哈萨克汗国

summary.en: The Jochid sultans Kerei and Janibek broke with Abu’l-Khayr’s Uzbek ulus and led their followers to the Chu and Talas valleys under Moghulistan’s protection; their khanate is regarded as the origin of Kazakh statehood.
summary.zh: 术赤后裔克烈与贾尼别克两位苏丹脱离阿布海尔的乌兹别克兀鲁思，率部众迁至楚河与塔拉斯河流域，受东察合台汗国庇护；他们建立的汗国被视为哈萨克国家的开端。

sources.title: Mirza Muhammad Haidar Dughlat, Tarikh-i Rashidi (tr. N. Elias & E. Denison Ross, 1895)
Martha Brill Olcott, The Kazakhs, 2nd ed. (1995)

events.note: No separate Wikidata item exists for the event, so no QID is given (Q1433867 is the khanate, inception 1465). Mirza Haidar gives AH 870 (1465–66); other dates (1456, 1459) are proposed. Coordinates approximate the Chu valley.

summary.en: A succession dispute in the Ashikaga shogunate drew the Hosokawa and Yamana coalitions into a decade of fighting that burned much of Kyoto. The shogunate never recovered its authority, opening the Sengoku (Warring States) era.
summary.zh: 足利将军家的继嗣纷争使细川与山名两大阵营在京都激战十年，城市大半焚毁。幕府权威一蹶不振，日本由此进入战国时代。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Ōnin War
The Cambridge History of Japan, Vol. 3: Medieval Japan (1990)
Conrad Totman, A History of Japan (Blackwell, 2nd ed. 2005)
Wikipedia: Ōnin War

events.note: Coordinates set on Kyoto, where the fighting took place; the Wikidata point lies about 17 km to the south.

summary.en: Blown south past the continent’s tip, Bartolomeu Dias’s Portuguese ships landed at Mossel Bay, where Khoikhoi herders resisted them, and sailed on to the Bushmans River before turning back, sighting the Cape of Good Hope on the return. The voyage proved a sea route to the Indian Ocean.
summary.zh: 迪亚士的葡萄牙船队被风吹过大陆南端，在莫塞尔湾登陆并遭科伊科伊牧民抵抗，继续航行至布须曼河后折返，归途中望见好望角。此行证明了通往印度洋的海路。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Bartolomeu Dias
João de Barros, Décadas da Ásia, I (1552)
Britannica: Bartolomeu Dias

summary.en: After a ten-year war (1482–1492), Emir Muhammad XII surrendered Granada, the last Muslim state in Iberia, to Ferdinand II of Aragon and Isabella I of Castile. The surrender completed the Christian Reconquista.
summary.zh: 经过十年战争（1482—1492年），埃米尔穆罕默德十二世将伊比利亚最后的穆斯林政权格拉纳达交给阿拉贡的斐迪南二世与卡斯蒂利亚的伊莎贝拉一世，基督教的“收复失地运动”至此完成。

sources.title: L. P. Harvey, Islamic Spain, 1250 to 1500 (1990)
Britannica: Granada

events.note: QID is the Granada War; Wikidata's start date for it (1492) conflicts with the standard 1482 start, so only the surrender date is used here.

summary.en: Sailing for the Crown of Castile, Christopher Columbus left Palos with three ships, crossed the Atlantic via the Canary Islands and reached the Bahamas on 12 October 1492. His return in 1493 launched sustained European contact with, and colonisation of, the Americas.
summary.zh: 哥伦布受卡斯蒂利亚王室资助，率三艘船从帕洛斯出发，经加那利群岛横渡大西洋，于1492年10月12日抵达巴哈马。1493年他返航后，欧洲开始与美洲持续接触并殖民美洲。

label.zh: 离开加那利群岛戈梅拉岛
登陆瓜纳哈尼（圣萨尔瓦多岛）

label.en: Santa María wrecked; La Navidad founded
label.zh: 圣玛丽亚号触礁，建立纳维达德

sources.title: Christopher Columbus, Diario of the First Voyage (abstract by Bartolomé de las Casas)
Samuel Eliot Morison, Admiral of the Ocean Sea (1942)
Britannica: Christopher Columbus

events.note: The Wikidata item covers all four voyages (1492–1504); this record is the first.

summary.en: From Columbus's second voyage of 1493, ships between Spain and the Americas carried horses, cattle, wheat and sugar cane west, and maize, potatoes, tomatoes, cacao and tobacco east, along with devastating Old World diseases. American crops spread across Europe, Africa and Asia, feeding population growth from Ireland to China.
summary.zh: 自1493年哥伦布第二次航行起，往来于西班牙与美洲之间的船只把马、牛、小麦和甘蔗运往美洲，把玉米、马铃薯、番茄、可可和烟草带回欧洲，同时也带去了毁灭性的旧大陆疾病。美洲作物传遍欧洲、非洲和亚洲，推动了从爱尔兰到中国的人口增长。

sources.title: Britannica: Columbian exchange
N. Nunn & N. Qian, "The Columbian Exchange: A History of Disease, Food, and Ideas", Journal of Economic Perspectives 24 (2010)
Alfred W. Crosby, The Columbian Exchange: Biological and Cultural Consequences of 1492 (1972)
Wikipedia: Columbian exchange

events.note: Marker at Seville, whose Casa de Contratación (1503) controlled the Indies trade; the end year is conventional, as the exchange continued.

image.artist: Tabac_rustique.jpg: Atilin Cacao-pod-k4636-14.jpg: The original uploader was Kbh3rd at English Wikipedia. VegCorn.jpg: ?

summary.en: Guided across the Arabian Sea from Malindi, the Portuguese fleet anchored near Calicut, the Zamorin’s spice port, completing the first sea voyage from Europe to India and opening the era of European sea power in the Indian Ocean.
summary.zh: 葡萄牙船队在马林迪领航员引导下横渡阿拉伯海，停泊于扎莫林的香料港卡利卡特附近，完成了从欧洲到印度的首次航行，开启了欧洲海上势力进入印度洋的时代。

sources.title: Álvaro Velho (attrib.), Roteiro da primeira viagem de Vasco da Gama (journal of the first voyage)
Sanjay Subrahmanyam, The Career and Legend of Vasco da Gama (1997)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Vasco da Gama
Wikidata Q30717033

events.note: QID is the 1st Portuguese India Armada (1497–1499); coordinates are Kappad beach, the traditional landing place near Calicut (Kozhikode).

summary.en: Over three and a half centuries about 12.5 million Africans were forced aboard ships for the Americas, of whom some 10.7 million survived the Middle Passage. Ports such as Ouidah, Luanda and Bonny were central; the trade reshaped African states and demography until its suppression in the 19th century.
summary.zh: 三个半世纪间，约1250万非洲人被强行押上驶往美洲的船只，约1070万人在“中间航程”中幸存。维达、罗安达、邦尼等港口为其中心；这一贸易深刻改变了非洲的国家与人口，直至19世纪被禁绝。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Atlantic slave trade
SlaveVoyages: Trans-Atlantic Slave Trade Database
Herbert S. Klein, The Atlantic Slave Trade (2nd ed., 2010)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. V: Africa from the Sixteenth to the Eighteenth Century (ed. B. A. Ogot, 1992)

events.note: Start and end years are conventions (first direct Africa–Americas voyages c. 1501–1525; last documented voyages 1866–67). Marker placed at Ouidah, a leading embarkation port. Estimates from SlaveVoyages.

image.artist: Plymouth Chapter of the Society for Effecting the Abolition of the Slave Trade

name.en: Battle of Sharur and the rise of the Safavids
name.zh: 沙鲁尔之战与萨法维王朝兴起

summary.en: Leading Qizilbash Turkmen followers, the teenage Ismail defeated the Aq Qoyunlu at Sharur, entered Tabriz and was proclaimed shah. He made Twelver Shi'ism the state religion, founding the Safavid dynasty that shaped modern Iran.
summary.zh: 少年伊斯玛仪率领红头军土库曼部众在沙鲁尔击败白羊王朝，进入大不里士称沙阿。他定十二伊玛目什叶派为国教，建立了塑造近代伊朗的萨法维王朝。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Ismail I
Encyclopaedia Iranica: Safavids
Wikipedia: Battle of Sharur

events.note: Wikidata dates the battle 17 July 1501; other sources place it a few weeks earlier. Coronation at Tabriz followed in 1501.

image.file: Negotiations between Alwand and Ismail, followed by the battle of Sharur (1501). Habib al-siyar, end of 16th century. National Palace Museum (cropped).jpg

summary.en: Afonso de Albuquerque stormed Goa from the Bijapur Sultanate at the second attempt; it became the capital of Portuguese India and stayed Portuguese until 1961.
summary.zh: 阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克第二次进攻时从比贾布尔苏丹国手中夺取果阿；此地成为葡属印度首府，直至1961年仍归葡萄牙所有。

sources.title: Sanjay Subrahmanyam, The Portuguese Empire in Asia, 1500–1700 (1993)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Afonso de Albuquerque
Wikidata Q2357384

image.file: "Plan de Goa", in Histoire générale des voyages,1750.jpg

summary.en: Afonso de Albuquerque's fleet stormed Malacca after weeks of fighting, driving out Sultan Mahmud Shah. Portugal gained a key base on the spice route, while Muslim traders dispersed to rival ports such as Aceh, Johor and Banten.
summary.zh: 阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克的舰队经数周激战攻占马六甲，苏丹马哈茂德沙出逃。葡萄牙由此获得香料航线上的关键据点，穆斯林商人则分散到亚齐、柔佛、万丹等竞争港口。

sources.title: Brás de Albuquerque, Commentaries of the Great Afonso Dalboquerque (1557; Hakluyt Society trans. 1875–84)
Tomé Pires, Suma Oriental (1512–1515), trans. Armando Cortesão (Hakluyt Society, 1944)
Barbara Watson Andaya & Leonard Y. Andaya, A History of Malaysia (Palgrave, 3rd ed. 2017)
Wikipedia: Capture of Malacca (1511)

image.file: Conquista de Malaca, estudo - Ernesto Condeixa (cropped).png

summary.en: Shaybanid Uzbek forces under Ubaydullah annihilated a Safavid army under Najm-e Sani that was backing Babur’s bid to retake Samarkand, fixing the Uzbek–Persian frontier and ending Babur’s Central Asian ambitions.
summary.zh: 乌拜杜拉率领的昔班尼乌兹别克军队全歼了纳吉姆·萨尼统率、支持巴布尔夺回撒马尔罕的萨法维军队，由此确定乌兹别克与波斯的边界，巴布尔在中亚的雄心也就此破灭。

sources.title: Babur, Baburnama (tr. Wheeler M. Thackston, 1996)
R. D. McChesney, “Central Asia vi. In the 16th–18th centuries”, Encyclopaedia Iranica
Wikidata Q4138186

summary.en: The Ottoman sultan Selim I, with artillery and Janissary firearms, defeated Shah Ismail's Qizilbash cavalry at Chaldiran and briefly occupied Tabriz. The battle set a long-lasting Ottoman–Safavid frontier across eastern Anatolia and Mesopotamia.
summary.zh: 奥斯曼苏丹塞利姆一世凭借火炮和近卫军火器，在查尔迪兰击败伊斯玛仪沙阿的红头军骑兵，并一度占领大不里士。此役确立了横贯安纳托利亚东部和美索不达米亚的奥斯曼—萨法维长期边界。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Battle of Chaldiran
C. Finkel, Osman's Dream (2005)
Wikipedia: Battle of Chaldiran

name.en: Ottoman–Mamluk War (Ottoman conquest of Syria and Egypt)
name.zh: 奥斯曼-马穆鲁克战争（奥斯曼征服叙利亚与埃及）

summary.en: Selim I turned south after Chaldiran, killing the Mamluk sultan Qansuh al-Ghawri at Marj Dabiq and taking Aleppo, Damascus and Jerusalem, then Cairo in January 1517. The Ottomans gained Syria, Egypt and guardianship of Mecca and Medina.
summary.zh: 查尔迪兰之战后，塞利姆一世挥师南下，在达比格草原击毙马穆鲁克苏丹甘苏赫·古里，夺取阿勒颇、大马士革和耶路撒冷，并于1517年1月攻入开罗。奥斯曼由此获得叙利亚、埃及及麦加和麦地那的守护权。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Ottoman Empire
Ibn Iyas, Bada'i al-Zuhur fi Waqa'i al-Duhur
Wikipedia: Ottoman–Mamluk War (1516–1517)

events.note: Event point at Marj Dabiq (24 August 1516).

wiki.zh: 奧斯曼—馬穆魯克戰爭 (1516年—1517年)

name.en: Battle of Ridaniya: Ottomans take Egypt
name.zh: 里达尼亚战役：奥斯曼征服埃及

summary.en: Selim I’s Ottoman army, using field artillery and muskets, defeated the Mamluk sultan Tuman bay II outside Cairo. Tuman bay was hanged at the Zuwayla gate, ending the Mamluk Sultanate; Egypt became an Ottoman province for three centuries.
summary.zh: 塞利姆一世的奥斯曼军队凭借野战火炮与火枪在开罗城外击败马穆鲁克苏丹图曼贝伊二世。图曼贝伊被吊死于祖韦拉门，马穆鲁克王朝灭亡，埃及此后三个世纪为奥斯曼行省。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Battle of Ridaniya
Ibn Iyas, Badaʾiʿ al-Zuhur (early 16th century)
Britannica: Mamluk

name.zh: 路德发表《九十五条论纲》

summary.en: Martin Luther, a theology professor at Wittenberg, circulated 95 theses disputing the sale of indulgences and sent them to Archbishop Albert of Mainz. Rapidly printed and spread, they sparked the Protestant Reformation that divided Western Christianity.
summary.zh: 维滕贝格大学神学教授马丁·路德提出《九十五条论纲》，抨击出售赎罪券，并寄呈美因茨大主教阿尔布雷希特。论纲经印刷迅速传播，引发了导致西方基督教分裂的宗教改革。

sources.title: Martin Luther, Disputatio pro declaratione virtutis indulgentiarum (1517)
Britannica: Ninety-five Theses
Britannica: Reformation

events.note: Luther's covering letter to Archbishop Albert is dated 31 October 1517; whether he also nailed the theses to the Castle Church door is debated.

name.zh: 麦哲伦—埃尔卡诺环球航行

summary.en: Five ships under Ferdinand Magellan left Sanlúcar de Barrameda to reach the Spice Islands by sailing west. Magellan was killed at Mactan in 1521; Juan Sebastián Elcano brought the Victoria home with 18 men in September 1522, completing the first circumnavigation of the Earth.
summary.zh: 麦哲伦率五艘船从桑卢卡尔-德巴拉梅达出发，向西航行寻找香料群岛。麦哲伦于1521年在麦克坦岛被杀；1522年9月，埃尔卡诺率“维多利亚”号及18名船员返航，完成人类首次环球航行。

sources.title: Britannica: Ferdinand Magellan
Antonio Pigafetta, Relazione del primo viaggio intorno al mondo (c. 1524)
Wikipedia: Magellan expedition

events.note: Julian dates: the fleet left Seville on 10 August and Sanlúcar on 20 September 1519; Victoria reached Sanlúcar on 6 September 1522 and Seville on 8 September (Wikidata's dates).

image.file: Detail from a map of Ortelius - Magellan's ship Victoria.png

summary.en: Ferdinand Magellan, seeking to force the chief Lapulapu to submit to his Christian ally Rajah Humabon of Cebu, landed on Mactan with about 50 men and was killed. The expedition sailed on and completed the first circumnavigation in 1522.
summary.zh: 麦哲伦为迫使酋长拉普拉普臣服于已受洗的宿务王胡马邦，率约五十人登陆麦克坦岛，结果战死。船队继续航行，并于1522年完成首次环球航行。

label.en: Exits the Strait of Magellan into the Pacific (Nov 1520)
label.zh: 驶出麦哲伦海峡进入太平洋（1520年11月）
利马萨瓦岛：首次弥撒（3月31日）

Encyclopaedia Britannica: Ferdinand Magellan

summary.en: Babur’s smaller army, using field guns behind a wagon barricade and flanking cavalry, defeated Sultan Ibrahim Lodi, who died on the field; the victory ended the Delhi Sultanate and founded the Mughal Empire.
summary.zh: 巴布尔兵力较少，以车阵掩护火炮并辅以侧翼骑兵，击败苏丹易卜拉欣·洛迪，后者阵亡；此战终结了德里苏丹国，开创莫卧儿帝国。

sources.title: Babur, Baburnama (tr. Wheeler M. Thackston, 1996)
John F. Richards, The Mughal Empire (New Cambridge History of India I.5, 1993)
Wikidata Q605321

summary.en: Babur defeated the Rajput confederacy of Rana Sanga of Mewar near Fatehpur Sikri, securing Mughal control of the upper Ganges plain against its strongest rival.
summary.zh: 巴布尔在法塔赫布尔西格里附近击败梅瓦尔的拉纳·桑加所领导的拉其普特联盟，确保了莫卧儿王朝对恒河上游平原的控制。

sources.title: Babur, Baburnama (tr. Wheeler M. Thackston, 1996)
John F. Richards, The Mughal Empire (New Cambridge History of India I.5, 1993)

name.zh: 埃塞俄比亚—阿达尔战争

summary.en: Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi (“Gran”) of Adal routed Emperor Lebna Dengel at Shimbra Kure in 1529 and overran most of the Christian highlands. Aided by a Portuguese expedition of 400 musketeers that landed in 1541, Emperor Gelawdewos killed the imam at Wayna Daga in 1543.
summary.zh: 阿达尔苏丹国的伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐（“格兰”）于1529年在申布拉库雷大败皇帝莱布纳·丹格尔，占领基督教高原大部。1541年四百名葡萄牙火枪手登陆驰援，1543年格拉德沃斯皇帝在其协助下于韦纳达加击毙伊玛目。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Ethiopian–Adal War
Shihab al-Din ʿArab Faqih, Futuh al-Habasha (c. 1559)
Miguel de Castanhoso, account of the Portuguese expedition to Abyssinia (1564)
Richard Pankhurst, The Ethiopians: A History (1998)

events.note: Marker placed near Wayna Daga (east of Lake Tana); the war ranged across the whole highlands.

name.zh: 哥白尼出版《天体运行论》

summary.en: Nicolaus Copernicus's De revolutionibus orbium coelestium was printed in Nuremberg shortly before his death. Placing the Sun near the centre of the universe with Earth orbiting it, the book laid the groundwork for the Scientific Revolution.
summary.zh: 哥白尼的《天体运行论》在纽伦堡付印，出版于他去世前不久。该书提出太阳位于宇宙中心附近、地球绕其运行，为科学革命奠定了基础。

sources.title: Owen Gingerich, The Book Nobody Read (2004)
Britannica: Nicolaus Copernicus

summary.en: Suleiman I and Shah Tahmasp I ended four decades of war with the first formal Ottoman–Safavid peace. The Ottomans kept Baghdad, most of Iraq and eastern Anatolia; Iran kept Azerbaijan, and the South Caucasus was divided.
summary.zh: 苏莱曼一世与塔赫玛斯普一世签订首个正式的奥斯曼—萨法维和约，结束了四十年战争。奥斯曼保有巴格达、伊拉克大部和安纳托利亚东部，伊朗保有阿塞拜疆，南高加索被瓜分。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Peace of Amasya
Encyclopaedia Iranica: Amasya, Peace of
Wikipedia: Peace of Amasya

summary.en: On the night of 23 January 1556 an earthquake centred near Huazhou in the Wei River valley devastated Shaanxi, Shanxi and Henan. Ming records put the dead at more than 830,000, many in collapsed loess cave dwellings, making it the deadliest earthquake on record.
summary.zh: 1556年1月23日夜，以渭河谷地华州附近为震中的大地震重创陕西、山西和河南。明代史料载死者逾83万，许多人死于黄土窑洞坍塌，这是有记载以来死亡人数最多的地震。

sources.title: Britannica: Shaanxi province earthquake of 1556
《明史》卷30 五行志三
Wikipedia: 1556 Shaanxi earthquake

events.note: Julian date; the Chinese date is the 12th day of the 12th month of Jiajing 34 (嘉靖三十四年十二月十二日).

summary.en: Akbar’s regent Bairam Khan defeated Hemu, the Sur dynasty general who had just seized Delhi; Hemu was struck by an arrow and captured, restoring Mughal rule under the 14-year-old Akbar.
summary.zh: 阿克巴的摄政拜拉姆汗击败刚刚夺取德里的苏尔王朝将领希穆；希穆中箭被俘，莫卧儿王朝在14岁的阿克巴治下得以复兴。

sources.title: Abu'l-Fazl, Akbarnama (tr. H. Beveridge)
John F. Richards, The Mughal Empire (New Cambridge History of India I.5, 1993)
Wikidata Q233414

summary.en: Oda Nobunaga, with a small force, surprised and killed the daimyō Imagawa Yoshimoto, whose much larger army was marching through Owari. The victory launched Nobunaga's rise as a unifier of Japan.
summary.zh: 织田信长以少量兵力奇袭行军经过尾张的今川义元大军，并斩杀义元。此役使信长崛起，开始统一日本的进程。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Battle of Okehazama
Jeroen P. Lamers, Japonius Tyrannus: The Japanese Warlord Oda Nobunaga Reconsidered (Hotei, 2000)
The Cambridge History of Japan, Vol. 4: Early Modern Japan (1991)
Wikipedia: Battle of Okehazama

summary.en: An alliance of the Deccan sultanates defeated Vijayanagara’s regent Rama Raya, who was beheaded; the capital at Hampi was then sacked and the empire never regained its power.
summary.zh: 德干诸苏丹国联军击败毗奢耶那伽罗的摄政罗摩·罗阇，并将其斩首；都城亨比随后遭洗劫，帝国从此一蹶不振。

sources.title: Burton Stein, Vijayanagara (New Cambridge History of India I.2, 1989)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Battle of Talikota
Wikidata Q1362188

events.note: Some sources give 23 January 1565.

summary.en: After Andrés de Urdaneta found the eastward return route across the Pacific in 1565, Spanish galleons sailed between Manila and Acapulco for 250 years, exchanging Chinese silk and porcelain for Mexican and Peruvian silver. The trade tied Asia to the Americas and made silver a global currency.
summary.zh: 1565年乌尔达内塔找到横渡太平洋东返的航线后，西班牙大帆船250年间往返于马尼拉和阿卡普尔科之间，以中国丝绸和瓷器换取墨西哥和秘鲁的白银。这一贸易把亚洲与美洲连接起来，使白银成为全球通货。

sources.title: Britannica: Manila galleon
Wikipedia: Manila galleon
Dennis O. Flynn & Arturo Giráldez, "Born with a Silver Spoon: The Origin of World Trade in 1571", Journal of World History 6 (1995)

events.note: The first return voyage left Cebu in 1565; Manila became the Asian terminus after its founding in 1571, and the last galleon sailed in 1815.

summary.en: The parliament meeting at Lublin turned the personal union of the Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania into a single Commonwealth with a jointly elected monarch and common Sejm. The new state was one of Europe's largest until its partitions in the late 18th century.
summary.zh: 在卢布林召开的议会将波兰王国与立陶宛大公国的君合国转变为统一的联邦，两国共同选举君主、设立共同议会。这一新国家在18世纪末被瓜分之前，一直是欧洲面积最大的国家之一。

sources.title: Norman Davies, God's Playground: A History of Poland, vol. 1 (1981)
Britannica: Union of Lublin

name.zh: 阿克巴营建法塔赫布尔西格里

summary.en: Akbar raised a red-sandstone capital at Sikri to honour the Sufi Shaikh Salim Chishti, who had foretold the birth of his heir; it hosted his religious debates in the Ibadat Khana before the court left around 1585.
summary.zh: 阿克巴在西格里兴建红砂岩新都，以纪念曾预言其继承人诞生的苏菲长老萨利姆·契斯提；宫廷约1585年迁离之前，阿克巴在此的“礼拜堂”主持宗教辩论。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage List: Fatehpur Sikri
Abu'l-Fazl, Akbarnama (tr. H. Beveridge)
Wikidata Q179046

events.note: Work began in 1569 (Wikidata); the city was proclaimed capital in 1571.

summary.en: After defeating Rajah Sulayman's Maynila, Miguel López de Legazpi proclaimed the Spanish city of Manila, later walled as Intramuros. It became the capital of the Spanish Philippines and the Asian terminus of the Manila galleons to Acapulco.
summary.zh: 米格尔·洛佩斯·德·黎牙实比击败苏莱曼王统治的马尼拉后，宣布建立西班牙马尼拉城，后筑城墙成为王城区（Intramuros）。这里成为西属菲律宾首府和通往阿卡普尔科的马尼拉大帆船贸易的亚洲终点。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Intramuros

Nicholas Tarling (ed.), The Cambridge History of Southeast Asia, Vol. 1: From Early Times to c. 1800 (1992)
Wikipedia: Intramuros

summary.en: Mughal forces under Man Singh fought Maharana Pratap of Mewar in a narrow Aravalli pass; Pratap withdrew but kept up resistance and became a lasting emblem of Rajput defiance.
summary.zh: 曼·辛格率领的莫卧儿军队在阿拉瓦利山的狭窄山口与梅瓦尔的普拉塔普王交战；普拉塔普虽撤退但坚持抵抗，成为拉其普特人不屈的长久象征。

sources.title: Abu'l-Fazl, Akbarnama (tr. H. Beveridge)

name.en: Battle of Alcácer Quibir (Battle of the Three Kings)
name.zh: 阿尔卡塞尔基比尔战役（三王之战）

summary.en: The Saadian sultan ʿAbd al-Malik crushed the invading army of King Sebastian of Portugal and his ally al-Mutawakkil. All three kings died; Ahmad al-Mansur took the Moroccan throne enriched by ransoms, while Portugal’s succession crisis led to union with Spain in 1580.
summary.zh: 萨阿德王朝苏丹阿卜杜勒·马利克大败入侵的葡萄牙国王塞巴斯蒂昂及其盟友穆塔瓦基勒。三位君主皆死于此役；艾哈迈德·曼苏尔凭赎金之利继承摩洛哥王位，而葡萄牙的继承危机导致其1580年与西班牙合并。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Battle of Alcácer Quibir
E. W. Bovill, The Battle of Alcazar (1952)
Britannica: Battle of Alcácer Quibir

summary.en: Philip II of Spain sent a fleet of about 130 ships to escort an invasion army from Flanders to England. Harried in the Channel, scattered by fireships off Calais and beaten at Gravelines, the Armada fled round Scotland and Ireland, losing many ships to storms.
summary.zh: 西班牙国王腓力二世派出约130艘战舰，意图护送驻佛兰德的军队入侵英格兰。无敌舰队在英吉利海峡遭英舰袭扰，在加来外海被火船冲散，又在格拉沃利讷战败，被迫绕道苏格兰和爱尔兰返航，途中因风暴损失惨重。

sources.title: Garrett Mattingly, The Defeat of the Spanish Armada (1959)
Colin Martin and Geoffrey Parker, The Spanish Armada (1988)

summary.en: Guru Arjan built the Harmandir Sahib in the sacred pool of Amritsar and installed the newly compiled Adi Granth there in 1604; rebuilt and gilded under Ranjit Singh, the Golden Temple is Sikhism’s holiest shrine.
summary.zh: 古鲁阿尔琼在阿姆利则圣池中建造哈曼迪尔寺，并于1604年将新编成的《阿迪·格兰特》供奉于此；该寺在兰吉特·辛格时期重建并贴金，即锡克教最神圣的金庙。

summary.en: After a gruelling Saharan crossing, a Moroccan army of musketeers under Judar Pasha, sent by Ahmad al-Mansur, routed the much larger Songhai host of Askia Ishaq II near Gao. The Songhai Empire collapsed and Timbuktu came under Moroccan pashas.
summary.zh: 艾哈迈德·曼苏尔派遣朱达尔帕夏率火枪部队艰苦穿越撒哈拉，在加奥附近击溃阿斯基亚·伊斯哈格二世人数远多于己的桑海大军。桑海帝国随之崩溃，廷巴克图落入摩洛哥帕夏统治之下。

name.zh: 壬辰倭乱（万历朝鲜战争）

summary.en: Toyotomi Hideyoshi sent some 150,000 troops into Joseon in 1592, aiming ultimately at Ming China. After rapid Japanese advances, Ming intervention, guerrilla resistance and Yi Sun-sin's navy stalled the campaign; a second invasion in 1597 ended with Hideyoshi's death and withdrawal in 1598.
summary.zh: 1592年丰臣秀吉派遣约十五万大军入侵朝鲜，最终目标是明朝。日军初期推进迅速，但明军援朝、义兵抗击与李舜臣水军使战事陷入僵局；1597年再度入侵，1598年秀吉死后日军撤退。

label.zh: 肥前名护屋城：出兵基地

label.en: Yi Sun-sin wins at Hansan Island
