summary.en: Admiral Yi Sun-sin lured a Japanese fleet into open water near Hansan Island and enveloped it in a "crane-wing" formation, sinking or capturing most of the ships. The victory cut Japanese sea supply along Korea's southern coast.
summary.zh: 李舜臣将日本舰队诱至闲山岛附近的开阔海域，以“鹤翼阵”合围，击沉或俘获大部分敌船。此役切断了日军沿朝鲜南海岸的海上补给线。

sources.title: Yi Sun-sin, Nanjung ilgi (War Diary, 1592–1598)
Stephen Turnbull, Samurai Invasion: Japan's Korean War 1592–98 (Cassell, 2002)
Wikipedia: Battle of Hansan Island

summary.en: With only 13 warships left after the Joseon navy's disaster at Chilcheollyang, Yi Sun-sin used the fierce tidal currents of the Myeongnyang Strait to repel a Japanese fleet many times larger, halting the Japanese advance by sea.
summary.zh: 朝鲜水军在漆川梁惨败后，李舜臣仅余十三艘战船，他利用鸣梁海峡湍急的潮流，击退数倍于己的日本舰队，阻止了日军的海上推进。

sources.title: Yi Sun-sin, Nanjung ilgi (War Diary, 1592–1598)
Kenneth M. Swope, A Dragon's Head and a Serpent's Tail: Ming China and the First Great East Asian War, 1592–1598 (University of Oklahoma Press, 2009)
Wikipedia: Battle of Myeongnyang

name.zh: 伊斯法罕成为萨法维首都

summary.en: Shah Abbas I moved his capital from Qazvin to Isfahan and rebuilt the city around the vast Naqsh-e Jahan Square with its royal mosque, palace and bazaar. "Isfahan is half the world" became a proverb for its splendour.
summary.zh: 阿拔斯一世将首都从加兹温迁至伊斯法罕，并围绕宏大的伊玛目广场（世界图景广场）兴建王家清真寺、宫殿和巴扎。“伊斯法罕半天下”成为赞美其繁华的谚语。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica: Abbas I
S. Babaie, Isfahan and Its Palaces (2008)
Wikipedia: Naqsh-e Jahan Square

events.note: Uses the Naqsh-e Jahan Square item; Wikidata dates the square from 1591, while the move of the capital is usually dated 1598.

summary.en: Tokugawa Ieyasu's Eastern Army defeated the Western Army led by Ishida Mitsunari, helped by defections during the battle. The victory made Ieyasu master of Japan; he became shogun in 1603.
summary.zh: 德川家康率领的东军在战场倒戈的帮助下击败石田三成为首的西军。此役使家康成为日本实际的统治者，并于1603年就任征夷大将军。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Battle of Sekigahara
The Cambridge History of Japan, Vol. 4: Early Modern Japan (1991)
Conrad Totman, A History of Japan (Blackwell, 2nd ed. 2005)
Wikipedia: Battle of Sekigahara

image.artist: User LordAmeth on en.wikipediaCollection of The Town of Sekigahara Archive of History and Cultural Anthropology

summary.en: Commissioned by King Seonjo in 1596 and completed by the royal physician Heo Jun in 1610, this 25-volume compendium organised East Asian medicine for Korean use and was printed in 1613. It was reprinted in China and Japan and is on the UNESCO Memory of the World Register.
summary.zh: 《东医宝鉴》由宣祖于1596年下令编纂，御医许浚于1610年完成，1613年刊行。这部25卷的医学全书将东亚医学系统整理以适合朝鲜之用，曾在中国和日本翻刻，已列入联合国教科文组织《世界记忆名录》。

sources.title: UNESCO Memory of the World: Donguibogam: Principles and Practice of Eastern Medicine
Wikipedia: Donguibogam

summary.en: In two winter and summer campaigns the Tokugawa besieged Osaka Castle, the last stronghold of Toyotomi Hideyori. Its fall in 1615 destroyed the Toyotomi line and secured Tokugawa rule for two and a half centuries.
summary.zh: 德川方分冬、夏两阵围攻丰臣秀赖的最后据点大坂城。1615年城陷，丰臣氏灭亡，德川统治由此稳固了两个半世纪。

sources.title: The Cambridge History of Japan, Vol. 4: Early Modern Japan (1991)
Conrad Totman, A History of Japan (Blackwell, 2nd ed. 2005)
Wikipedia: Siege of Osaka

summary.en: Beginning with the Defenestration of Prague, a revolt of Bohemian Protestants against Habsburg rule grew into a European war involving the Holy Roman Empire, Sweden, Denmark, France and Spain. The fighting devastated Germany, where perhaps a fifth or more of the population died.
summary.zh: 以布拉格掷出窗外事件为开端，波希米亚新教徒反抗哈布斯堡统治的起义演变为一场席卷欧洲的大战，神圣罗马帝国、瑞典、丹麦、法国和西班牙相继卷入。战火重创德意志地区，可能有五分之一以上的人口丧生。

sources.title: Peter H. Wilson, Europe's Tragedy: A History of the Thirty Years War (2009)
Britannica: Thirty Years' War

events.note: Placed at Prague Castle, site of the Defenestration of 23 May 1618.

summary.en: Nurhaci's Later Jin destroyed three of four converging Ming columns one after another in five days near Sarhu, shifting the balance of power in Liaodong to the Manchus.
summary.zh: 努尔哈赤“凭尔几路来，我只一路去”，五日内于萨尔浒等地各个击破明军四路中的三路，辽东攻守之势自此逆转。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷259 杨镐传
《满洲实录》卷5

summary.en: Jan Pieterszoon Coen of the Dutch East India Company (VOC) destroyed the town of Jayakarta and built Batavia on its ruins. It became the VOC's Asian headquarters and later the capital of the Dutch East Indies.
summary.zh: 荷兰东印度公司的扬·彼得松·库恩摧毁查雅加达城，并在废墟上兴建巴达维亚。这里成为荷兰东印度公司的亚洲总部，后来成为荷属东印度首府。

sources.title: M. C. Ricklefs, A History of Modern Indonesia since c. 1200 (Palgrave, 4th ed. 2008)
Nicholas Tarling (ed.), The Cambridge History of Southeast Asia, Vol. 1: From Early Times to c. 1800 (1992)
Wikipedia: Batavia, Dutch East Indies

summary.en: Ming commander Yuan Chonghuan, using Portuguese-style cannon on the walls of Ningyuan (Xingcheng), repulsed Nurhaci's assault – his first major defeat; Nurhaci died later that year.
summary.zh: 袁崇焕凭宁远孤城与红夷大炮击退努尔哈赤，后金首遭大败，努尔哈赤同年病逝。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
张廷玉等《明史》卷259 袁崇焕传

summary.en: Shah Jahan commissioned this white-marble mausoleum at Agra for his wife Mumtaz Mahal, who died in 1631; built by thousands of artisans over two decades, it is the masterpiece of Mughal architecture.
summary.zh: 沙贾汗为1631年去世的皇后慕塔芝·玛哈在阿格拉修建这座白色大理石陵墓；数千名工匠历时二十余年建成，是莫卧儿建筑的巅峰之作。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage List: Taj Mahal
Ebba Koch, The Complete Taj Mahal (2006)
Wikidata Q9141

image.artist: Taj_Mahal,_Agra,_India_edit2.jpg: Yann; edited by King of Hearts derivative work: Jbarta (talk)

summary.en: The Roman Inquisition found Galileo Galilei 'vehemently suspect of heresy' for defending Copernican heliocentrism in his Dialogue Concerning the Two Chief World Systems. He was forced to recant and spent his remaining years under house arrest near Florence.
summary.zh: 罗马宗教裁判所认定伽利略因在《关于两大世界体系的对话》中为哥白尼日心说辩护而“有强烈异端嫌疑”。他被迫公开放弃其观点，余生在佛罗伦萨附近遭软禁。

sources.title: Maurice A. Finocchiaro (ed.), The Galileo Affair: A Documentary History (1989)
Britannica: Galileo

events.note: The Wikidata item covers the whole Galileo affair (1610–1633); this record marks the sentence and abjuration at Santa Maria sopra Minerva on 22 June 1633.

name.en: Fasilides makes Gondar the imperial capital
name.zh: 法西利达斯定都贡德尔

summary.en: Emperor Fasilides ended the roving royal camps of the Ethiopian monarchy by founding a permanent capital at Gondar, north of Lake Tana. His castle began the Fasil Ghebbi compound, whose palaces blend Aksumite, Indian and Portuguese-influenced styles.
summary.zh: 皇帝法西利达斯结束了埃塞俄比亚君主四处移驻的营帐制度，在塔纳湖以北的贡德尔建立永久都城。其城堡开启了法西尔盖比王宫建筑群，融合了阿克苏姆、印度与葡萄牙影响的风格。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Fasil Ghebbi
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Fasil Ghebbi, Gondar Region
Richard Pankhurst, The Ethiopians: A History (1998)

events.note: Foundation dated 1635 (Wikidata, for the city) or 1636.

image.file: ET Gondar asv2018-02 img02 Fasil Ghebbi.jpg

summary.en: Written while Song Yingxing was a county instructor at Fenyi in Jiangxi and printed in 1637, this illustrated encyclopedia describes farming, textiles, salt, ceramics, metallurgy, weapons and papermaking. Little circulated in Qing China, it was later valued in Japan and Europe as a record of Ming technology.
summary.zh: 宋应星任江西分宜县教谕期间撰成此书，1637年刊行。这部附有插图的百科全书记述了农业、纺织、制盐、陶瓷、冶金、兵器和造纸等工艺。该书在清代流传不广，后来在日本和欧洲作为明代技术的记录而受到重视。

sources.title: Britannica: Tiangong kaiwu
宋应星《天工开物》（维基文库）
Wikipedia: Tiangong Kaiwu

image.file: Casting a Tripod, Bell, and Statue.jpg

summary.en: Overtaxed peasants and masterless samurai of Shimabara and Amakusa, many of them Christian, rose and held Hara Castle until it fell to a shogunal army in 1638. The revolt hardened the ban on Christianity and the exclusion of the Portuguese.
summary.zh: 岛原与天草地区不堪重税的农民和浪人（多为天主教徒）起事，据守原城，1638年被幕府大军攻陷。此后幕府更加严厉地禁教，并驱逐葡萄牙人。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Shimabara Rebellion
The Cambridge History of Japan, Vol. 4: Early Modern Japan (1991)
Ronald P. Toby, State and Diplomacy in Early Modern Japan (Princeton University Press, 1984)
Wikipedia: Shimabara Rebellion

summary.en: A series of Tokugawa edicts in the 1630s banned Japanese from travelling abroad, expelled the Portuguese and confined Dutch trade to Dejima in Nagasaki. Controlled contacts continued with China, Korea, the Ryukyus and the Ainu until the 1850s.
summary.zh: 17世纪30年代德川幕府颁布一系列法令，禁止日本人出海、驱逐葡萄牙人，并将荷兰贸易限制在长崎出岛。与中国、朝鲜、琉球及阿伊努的有限往来则一直持续到19世纪50年代。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: sakoku
Ronald P. Toby, State and Diplomacy in Early Modern Japan (Princeton University Press, 1984)
The Cambridge History of Japan, Vol. 4: Early Modern Japan (1991)
Wikipedia: Sakoku

events.note: The term sakoku was coined only in 1801; historians debate how closed Japan really was.

summary.en: Signed near Qasr-e Shirin, the treaty ended the Ottoman–Safavid war of 1623–1639. Baghdad and Mesopotamia stayed Ottoman, and the Zagros frontier it set roughly anticipates today's Iran–Iraq and Iran–Turkey borders.
summary.zh: 条约在席林堡附近签订，结束了1623—1639年的奥斯曼—萨法维战争。巴格达和美索不达米亚归奥斯曼所有，所定的扎格罗斯边界大致与今日伊朗—伊拉克、伊朗—土耳其边界相当。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Treaty of Qasr-e Shirin
C. Finkel, Osman's Dream (2005)
Wikipedia: Treaty of Zuhab

name.en: Battle of Shanhai Pass and fall of the Ming

summary.en: Weeks after Li Zicheng took Beijing and the Chongzhen Emperor hanged himself, the Ming general Wu Sangui opened Shanhai Pass to the Qing regent Dorgon; their combined forces routed Li, and the Qing moved its capital to Beijing.
summary.zh: 李自成攻破北京、崇祯帝自缢后，吴三桂开山海关降清，与多尔衮合击大顺军，清军入关，定都北京。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
赵尔巽等《清史稿》卷4 世祖本纪一 顺治元年
张廷玉等《明史》卷24 庄烈帝纪二

summary.en: Treaties signed at Osnabrück and Münster ended the Thirty Years' War in the Holy Roman Empire and the Eighty Years' War between Spain and the Dutch Republic. They recognised Dutch and Swiss independence, extended toleration to Calvinists and strengthened the sovereignty of the German princes.
summary.zh: 在奥斯纳布吕克与明斯特签订的一系列条约，结束了神圣罗马帝国境内的三十年战争以及西班牙与荷兰共和国之间的八十年战争。和约承认荷兰与瑞士独立，将宗教宽容扩展至加尔文派，并增强了德意志诸侯的主权。

sources.title: Instrumentum Pacis Osnabrugense and Monasteriense (1648)
Britannica: Peace of Westphalia

events.note: The Spanish–Dutch Peace of Münster was signed on 30 January 1648; the imperial treaties on 24 October 1648 (Wikidata date).

name.en: Dutch East India Company settles at the Cape
name.zh: 荷兰东印度公司在开普建立据点

summary.en: Jan van Riebeeck landed at Table Bay to found a provisioning station for VOC ships. Expansion of free burgher farms dispossessed Khoikhoi herders, and enslaved people from Asia and Africa formed much of the labour force, laying foundations of later South African society.
summary.zh: 扬·范里贝克在桌湾登陆，为东印度公司船只建立补给站。自由市民农场的扩张夺走了科伊科伊牧民的土地，来自亚洲和非洲的奴隶构成主要劳动力，奠定了后来南非社会的基础。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Dutch Cape Colony
Hermann Giliomee, The Afrikaners: Biography of a People (2003)
Richard Elphick, Khoikhoi and the Founding of White South Africa (1985)
Journal of Jan van Riebeeck, 1651–1662 (Van Riebeeck Society ed., 1952–58)

summary.en: Over three days a fire driven by strong winds burned most of Edo, including the main keep of Edo Castle, and killed perhaps 100,000 people. The shogunate rebuilt the city with firebreaks, wider streets and relocated temples and daimyo mansions; the keep was never rebuilt.
summary.zh: 强风助长下的大火连烧三日，焚毁江户大半城区，包括江户城天守阁，死者或达10万人。幕府重建时设置防火带、拓宽街道，并迁移寺院和大名宅邸；天守阁此后再未重建。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Great Fire of Meireki
Wikipedia (ja): 明暦の大火
Jeffrey Hanes, "Urban Planning as an Urban Problem", in J. L. McClain et al. (eds.), Edo and Paris (1994)

events.note: Began on the 18th day of the 1st month of Meireki 3 (2 March 1657, Gregorian). Death estimates range from about 30,000 to over 100,000.

name.en: Koxinga takes Taiwan from the Dutch

summary.en: Ming loyalist Zheng Chenggong (Koxinga) landed at Luermen and besieged the Dutch East India Company's Fort Zeelandia for nine months, forcing its surrender in February 1662 and founding a Zheng regime on Taiwan.
summary.zh: 明郑延平王郑成功自鹿耳门登陆，围攻荷兰东印度公司热兰遮城九个月，1662年2月荷军投降，郑氏据台。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
江日昇《台湾外记》
Britannica: Zheng Chenggong

summary.en: Forces of Portuguese Angola and their Imbangala allies defeated the army of the Kingdom of Kongo; King António I was killed and beheaded. The defeat plunged Kongo into decades of civil war between rival royal houses.
summary.zh: 葡属安哥拉军队及其因班加拉盟军击败刚果王国军队，国王安东尼奥一世阵亡并被斩首。此役使刚果陷入敌对王族之间长达数十年的内战。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Battle of Mbwila
John K. Thornton, A History of West Central Africa to 1850 (2020)
António de Oliveira de Cadornega, História Geral das Guerras Angolanas (1680)

events.note: Battlefield location approximate.

summary.en: Starting in a bakery on Pudding Lane, a fire fanned by an east wind burned for four days and destroyed about 13,200 houses, 87 parish churches and old St Paul's Cathedral in the City of London. The City was rebuilt in brick and stone, with Christopher Wren's new St Paul's and City churches.
summary.zh: 大火起于布丁巷的一家面包坊，在东风助长下燃烧四天，伦敦城内约13200所房屋、87座教区教堂和旧圣保罗大教堂被毁。此后城区以砖石重建，克里斯托弗·雷恩设计了新的圣保罗大教堂和城中诸教堂。

sources.title: Britannica: Great Fire of London
The Diary of Samuel Pepys, 2 September 1666
Wikipedia: Great Fire of London

events.note: Began on 2 September 1666 in the Julian (Old Style) calendar then used in England; the date shown is the Gregorian equivalent.

summary.en: When the Kangxi Emperor moved to abolish their fiefs, Wu Sangui in Yunnan and the princes in Guangdong and Fujian rebelled. After eight years of war Qing forces took Kunming in 1681.
summary.zh: 康熙帝下令撤藩，吴三桂于云南起兵，广东尚氏、福建耿氏响应；历时八年，1681年清军攻克昆明平定。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
赵尔巽等《清史稿》卷474 吴三桂传

summary.en: A relief army of imperial, German and Polish–Lithuanian troops under King John III Sobieski routed the Ottoman forces of Grand Vizier Kara Mustafa Pasha besieging Vienna. The victory began a long Habsburg counter-offensive that recovered Hungary by 1699.
summary.zh: 由神圣罗马帝国、德意志诸邦和波兰—立陶宛军队组成、波兰国王扬三世·索别斯基统率的援军，击溃了围攻维也纳的大维齐尔卡拉·穆斯塔法帕夏的奥斯曼军队。此役开启了哈布斯堡王朝的长期反攻，至1699年收复匈牙利。

sources.title: John Stoye, The Siege of Vienna (1964)
Britannica: Siege of Vienna

name.zh: 牛顿《自然哲学的数学原理》出版

summary.en: Isaac Newton's Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica, issued in London under the Royal Society's imprimatur at Edmond Halley's expense, set out the laws of motion and universal gravitation. It unified terrestrial and celestial mechanics and became a foundation of modern physics.
summary.zh: 牛顿的《自然哲学的数学原理》经皇家学会批准在伦敦出版，费用由埃德蒙·哈雷承担。书中提出运动定律和万有引力定律，统一了地面力学与天体力学，成为近代物理学的基石。

sources.title: Richard S. Westfall, Never at Rest: A Biography of Isaac Newton (1980)
Britannica: Principia

events.note: Wikidata's inception (1680) reflects when Newton began the work. Publication was announced on 5 July 1687 in the Julian calendar then used in England; the date shown is the Gregorian equivalent (15 July).

image.artist: The original uploader was Zhaladshar at English Wikisource.

summary.en: After Qing forces besieged the Russian fort of Albazin, envoys led by Songgotu signed China's first treaty with a European state at Nerchinsk, fixing the border along the Argun river and the Stanovoy range.
summary.zh: 清军两次围攻雅克萨后，索额图与俄使在尼布楚签订条约，以额尔古纳河与外兴安岭划定中俄东段边界，是中国与欧洲国家的首个条约。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
赵尔巽等《清史稿》卷7 圣祖本纪二 康熙二十八年
Britannica: Treaty of Nerchinsk

name.en: Battle of Feyiase: rise of Asante
name.zh: 费亚斯战役：阿散蒂崛起

summary.en: The Asante confederacy under Osei Tutu, united by the priest Okomfo Anokye around the Golden Stool, defeated its overlord Denkyira. Independence gave Asante control of gold and trade routes to the coast and launched its expansion into a major West African empire.
summary.zh: 奥塞·图图领导、由祭司奥孔福·阿诺基以“金凳子”凝聚的阿散蒂联盟击败宗主国登基拉。独立使阿散蒂掌握了黄金与通往海岸的商路，开始扩张为西非强国。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Battle of Feyiase
Ivor Wilks, Asante in the Nineteenth Century (1975)
T. C. McCaskie, State and Society in Pre-Colonial Asante (1995)

events.note: Dated 1701 (some accounts 1699–1701); site near Kumasi, coordinates approximate.

summary.en: Peter the Great's Russian army decisively defeated Charles XII of Sweden near Poltava in the Great Northern War. The battle ended Sweden's era as a great power and established Russia as the dominant state of north-eastern Europe.
summary.zh: 大北方战争中，彼得大帝的俄军在波尔塔瓦附近决定性地击败瑞典国王卡尔十二世。此役终结了瑞典的强国时代，确立了俄国在东北欧的主导地位。

sources.title: Peter Englund, The Battle That Shook Europe: Poltava and the Birth of the Russian Empire (2003)
Britannica: Battle of Poltava

events.note: Wikidata gives 27 June 1709, the Julian (Old Style) date used in Russia; 8 July is the Gregorian date (28 June in the Swedish calendar).

summary.en: Nader Shah of Persia routed the far larger army of the Mughal emperor Muhammad Shah, then occupied and plundered Delhi, carrying off the Peacock Throne and exposing Mughal weakness.
summary.zh: 波斯的纳迪尔沙击溃兵力远胜于己的莫卧儿皇帝穆罕默德沙的军队，随即占领并劫掠德里，掠走孔雀宝座，莫卧儿王朝的衰弱暴露无遗。

sources.title: Michael Axworthy, The Sword of Persia (2006)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Nadir Shah
Wikidata Q2736986

image.file: Nadir Shah at the sack of Delhi - Battle scene with Nader Shah on horseback, possibly by Muhammad Ali ibn Abd al-Bayg ibn Ali Quli Jabbadar, mid-18th century, Museum of Fine Arts, Boston.jpg
image.artist: possibly by Muhammad Ali ibn Abd al-Bayg ibn Ali Quli Jabbadar

name.zh: 清朝平定准噶尔与准噶尔人大屠杀

summary.en: Qing armies under the Qianlong emperor destroyed the Dzungar Khanate after Amursana’s revolt; war, massacre and smallpox killed most of the Dzungar Oirats, and their lands became part of Qing Xinjiang.
summary.zh: 阿睦尔撒纳叛清后，乾隆帝派兵彻底摧毁准噶尔汗国；战争、屠杀与天花使准噶尔卫拉特人大部分死亡，其故地并入清朝新疆。

sources.title: Peter C. Perdue, China Marches West: The Qing Conquest of Central Eurasia (2005)
Wei Yuan, Shengwuji (Record of Imperial Military Exploits) (1842)
Wikidata Q4462644

events.note: Estimates of the death toll vary widely; Perdue follows Wei Yuan’s figure that some 40% died of smallpox and 30% were killed.

image.artist: A collaboration between Chinese and European painters. The Jesuit missionaries involved in producing the drawings in Chi

summary.en: On All Saints' Day a great earthquake, followed by a tsunami and fires, destroyed most of Lisbon and killed tens of thousands. The disaster prompted Pombal's planned rebuilding of the city and fuelled Enlightenment debate about providence, notably in Voltaire's writings.
summary.zh: 万圣节当天，一场大地震及随后的海啸和大火摧毁了里斯本大部分城区，造成数万人死亡。灾后庞巴尔侯爵主持规划重建，这场灾难也引发了以伏尔泰为代表的启蒙思想家关于天意的辩论。

sources.title: Voltaire, Poème sur le désastre de Lisbonne (1756)
Britannica: Lisbon earthquake of 1755

events.note: Wikidata's coordinates (36.0, −11.0) are the estimated offshore epicentre; this record is placed at Lisbon, the city destroyed.

summary.en: Robert Clive’s East India Company force defeated Siraj-ud-Daulah, Nawab of Bengal, after his commander Mir Jafar defected; the battle made the Company the power behind the Bengal throne and began British territorial rule in India.
summary.zh: 罗伯特·克莱武率领的东印度公司军队在孟加拉纳瓦卜西拉杰·乌德·达乌拉的将领米尔·贾法尔倒戈后将其击败；公司由此操纵孟加拉政权，英国在印度的领土统治自此开始。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Battle of Plassey
P. J. Marshall, Bengal: The British Bridgehead (New Cambridge History of India II.2, 1987)
Wikidata Q203233

image.file: Lord Clive meeting with Mir Jafar after the Battle of Plassey.jpg

summary.en: Beginning in Britain, coal-fired steam power, mechanised cotton spinning and new iron-making methods moved production from homes and workshops into factories. Manchester became the first industrial city, and the transformation spread to Europe and beyond, reshaping work, cities, trade and the global balance of power.
summary.zh: 工业革命始于英国，以煤为燃料的蒸汽动力、机械化棉纺和新的炼铁方法使生产从家庭和作坊转入工厂。曼彻斯特成为第一座工业城市，这一变革扩展到欧洲及其他地区，重塑了劳动、城市、贸易和全球力量格局。

sources.title: Britannica: Industrial Revolution
Wikipedia: Industrial Revolution
Robert C. Allen, The British Industrial Revolution in Global Perspective (2009)

events.note: Span is conventional (c. 1760–1820/1840); Wikidata ends it in 1820. Marker at Manchester.

image.file: Mémoires de la Société géologique de France (IA meymoiresdelaso00socig).pdf

summary.en: Ahmad Shah Durrani’s Afghan army, with Rohilla and Awadh allies, crushed the Maratha army under Sadashivrao Bhau in one of the largest battles of the 18th century, halting Maratha expansion in the north.
summary.zh: 艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的阿富汗军队联合罗赫拉人和奥德军队，击溃萨达希夫拉奥·鲍率领的马拉塔大军；这是18世纪规模最大的战役之一，遏止了马拉塔人向北扩张。

sources.title: T. S. Shejwalkar, Panipat 1761 (1946)
Stewart Gordon, The Marathas 1600–1818 (New Cambridge History of India II.4, 1993)
Wikidata Q1259218

image.file: The Third battle of Panipat 13 January 1761.jpg

summary.en: Company troops under Hector Munro defeated the combined forces of Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daulah of Awadh and the Mughal emperor Shah Alam II; the Treaty of Allahabad (1765) then gave the Company the revenue rights of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa.
summary.zh: 赫克托·芒罗率领的东印度公司军队击败米尔·卡西姆、奥德的舒贾·乌德·达乌拉与莫卧儿皇帝沙·阿拉姆二世的联军；1765年的《阿拉哈巴德条约》使公司获得孟加拉、比哈尔和奥里萨的财税权。

sources.title: P. J. Marshall, Bengal: The British Bridgehead (New Cambridge History of India II.2, 1987)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Battle of Buxar
Wikidata Q2355467

events.note: Standard histories date the battle 22–23 October 1764; Wikidata records 6 November 1764, which appears to be an error.

image.file: Battle of Buxar -Crown and company- Arthur Edward Mainwaring pg.144.jpg

name.en: Burmese–Siamese War and fall of Ayutthaya
name.zh: 缅暹战争与阿瑜陀耶陷落

summary.en: Konbaung Burma under Hsinbyushin invaded Siam on two fronts and, after a 14-month siege, sacked and burned Ayutthaya in April 1767, ending the 417-year-old kingdom. Taksin soon regrouped the Siamese at Thonburi.
summary.zh: 贡榜王朝孟驳王分两路入侵暹罗，经十四个月围城，于1767年4月攻陷并焚毁阿瑜陀耶，延续四百余年的王国就此灭亡。不久郑信在吞武里重整暹罗力量。

sources.title: Victor Lieberman, Strange Parallels: Southeast Asia in Global Context, c. 800–1830, Vol. 1 (Cambridge University Press, 2003)
Chris Baker & Pasuk Phongpaichit, A History of Thailand (Cambridge University Press, 2nd ed. 2009)
Hmannan Yazawin (Glass Palace Chronicle, 1832)
Wikipedia: Burmese–Siamese War (1765–1767)

summary.en: Four wars between the East India Company and Mysore under Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan, whose rocket corps and French ties made them the Company’s most formidable southern foe; they ended with Mysore reduced to a subsidiary state.
summary.zh: 东印度公司与海德尔·阿里和蒂普苏丹统治下的迈索尔之间的四次战争；迈索尔凭借火箭部队和与法国的联系，成为公司在南印度最强劲的对手，最终沦为附属国。

sources.title: Kate Brittlebank, Tipu Sultan’s Search for Legitimacy (1997)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Mysore Wars
Wikidata Q617321

events.note: Plotted at Srirangapatna, Mysore’s capital; Wikidata gives a generic point (13°N 77°E) for the wars.

summary.en: The Qianlong Emperor's Complete Library of the Four Treasuries copied some 3,500 works into about 36,000 volumes, while the same review suppressed and destroyed thousands of books judged seditious.
summary.zh: 乾隆帝开四库全书馆，抄录典籍约三千五百种、三万六千余册；修书同时禁毁大量“违碍”书籍。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
《四库全书总目》卷首 圣谕
Britannica: Siku quanshu

events.note: The first set was completed in 1782; Wikidata gives 1773–1783.

summary.en: King Rama I, founder of the Chakri dynasty, moved the capital across the Chao Phraya from Thonburi to Rattanakosin Island, setting the city pillar on 21 April 1782 and building the Grand Palace.
summary.zh: 却克里王朝开国君主拉玛一世将都城从吞武里迁至湄南河对岸的拉达那哥欣岛，于1782年4月21日立城柱，并修建大皇宫。

sources.title: Chris Baker & Pasuk Phongpaichit, A History of Thailand (Cambridge University Press, 2nd ed. 2009)
David K. Wyatt, Thailand: A Short History (Yale University Press, 2nd ed. 2003)
Wikipedia: Rattanakosin Island

name.zh: 亚洲学会在加尔各答成立

summary.en: The judge and philologist William Jones founded the Asiatic Society in Calcutta to study Asia's languages, history and sciences. His 1786 address to the Society, noting that Sanskrit, Greek and Latin shared a common source, helped found comparative linguistics and the idea of an Indo-European family.
summary.zh: 法官兼语文学家威廉·琼斯在加尔各答创立亚洲学会，研究亚洲的语言、历史和科学。他1786年在学会的演讲指出梵语、希腊语和拉丁语同出一源，为比较语言学和印欧语系概念奠定了基础。

sources.title: Britannica: Sir William Jones
Wikipedia: The Asiatic Society

summary.en: Fiscal crisis and Enlightenment ideas led the Estates-General of 1789 to transform itself into a National Assembly; the storming of the Bastille on 14 July became the Revolution's symbol. It abolished feudal privilege and the monarchy, proclaimed the Rights of Man, and ended with Napoleon Bonaparte's coup in 1799.
summary.zh: 财政危机与启蒙思想促使1789年的三级会议转变为国民议会，7月14日攻占巴士底狱成为革命的象征。大革命废除了封建特权和君主制，发表《人权宣言》，最终以1799年拿破仑·波拿巴发动政变告终。

sources.title: Déclaration des droits de l'homme et du citoyen (1789)
William Doyle, The Oxford History of the French Revolution (1989)
Britannica: French Revolution

events.note: Coordinates are those of the Bastille (Wikidata Q6539).

image.artist: Isidore Stanislas Helman / After Charles Monnet

summary.en: Nguyễn Huệ of the Tây Sơn, newly proclaimed Emperor Quang Trung, made a lightning march north during Tết and routed the Qing army that had occupied Thăng Long to restore the Lê, ending Qing intervention.
summary.zh: 西山朝阮惠刚称帝号光中，便于春节期间率军急行北上，击溃为扶持黎朝而占据升龙的清军，结束了清朝的干预。

sources.title: Keith W. Taylor, A History of the Vietnamese (Cambridge University Press, 2013)
Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư (Complete Annals of Đại Việt, 1479; 1697 ed.)
Wikipedia: Battle of Ngọc Hồi-Đống Đa

events.note: Wikidata gives 1788 (the Vietnamese lunar year Mậu Thân); the decisive fighting took place on 28–30 January 1789.

image.artist: A collaboration between Chinese and European painters. The Jesuit missionaries involved in producing the drawings in Chi

summary.en: About 1,100 Black Loyalists from Nova Scotia, freed for serving Britain in the American war, founded Freetown under the abolitionist Sierra Leone Company. It later became the base of the Royal Navy’s anti-slavery squadron and home to tens of thousands of liberated Africans.
summary.zh: 约1100名来自新斯科舍的黑人效忠派（因在美国独立战争中为英国作战而获自由）在废奴主义的塞拉利昂公司支持下建立弗里敦。此后它成为英国皇家海军反奴隶贸易舰队的基地，数万名获释非洲人在此定居。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Freetown
Christopher Fyfe, A History of Sierra Leone (1962)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. VI: Africa in the Nineteenth Century until the 1880s (ed. J. F. Ade Ajayi, 1989)

summary.en: Britain's first embassy to China, led by George Macartney, was received by the Qianlong Emperor at the Chengde summer palace, but its requests for trade concessions and a permanent embassy were refused.
summary.zh: 英国首个访华使团由马戛尔尼率领，于承德避暑山庄觐见乾隆帝，其通商与驻使要求均遭拒绝。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
Britannica: George Macartney
《清高宗实录》乾隆五十八年八月

summary.en: In Berkeley, Gloucestershire, the country doctor Edward Jenner inoculated eight-year-old James Phipps with matter from a cowpox sore and later showed that he resisted smallpox. Jenner's 1798 report launched vaccination, which spread worldwide within a decade and ultimately led to smallpox's eradication in 1980.
summary.zh: 格洛斯特郡伯克利的乡村医生爱德华·詹纳用牛痘疱疹中的物质为八岁的詹姆斯·菲普斯接种，随后证明他能抵抗天花。詹纳1798年发表的报告开启了疫苗接种，十年内传遍世界，最终使天花于1980年被宣布根除。

sources.title: Britannica: Edward Jenner
S. Riedel, "Edward Jenner and the history of smallpox and vaccination", Proceedings (Baylor University Medical Center) 18 (2005)
Wikipedia: Edward Jenner

events.note: No Wikidata item exists for the inoculation itself; the QID is omitted.

summary.en: British and Hyderabad troops stormed Tipu Sultan’s island capital; Tipu was killed defending a breach, and the Company restored the Wodeyar dynasty over a reduced Mysore.
summary.zh: 英军与海得拉巴军队攻陷蒂普苏丹的河洲都城；蒂普在城墙缺口处战死，公司随后在缩小了的迈索尔恢复沃迪亚尔王朝。

sources.title: Kate Brittlebank, Tipu Sultan’s Search for Legitimacy (1997)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Tippu Sultan
Wikidata Q815204

name.en: Sokoto jihad of Usman dan Fodio
name.zh: 奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥的索科托圣战

summary.en: The Fulani scholar Usman dan Fodio declared jihad against the Hausa king of Gobir, accusing rulers of injustice and syncretism. By 1808 his followers had toppled most Hausa kingdoms, forming the Sokoto Caliphate, the largest state in 19th-century West Africa and a centre of Islamic scholarship.
summary.zh: 富拉尼学者奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥指责豪萨统治者暴虐、信仰混杂，向戈比尔国王宣布圣战。至1808年其追随者推翻大部分豪萨王国，建立索科托哈里发国——19世纪西非最大的国家和伊斯兰学术中心。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Jihad of Usman dan Fodio
Murray Last, The Sokoto Caliphate (1967)
Mervyn Hiskett, The Sword of Truth: The Life and Times of the Shehu Usuman dan Fodio (1973)

events.note: QID is the Sokoto jihad proper (Wikidata “Sokoto Revolution”, 1804–1808); Gobir declared war on 21 February 1804, just after the hijra to Gudu. Marker at Sokoto.

summary.en: Napoleon crossed the Niemen with some 450,000 men of the Grande Armée, won a costly victory at Borodino and entered a burning Moscow in September. Without a Russian surrender, the retreat through winter, hunger and Cossack attacks destroyed most of his army.
summary.zh: 拿破仑率领约45万人的大军渡过涅曼河，在博罗季诺付出惨重代价取胜，9月进入陷于大火的莫斯科。俄国拒不求和，大军在严寒、饥饿与哥萨克袭扰中撤退，几乎全军覆没。

label.zh: 小雅罗斯拉韦茨战役，开始撤退

sources.title: Adam Zamoyski, 1812: Napoleon's Fatal March on Moscow (2004)
Dominic Lieven, Russia Against Napoleon (2009)
Britannica: Napoleon I

events.note: Estimates of the invading force range from about 450,000 to over 600,000 including reinforcements. Event placed at Borodino.

summary.en: Diplomats of the great powers, led by Metternich, Castlereagh, Alexander I and Talleyrand, redrew the map of Europe after Napoleon's defeat. The settlement, signed in June 1815, sought a balance of power and kept general peace among the great powers for decades.
summary.zh: 以梅特涅、卡斯尔雷、亚历山大一世和塔列朗为代表的列强外交官，在拿破仑战败后重新划定欧洲版图。1815年6月签署的最后议定书追求均势，使列强之间维持了数十年的大体和平。

sources.title: Final Act of the Congress of Vienna (9 June 1815)
Britannica: Congress of Vienna

events.note: Held September 1814 – June 1815 (Wikidata start/end); Wikidata point in time 1815 refers to the Final Act of 9 June 1815.

summary.en: A period of wars, migrations and state formation in southern Africa accompanied the rise of the Zulu kingdom. New polities such as Moshoeshoe’s Lesotho, the Ndebele and the Gaza emerged; historians debate how far drought, the Delagoa Bay trade and colonial slaving drove the upheaval.
summary.zh: 祖鲁王国崛起期间，南部非洲经历了战争、迁徙与新国家形成的时期。莫舒舒的莱索托、恩德贝莱、加扎等新政权相继出现；干旱、德拉瓜湾贸易与殖民掠奴各在多大程度上推动了这一动乱，史学界仍有争论。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Mfecane
Carolyn Hamilton (ed.), The Mfecane Aftermath: Reconstructive Debates in Southern African History (1995)
J. D. Omer-Cooper, The Zulu Aftermath (1966)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. VI: Africa in the Nineteenth Century until the 1880s (ed. J. F. Ade Ajayi, 1989)

events.note: Both the concept and its dates are contested (Cobbing critique, 1988).

summary.en: An Anglo-allied army under the Duke of Wellington and a Prussian army under Blücher defeated Napoleon south of Brussels. The defeat ended his Hundred Days' return to power; he abdicated again and was exiled to Saint Helena.
summary.zh: 威灵顿公爵统率的英国及其盟军与布吕歇尔统率的普鲁士军队在布鲁塞尔以南击败拿破仑。此役终结了他重掌政权的“百日王朝”，拿破仑再度退位并被流放至圣赫勒拿岛。

sources.title: Andrew Roberts, Waterloo: Napoleon's Last Gamble (2005)
Britannica: Battle of Waterloo

summary.en: The largest volcanic eruption in recorded history devastated Sumbawa, killing tens of thousands directly and through famine. Its aerosols cooled the northern hemisphere, causing the "Year Without a Summer" of 1816.
summary.zh: 有记录以来规模最大的火山喷发摧毁了松巴哇岛，直接或因饥荒死亡者数以万计。喷发的气溶胶使北半球降温，导致1816年出现“无夏之年”。

sources.title: Clive Oppenheimer, "Climatic, environmental and human consequences of the largest known historic eruption: Tambora volcano (Indonesia) 1815", Progress in Physical Geography 27:2 (2003)
M. C. Ricklefs, A History of Modern Indonesia since c. 1200 (Palgrave, 4th ed. 2008)
Wikipedia: 1815 eruption of Mount Tambora

summary.en: Prince Diponegoro of Yogyakarta led a widespread rebellion against Dutch colonial rule and its Javanese allies. The war cost some 200,000 Javanese lives before Diponegoro was seized at negotiations and exiled.
summary.zh: 日惹王子蒂博尼哥罗领导了一场反抗荷兰殖民统治及其爪哇盟友的大规模起义。战争造成约二十万爪哇人死亡，最终蒂博尼哥罗在谈判中被扣押并流放。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Java War
Peter Carey, The Power of Prophecy: Prince Dipanagara and the End of an Old Order in Java, 1785–1855 (KITLV, 2007)
M. C. Ricklefs, A History of Modern Indonesia since c. 1200 (Palgrave, 4th ed. 2008)
Wikipedia: Java War

image.file: Nicolaas Pieneman - The Submission of Prince Dipo Negoro to General De Kock.jpg

summary.en: Ending the Russo-Persian War of 1826–1828, Qajar Iran ceded the khanates of Erivan and Nakhchivan to Russia, paid a heavy indemnity and granted Russian subjects extraterritorial rights. It fixed the Aras River frontier and marked Iran's loss of the South Caucasus.
summary.zh: 条约结束了1826—1828年俄波战争。卡扎尔伊朗将埃里温和纳希切万两汗国割让给俄国，支付巨额赔款，并给予俄国臣民治外法权。条约确定以阿拉斯河为界，标志伊朗丧失南高加索。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Treaty of Turkmenchay
F. Kazemzadeh, "Iranian relations with Russia and the Soviet Union, to 1921", Cambridge History of Iran, vol. 7 (1991)
Wikipedia: Treaty of Turkmenchay

events.note: Signed 10 February 1828 (Julian; 22 February Gregorian); only the year is given.

summary.en: France landed at Sidi Ferruch and took Algiers from its Ottoman dey in 1830. Emir ʿAbd al-Qadir led organised resistance until 1847, and Kabylia rose again in 1871; the long, brutal conquest made Algeria a settler colony annexed to France.
summary.zh: 1830年法国在西迪费鲁什登陆，从奥斯曼的德伊手中夺取阿尔及尔。埃米尔阿卜杜·卡迪尔领导有组织的抵抗直至1847年，卡比利亚于1871年再度起义；漫长而残酷的征服使阿尔及利亚成为并入法国的移民殖民地。

sources.title: Wikipedia: French conquest of Algeria
Benjamin Stora, Algeria 1830–2000: A Short History (2001)
Britannica: ʿAbd al-Qādir
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. VI: Africa in the Nineteenth Century until the 1880s (ed. J. F. Ade Ajayi, 1989)

events.note: End date conventional: Wikidata gives 1904, many accounts 1903 (Saharan campaigns).

image.file: La prise de Constantine 1837 par Horace Vernet.jpg

summary.en: Thousands of Dutch-speaking Boers left the British Cape Colony with their servants and herds, moving onto the highveld and into Natal. Clashes with the Ndebele and Zulu, including Blood River in 1838, led to the Boer republics of Transvaal and Orange Free State.
summary.zh: 数千名讲荷兰语的布尔人携仆从与牲畜离开英属开普殖民地，迁入高地草原与纳塔尔。他们与恩德贝莱人、祖鲁人发生冲突（包括1838年血河之战），最终建立德兰士瓦和奥兰治自由邦两个布尔共和国。

label.en: Parties leave the eastern Cape frontier
label.zh: 各队离开开普东部边疆

label.en: Gather at Thaba Nchu with Barolong aid
label.zh: 在塔巴恩丘集结，得巴罗隆人援助
彼得马里茨堡：纳塔利亚共和国
在德兰士瓦建立奥里赫斯塔德

sources.title: Wikipedia: Great Trek
Hermann Giliomee, The Afrikaners: Biography of a People (2003)
Norman Etherington, The Great Treks: The Transformation of Southern Africa, 1815–1854 (2001)

events.note: Date range follows Wikidata (1836–1852, to the Sand River Convention); many accounts date the main movement 1835–1840s.

summary.en: Imperial commissioner Lin Zexu confiscated over 20,000 chests of British opium in Canton and destroyed it on the beach at Humen over 23 days, a confrontation that led directly to the First Opium War.
summary.zh: 钦差大臣林则徐收缴英商鸦片两万余箱，于虎门海滩历时二十三天当众销毁，直接引发第一次鸦片战争。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
赵尔巽等《清史稿》卷369 林则徐传

summary.en: Britain sent an expeditionary force after the opium seizures; steam warships blockaded the coast, took Zhoushan, Xiamen and Zhenjiang and threatened Nanjing, forcing the Qing to sue for peace.
summary.zh: 英国以禁烟为由派远征军来华，封锁沿海，攻占定海、厦门、镇江，兵临南京，清廷被迫求和。

summary.en: Potato blight destroyed the staple crop of Ireland's rural poor in successive years while food exports continued and relief was limited. About one million people died of starvation and disease and over a million emigrated, cutting Ireland's population by roughly a quarter.
summary.zh: 马铃薯晚疫病连年摧毁爱尔兰农村贫民的主粮，而粮食出口照常、救济有限。约100万人死于饥饿和疾病，逾100万人移居海外，爱尔兰人口减少约四分之一。

summary.en: A wave of liberal and national uprisings spread from Palermo and Paris to Vienna, Berlin, Budapest and Milan. Most were suppressed by 1849, but serfdom was abolished in the Austrian lands and the revolutions shaped later national movements.
summary.zh: 一股自由主义和民族主义起义浪潮从巴勒莫和巴黎蔓延至维也纳、柏林、布达佩斯和米兰。多数起义到1849年遭到镇压，但奥地利境内废除了农奴制，这场革命也深刻影响了此后的民族运动。

sources.title: Mike Rapport, 1848: Year of Revolution (2008)

summary.en: After a revolt at Multan, Company armies fought the Sikh Khalsa at Chillianwala and Gujrat; victory led to the annexation of the Punjab in March 1849 and the exile of the boy-maharaja Duleep Singh.

summary.zh: 洪秀全领导拜上帝会于广西金田起义，1853年定都天京。天京事变后由盛转衰，1864年为曾国藩湘军所灭，死难者或达二千万。

summary.en: Charles Darwin's On the Origin of Species, published in London by John Murray, argued that species evolve over generations through natural selection. The book transformed biology and provoked wide religious and philosophical debate.
summary.zh: 查尔斯·达尔文的《物种起源》由伦敦约翰·默里出版社出版，提出物种通过自然选择代代演化。此书彻底改变了生物学，并引发广泛的宗教与哲学争论。

summary.en: Led by Piedmont-Sardinia's prime minister Cavour and the volunteer campaigns of Giuseppe Garibaldi, most Italian states were united and the Kingdom of Italy was proclaimed in Turin in 1861 under Victor Emmanuel II. Venetia joined in 1866, and Rome, taken in 1870, became the capital in 1871.
summary.zh: 在撒丁王国首相加富尔的主导和朱塞佩·加里波第志愿军的征战下，意大利大部分邦国得以统一，1861年在都灵宣告成立以维克托·伊曼纽尔二世为国王的意大利王国。威尼托于1866年并入，1870年攻占的罗马于1871年成为首都。

summary.zh: 切尔尼亚耶夫将军未经圣彼得堡明确授权便攻陷浩罕汗国最大的城市塔什干；1867年该城成为俄国突厥斯坦总督区首府。

summary.en: Samurai from Satsuma and Chōshū proclaimed the restoration of imperial rule in Kyoto on 3 January 1868 and defeated the shogunate in the Boshin War. The new government abolished the domains and samurai privileges and set Japan on a course of rapid modernisation.
summary.zh: 1868年1月3日，萨摩、长州等藩的武士在京都宣布“王政复古”，并在戊辰战争中击败幕府。新政府废藩置县、废除武士特权，使日本走上迅速现代化的道路。

summary.en: Built from 1859 by Ferdinand de Lesseps’s company with the forced labour of tens of thousands of Egyptian peasants, the canal opened under Khedive Ismaʿil, linking the Mediterranean and Red Sea. Egypt’s debts soon led it to sell its shares to Britain (1875).
summary.zh: 运河自1859年由斐迪南·德·雷赛布的公司修建，数万埃及农民被强征服役，在赫迪夫伊斯梅尔治下通航，连通地中海与红海。埃及因债务很快于1875年将其股份售予英国。

summary.en: After Prussian victories over Denmark, Austria and France engineered by Otto von Bismarck, King Wilhelm I of Prussia was proclaimed German Emperor in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles. The new German Empire became continental Europe's leading industrial and military power.
summary.zh: 在俾斯麦主导下，普鲁士先后战胜丹麦、奥地利和法国，随后普鲁士国王威廉一世在凡尔赛宫镜厅被宣布为德意志皇帝。新成立的德意志帝国成为欧洲大陆首屈一指的工业与军事强国。

summary.en: After a gunboat confrontation off Ganghwa Island, Japan forced Joseon to sign its first modern, unequal treaty, opening three ports and granting Japanese extraterritoriality. It ended Korea's seclusion and its exclusive tributary ties to Qing China.
summary.zh: 在江华岛炮舰冲突之后，日本迫使朝鲜签订第一个近代不平等条约，开放三处港口并给予日本领事裁判权。条约打破了朝鲜的闭关状态及其与清朝的宗藩关系。

summary.en: A Zulu army of about 20,000 under Ntshingwayo kaMahole overwhelmed the camp of a British column invading King Cetshwayo’s kingdom, killing over 1,300 soldiers. It was among the heaviest defeats of a modern army by an African force, though Britain went on to take Ulundi that July.
summary.zh: 恩茨欣瓦约·卡马霍莱率约两万祖鲁大军攻破入侵塞奇瓦约国王领地的英军营地，击毙一千三百余人。这是非洲军队对近代军队取得的最惨重胜利之一，但英军仍于同年7月攻占乌伦迪。

summary.en: Colonel Ahmad ʿUrabi led Egyptian officers and notables against foreign financial control and the Turco-Circassian elite under the slogan “Egypt for the Egyptians”. Britain bombarded Alexandria and defeated ʿUrabi at Tel el-Kebir in 1882, beginning an occupation that lasted until 1956.
summary.zh: 艾哈迈德·奥拉比上校率埃及军官与士绅，以“埃及人的埃及”为口号反对外国财政控制和土耳其—切尔克斯精英。1882年英国炮击亚历山大港，并在泰勒凯比尔击败奥拉比，开始了持续至1956年的占领。

summary.en: After a failed attack in 1879, General Mikhail Skobelev besieged the Teke Turkmen fortress of Geok Tepe and stormed it in January 1881, followed by the slaughter of fleeing defenders and civilians; it completed Russia’s conquest of the Turkmen.
summary.zh: 1879年进攻失败后，斯科别列夫将军围攻帖克土库曼人的格奥克捷佩要塞，于1881年1月攻破并屠杀出逃的守军与平民，完成了俄国对土库曼人的征服。

summary.zh: 短短三十余年间，欧洲列强通过条约、特许公司和军事征服瓜分了几乎整个非洲大陆。只有击败意大利的埃塞俄比亚和利比里亚保持独立，而从摩洛哥到开普，各地抵抗此起彼伏。

summary.en: Britain fought the Transvaal and Orange Free State over control of the gold-rich interior. Its scorched-earth tactics and concentration camps killed tens of thousands of Boer and Black African civilians; the Treaty of Vereeniging (1902) led to the Union of South Africa in 1910.
summary.zh: 英国与德兰士瓦和奥兰治自由邦为争夺富含黄金的内陆而战。英军的焦土战术与集中营造成数万布尔人和非洲黑人平民死亡；1902年《弗里尼欣和约》之后，1910年成立南非联邦。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Second Boer War
Thomas Pakenham, The Boer War (1979)
Peter Warwick, Black People and the South African War, 1899–1902 (1983)

name.zh: 义和团运动与八国联军

summary.en: Anti-foreign Boxer militias besieged the Beijing legations with court support in 1900; an eight-nation expeditionary force took the city, the Empress Dowager fled to Xi'an, and the Boxer Protocol imposed a vast indemnity.
summary.zh: 义和团在清廷纵容下围攻北京使馆区，八国联军攻占北京，慈禧挟光绪西逃；1901年《辛丑条约》赔款四亿五千万两。

summary.en: When the British governor demanded to sit on the Golden Stool, the sacred symbol of Asante nationhood, Queen Mother Yaa Asantewaa of Ejisu led an uprising that besieged the British fort at Kumasi. The rising was crushed and Asante annexed, but the Stool itself was never surrendered.
summary.zh: 英国总督要求坐上阿散蒂民族的神圣象征“金凳子”，埃吉苏王太后雅阿·阿散蒂瓦随即领导起义，围攻库马西的英军堡垒。起义被镇压、阿散蒂遭吞并，但金凳子始终未被交出。

sources.title: Wikipedia: War of the Golden Stool
A. Adu Boahen, Yaa Asantewaa and the Asante–British War of 1900–1 (2003)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. VII: Africa under Colonial Domination 1880–1935 (ed. A. Adu Boahen, 1985)

name.zh: 赫雷罗人和纳马人种族灭绝

summary.en: After the Herero and Nama rose against German rule in South West Africa, General von Trotha issued an extermination order; survivors were driven into the Omaheke desert or concentration camps. Most Herero and about half the Nama died. Germany acknowledged the events as genocide in 2021.
summary.zh: 赫雷罗人和纳马人起义反抗德属西南非洲统治后，冯·特罗塔将军下达灭绝令，幸存者被驱入奥马赫科沙漠或集中营。大多数赫雷罗人和约半数纳马人死亡。德国于2021年承认其为种族灭绝。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Herero and Nama genocide
David Olusoga & Casper W. Erichsen, The Kaiser’s Holocaust (2010)
Jürgen Zimmerer & Joachim Zeller (eds.), Genocide in German South-West Africa (2008)

events.note: Marker at the Waterberg, site of the decisive battle of August 1904 (approximate).

wiki.zh: 赫雷罗人和纳马人大屠杀

summary.en: Rivalry over Manchuria and Korea led Japan to attack the Russian fleet at Port Arthur in 1904. Japanese victories on land at Mukden and at sea at Tsushima produced the Treaty of Portsmouth, the first defeat of a European great power by an Asian state in modern times.
summary.zh: 日俄两国因争夺中国东北与朝鲜而交恶，1904年日本突袭旅顺口的俄国舰队。日本在奉天陆战与对马海战中获胜，双方签订《朴次茅斯条约》，这是近代亚洲国家首次击败欧洲列强。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Russo-Japanese War
The Cambridge History of Japan, Vol. 6: The Twentieth Century (1988)
Marius B. Jansen, The Making of Modern Japan (Harvard University Press, 2000)
Wikipedia: Russo-Japanese War

summary.en: Peoples of southern German East Africa, resisting forced cotton cultivation and taxes, rose together, many trusting sacred water (maji) from the prophet Kinjikitile to turn bullets. German famine tactics left perhaps 75,000–300,000 dead.
summary.zh: 德属东非南部各族因反抗强制种植棉花和苛税而联合起义，许多人相信先知金吉基提勒所赐的圣水（“马及”）能化解子弹。德军的饥荒战术造成约7.5万至30万人死亡。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Maji Maji Rebellion
John Iliffe, A Modern History of Tanganyika (1979)
G. C. K. Gwassa & John Iliffe (eds.), Records of the Maji Maji Rising (1967)

events.note: Marker in the Matumbi Hills where the rising began (approximate); death toll estimates vary widely.

summary.en: Admiral Tōgō Heihachirō's fleet annihilated the Russian Baltic Fleet, which had sailed halfway around the world, in the Tsushima Strait. The battle decided the Russo-Japanese War.
summary.zh: 东乡平八郎率领的日本联合舰队在对马海峡全歼远航半个地球而来的俄国波罗的海舰队，决定了日俄战争的结局。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Battle of Tsushima
The Cambridge History of Japan, Vol. 6: The Twentieth Century (1988)
Marius B. Jansen, The Making of Modern Japan (Harvard University Press, 2000)
Wikipedia: Battle of Tsushima

summary.en: Under military pressure, Korean ministers signed a treaty making the Korean Empire a Japanese protectorate and handing its diplomacy to a Japanese Resident-General, Itō Hirobumi. Emperor Gojong never ratified it.
summary.zh: 在日本军事压力下，大韩帝国大臣签订条约，使韩国沦为日本保护国，外交权交由日本统监伊藤博文掌管。高宗皇帝始终未予批准。

sources.title: Peter Duus, The Abacus and the Sword: The Japanese Penetration of Korea, 1895–1910 (University of California Press, 1995)
Michael J. Seth, A History of Korea: From Antiquity to the Present (Rowman & Littlefield, 2010)
Wikipedia: Japan–Korea Treaty of 1905

summary.en: Viceroy Lord Curzon split Bengal, separating the largely Muslim east; mass protest and the Swadeshi boycott forced its reversal in 1911, when the capital of British India also moved from Calcutta to Delhi.
summary.zh: 总督寇松将孟加拉一分为二，使以穆斯林为主的东部独立成省；大规模抗议和“司瓦德西”抵制运动迫使英国于1911年撤销分治，同年英属印度首都由加尔各答迁往德里。

sources.title: Sumit Sarkar, Modern India 1885–1947 (1983)
Sumit Sarkar, The Swadeshi Movement in Bengal 1903–1908 (1973)
Wikidata Q2047143

summary.en: Protests by merchants, clerics and reformers forced Mozaffar al-Din Shah to accept an elected parliament (Majles) and, in 1906, a constitution, one of the first in Asia. Royalist reaction, civil war and Russian intervention closed the revolutionary period in 1911.
summary.zh: 商人、宗教人士和改革者的抗议迫使穆扎法尔丁沙接受民选议会（马吉利斯），并于1906年颁布宪法，这是亚洲最早的宪法之一。保皇派反扑、内战和俄国干涉使革命时期于1911年结束。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Constitutional Revolution
E. Abrahamian, Iran Between Two Revolutions (1982)
Wikipedia: Persian Constitutional Revolution

summary.en: The Djenné masons’ guild under master builder Ismaila Traoré raised the present mud-brick mosque on the site of the medieval original. Re-plastered by the whole town each year, it is the largest earthen building in the world and an emblem of Sudano-Sahelian architecture.
summary.zh: 杰内泥瓦匠行会在建筑大师伊斯梅拉·特拉奥雷主持下，于中世纪原寺旧址上建起现今的泥砖清真寺。全城居民每年为之重新抹泥，它是世界上最大的土建筑，也是苏丹—萨赫勒建筑风格的象征。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Great Mosque of Djenné
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Old Towns of Djenné
Jean-Louis Bourgeois, “The History of the Great Mosques of Djenné”, African Arts 20/3 (1987)

name.zh: 马斯吉德苏莱曼发现石油

summary.en: Drillers working William Knox D'Arcy's concession struck oil at Masjed Soleyman in Khuzestan, the first commercial oil discovery in the Middle East. It led to the Anglo-Persian Oil Company (later BP) and transformed the region's strategic importance.
summary.zh: 在威廉·诺克斯·达西特许权下作业的钻井队在胡齐斯坦的马斯吉德苏莱曼钻出石油，这是中东首次商业性石油发现。此后成立英波石油公司（后来的BP），该地区的战略地位由此改变。

sources.title: D. Yergin, The Prize: The Epic Quest for Oil, Money, and Power (1991)
Wikipedia: Masjed Soleyman oil field
Wikipedia: Anglo-Persian Oil Company

summary.en: Officers of the Committee of Union and Progress, starting in Ottoman Macedonia, forced Sultan Abdul Hamid II to restore the 1876 constitution and parliament. The Second Constitutional Era that followed brought the Unionists to power; they later led the empire into World War I.
summary.zh: 统一与进步委员会的军官从奥斯曼马其顿起事，迫使苏丹阿卜杜勒-哈米德二世恢复1876年宪法和议会。随后的第二立宪时期使统一派掌权，他们后来带领帝国加入第一次世界大战。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Young Turk Revolution of 1908
F. Ahmad, The Young Turks (1969)
Wikipedia: Young Turk Revolution

events.note: Plotted at Salonica (Thessaloniki), the CUP's centre, where the movement began; geographically in Europe.

image.file: Declaration of the 1908 Revolution in Ottoman Empire.png

summary.en: Built by the Ottoman state largely with donations from Muslims worldwide, the narrow-gauge line from Damascus reached Medina in 1908, cutting the pilgrimage journey from weeks to days. Repeatedly attacked during the Arab Revolt of 1916–18, its southern section was never restored.
summary.zh: 汉志铁路由奥斯曼政府主要依靠世界各地穆斯林的捐款修建，这条窄轨铁路自大马士革南下，1908年通抵麦地那，使朝觐旅程由数周缩短为数日。1916至1918年阿拉伯起义期间屡遭袭击，其南段此后再未恢复。

sources.title: Britannica: Hejaz Railway
Wikipedia: Hejaz railway
W. Ochsenwald, The Hijaz Railroad (1980)

summary.en: Prime Minister Yi Wan-yong and Resident-General Terauchi Masatake signed the annexation treaty on 22 August 1910; it was proclaimed a week later, ending the Korean Empire and beginning 35 years of Japanese colonial rule.
summary.zh: 1910年8月22日，总理大臣李完用与统监寺内正毅签订合并条约，一周后公布。大韩帝国就此灭亡，朝鲜开始了长达三十五年的日本殖民统治。

sources.title: Peter Duus, The Abacus and the Sword: The Japanese Penetration of Korea, 1895–1910 (University of California Press, 1995)

Wikipedia: Japan–Korea Treaty of 1910

summary.en: Revolutionary soldiers of the New Army rose at Wuchang on 10 October 1911 and took the Hubei capital; within weeks most provinces declared independence from the Qing.
summary.zh: 1911年10月10日湖北新军革命党人在武昌起义，占领武汉三镇，各省纷纷响应宣布独立。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)

summary.en: Sun Yat-sen was inaugurated as provisional president of the Republic of China in Nanjing on 1 January 1912; on 12 February the child emperor Puyi abdicated, ending over two thousand years of imperial rule.
summary.zh: 1912年1月1日孙中山在南京就任中华民国临时大总统；2月12日清帝溥仪退位，两千多年帝制终结。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)

summary.en: Triggered by the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand in Sarajevo, war between the Central Powers and the Allies brought trench deadlock in the west and vast campaigns in the east. About 9–10 million soldiers died, and the German, Austro-Hungarian, Russian and Ottoman empires collapsed.
summary.zh: 奥匈帝国皇储弗朗茨·斐迪南大公在萨拉热窝遇刺，引发同盟国与协约国之间的大战，西线陷入堑壕僵持，东线则展开大规模运动战。约九百万至一千万军人阵亡，德意志、奥匈、俄罗斯和奥斯曼四大帝国相继崩溃。

sources.title: Hew Strachan, The First World War (2003)
Britannica: World War I

events.note: Placed at Verdun on the Western Front (Wikidata has no coordinates). Wikidata point in time (11 Nov 1918) is the Armistice; start and end dates match.

summary.en: During World War I the Ottoman government of the Committee of Union and Progress carried out the systematic deportation and mass killing of the empire's Armenians, beginning with the arrest of Armenian leaders in Constantinople on 24 April 1915. Scholars estimate 600,000 to 1.5 million deaths; Turkey disputes the term genocide.
summary.zh: 第一次世界大战期间，统一与进步委员会领导的奥斯曼政府对帝国境内的亚美尼亚人实施有组织的驱逐和大规模屠杀，始于1915年4月24日在君士坦丁堡逮捕亚美尼亚知名人士。学者估计死者约60万至150万人；土耳其对“种族灭绝”这一定性持异议。

sources.title: R. G. Suny, "They Can Live in the Desert but Nowhere Else": A History of the Armenian Genocide (2015)
T. Akçam, The Young Turks' Crime against Humanity (2012)
Wikipedia: Armenian genocide

events.note: Plotted at Deir ez-Zor, destination of the deportation marches; the killings took place across Anatolia and Syria.

summary.en: The Allies tried to force the Dardanelles and knock the Ottoman Empire out of the war. After naval attacks failed, British, ANZAC and French landings on the Gallipoli peninsula were contained by Ottoman defenders, among them Mustafa Kemal, and evacuated in January 1916.
summary.zh: 协约国企图强行打通达达尼尔海峡，迫使奥斯曼帝国退出战争。海军进攻失败后，英国、澳新军团和法国部队在加里波利半岛登陆，但被包括穆斯塔法·凯末尔在内的奥斯曼守军遏制，最终于1916年1月撤离。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Battle of Gallipoli
P. Hart, Gallipoli (2011)
Wikipedia: Gallipoli campaign

summary.en: A tsarist decree drafting Central Asians for labour behind the front sparked revolt from Khujand to Semirechye; brutal reprisals and the flight of Kazakhs and Kyrgyz across the mountains to China cost well over a hundred thousand lives.
summary.zh: 沙皇征发中亚居民赴前线后方服劳役的命令引发从苦盏到七河地区的起义；残酷镇压以及哈萨克人、吉尔吉斯人翻山逃往中国，造成十余万人以上死亡。

sources.title: Adeeb Khalid, Central Asia: A New History from the Imperial Conquests to the Present (2021)
Aminat Chokobaeva, Cloé Drieu & Alexander Morrison (eds.), The Central Asian Revolt of 1916 (2019)

summary.en: Guerrilla bands, strongest in the Fergana valley and eastern Bukhara, fought Soviet rule after the Bolsheviks crushed the Kokand Autonomy in 1918; the Ottoman exile Enver Pasha joined them before his death in 1922.
summary.zh: 1918年布尔什维克摧毁浩罕自治政府后，以费尔干纳盆地和东布哈拉为主要据点的游击队奋起反抗苏维埃统治；奥斯曼流亡者恩维尔帕夏曾加入其中，1922年战死。

summary.en: In a secret agreement, British and French diplomats Mark Sykes and François Georges-Picot, with Russian assent, divided the Ottoman Arab provinces into zones of influence. It shaped the post-war mandates and is widely remembered in the region as a symbol of imperial partition.
summary.zh: 英法外交官马克·赛克斯和弗朗索瓦·乔治-皮科在俄国同意下秘密划分奥斯曼帝国阿拉伯诸省的势力范围。协定影响了战后的委任统治格局，在当地被普遍视为帝国主义瓜分的象征。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Sykes-Picot Agreement
J. Barr, A Line in the Sand (2011)
Wikipedia: Sykes–Picot Agreement

summary.en: Sharif Husayn ibn Ali of Mecca, encouraged by Britain, launched a revolt against Ottoman rule in the Hejaz. Arab forces led by his son Faisal, aided by British officers including T. E. Lawrence, advanced north via Aqaba and entered Damascus in October 1918.
summary.zh: 麦加谢里夫侯赛因·本·阿里在英国鼓动下于汉志发动反抗奥斯曼统治的起义。其子费萨尔率领的阿拉伯部队在T. E. 劳伦斯等英国军官协助下经亚喀巴北上，1918年10月进入大马士革。

sources.title: E. Rogan, The Fall of the Ottomans (2015)
T. E. Lawrence, Seven Pillars of Wisdom (1926)
Wikipedia: Arab Revolt

summary.en: The Bolsheviks under Vladimir Lenin overthrew Russia's Provisional Government in Petrograd, seizing the Winter Palace. Their seizure of power led to civil war and to the founding of the Soviet Union in 1922.
summary.zh: 列宁领导的布尔什维克在彼得格勒推翻俄国临时政府，攻占冬宫。这次夺权引发了内战，并导致1922年苏联的建立。

sources.title: John Reed, Ten Days That Shook the World (1919)
Orlando Figes, A People's Tragedy: The Russian Revolution 1891–1924 (1996)
Britannica: October Revolution

summary.en: Beijing students protested the Paris Peace Conference decision to give Germany's Shandong concessions to Japan; the demonstrations grew into a nationwide movement for science, democracy and vernacular culture.
summary.zh: 北京学生抗议巴黎和会将德国在山东权益转让日本，示威扩展为全国运动，推动了以科学、民主与白话文为旗帜的新文化运动。

summary.en: Signed in the Hall of Mirrors five years to the day after the Sarajevo assassination, the treaty ended the war between Germany and the Allies. Germany lost territory and colonies and accepted limits on its armed forces and liability for reparations; the treaty also created the League of Nations.
summary.zh: 和约在萨拉热窝事件整整五年后于凡尔赛宫镜厅签署，结束了德国与协约国之间的战争。德国丧失领土和殖民地，接受军备限制并承担赔款责任；和约还创建了国际联盟。

sources.title: Margaret MacMillan, Peacemakers: The Paris Conference of 1919 and Its Attempt to End War (2001)

summary.en: A Declaration of Independence was read in Seoul on 1 March 1919, sparking nationwide peaceful demonstrations against Japanese rule. Their violent suppression killed thousands, but the movement led to the Korean Provisional Government in Shanghai.
summary.zh: 1919年3月1日，《独立宣言》在汉城宣读，引发全国性反对日本统治的和平示威。运动遭血腥镇压，数千人遇难，但随后促成了上海大韩民国临时政府的成立。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: March First Movement

summary.en: Troops under Brigadier-General Reginald Dyer fired without warning on a crowd in an enclosed garden at Amritsar, killing hundreds (379 by the official count, many more by Indian estimates); it turned many moderates against British rule.
summary.zh: 戴尔准将率部在阿姆利则一处封闭园地内不加警告地向人群开枪，造成数百人死亡（官方统计379人，印方估计远多于此），使许多温和派转而反对英国统治。

sources.title: Kim A. Wagner, Amritsar 1919: An Empire of Fear and the Making of a Massacre (2019)

summary.en: Mongolian revolutionaries led by Damdin Sükhbaatar, backed by the Red Army, expelled Baron Ungern-Sternberg’s White forces from Urga; the regime they founded proclaimed the Mongolian People’s Republic, the second communist state, in 1924.
summary.zh: 苏赫巴托尔领导的蒙古革命者在苏俄红军支持下，将恩琴男爵的白军逐出库伦；他们建立的政权于1924年宣布成立蒙古人民共和国，成为世界上第二个社会主义国家。

sources.title: Charles R. Bawden, The Modern History of Mongolia (1968)

summary.en: After victory in the War of Independence and the Treaty of Lausanne, the Grand National Assembly in Ankara proclaimed the Republic of Turkey, with Mustafa Kemal (Atatürk) as its first president. The caliphate was abolished in 1924 and sweeping secularising reforms followed.
summary.zh: 独立战争胜利和《洛桑条约》签订后，安卡拉的大国民议会宣布成立土耳其共和国，穆斯塔法·凯末尔（阿塔图尔克）任首任总统。1924年哈里发制度被废除，此后推行了全面的世俗化改革。

summary.en: Back from holiday at his laboratory in St Mary's Hospital, London, Alexander Fleming noticed that a Penicillium mould had killed the staphylococcus bacteria around it. Howard Florey and Ernst Chain's Oxford team turned penicillin into a usable drug in 1940–41, opening the antibiotic era.
summary.zh: 亚历山大·弗莱明度假归来，在伦敦圣玛丽医院的实验室里发现一种青霉菌杀死了周围的葡萄球菌。1940至1941年，弗洛里和钱恩领导的牛津团队把青霉素制成可用的药物，开启了抗生素时代。

summary.en: After heavy winter snow and months of torrential rain, the Yangtze, Huai and Yellow rivers overflowed in summer 1931, flooding a vast area and leaving Wuhan under water for weeks. Estimates of deaths from drowning, famine and disease range from about 400,000 to several million.
summary.zh: 1930年冬季大雪及随后连月暴雨之后，长江、淮河和黄河于1931年夏相继泛滥，大片地区被淹，武汉城内积水数周。溺亡及随后的饥荒和疫病造成的死亡人数估计从约40万到数百万不等。

summary.en: Germany's invasion of Poland on 1 September 1939 began a war that by 1941 pitted the Axis against Britain, the Soviet Union and the United States. summary.en: North Korea invaded the South in June 1950. A US-led UN force, after holding the Pusan Perimeter and landing at Incheon, advanced to the Yalu; Chinese intervention drove it back, and the front settled near the 38th parallel until the 1953 armistice.
summary.zh: 1950年6月朝鲜人民军南下。以美国为首的联合国军守住釜山防御圈并在仁川登陆后推进至鸭绿江；中国人民志愿军参战后将其击退，战线最终稳定在三八线附近，直至1953年签订停战协定。

label.en: North Korean forces cross the 38th parallel (25 June)
label.zh: 朝鲜人民军越过三八线（6月25日）
联合国军推进至鸭绿江

summary.en: General Douglas MacArthur's amphibious landing at Incheon, behind North Korean lines, led to the recapture of Seoul and the collapse of the North Korean army in the South.
summary.zh: 麦克阿瑟将军指挥联合国军在朝鲜人民军后方的仁川实施两栖登陆，随后收复汉城，使南下的朝鲜人民军全面溃退。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Incheon landing

Wikipedia: Battle of Inchon

name.en: Constitution of India comes into force

summary.en: Drafted by the Constituent Assembly, with B. R. Ambedkar chairing its drafting committee, the constitution made India a sovereign democratic republic with universal adult suffrage.
summary.zh: 由制宪会议起草、安贝德卡尔主持起草委员会的宪法正式生效，印度成为实行成人普选的主权民主共和国。

sources.title: Granville Austin, The Indian Constitution: Cornerstone of a Nation (1966)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Constitution of India
Wikidata Q477108

summary.en: The Free Officers led by Gamal Abdel Nasser and Muhammad Naguib seized power in a bloodless coup, forcing King Farouk to abdicate. The monarchy was abolished in 1953, land reform followed, and Nasser emerged as leader of Arab nationalism and the non-aligned world.
summary.zh: 以纳赛尔和纳吉布为首的“自由军官组织”发动不流血政变，迫使法鲁克国王退位。1953年废除君主制，随后推行土地改革，纳赛尔成为阿拉伯民族主义和不结盟运动的领袖。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Egyptian revolution of 1952
Joel Gordon, Nasser’s Blessed Movement: Egypt’s Free Officers and the July Revolution (1992)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. VIII: Africa since 1935 (ed. A. A. Mazrui, 1993)

summary.en: The Kenya Land and Freedom Army, mainly Kikuyu, fought British colonial rule and settler land seizure in the central highlands. Britain declared an emergency and detained some tens of thousands in camps where abuse was systematic; the struggle hastened Kenyan independence in 1963.
summary.zh: 以基库尤人为主的“肯尼亚土地与自由军”在中部高原反抗英国殖民统治和移民夺地。英国宣布紧急状态，将数以万计的人关入系统性施虐的拘留营；这一斗争加速了肯尼亚于1963年独立。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Mau Mau rebellion
Caroline Elkins, Imperial Reckoning: The Untold Story of Britain’s Gulag in Kenya (2005)
David Anderson, Histories of the Hanged (2005)

events.note: Marker at Nyeri in the central highlands.

summary.en: Signed at Panmunjom by the UN Command, the Korean People's Army and the Chinese People's Volunteers, the armistice ended fighting and created the Demilitarized Zone. No peace treaty has followed.
summary.zh: 联合国军司令部与朝鲜人民军、中国人民志愿军在板门店签署停战协定，停止敌对行动并设立非军事区。此后双方至今未签订和平条约。

sources.title: Bruce Cumings, The Korean War: A History (Modern Library, 2010)
Roy E. Appleman, South to the Naktong, North to the Yalu (U.S. Army Center of Military History, 1961)
Wikipedia: Korean Armistice Agreement

summary.en: Iranian army officers and royalists, organised with the help of the US CIA and British intelligence, overthrew Prime Minister Mohammad Mosaddegh, who had nationalised the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company. The coup restored the power of Mohammad Reza Shah and left lasting distrust of the West in Iran.
summary.zh: 在美国中央情报局和英国情报机构协助策划下，伊朗军官和保皇派推翻了将英伊石油公司国有化的首相穆罕默德·摩萨台。政变恢复了穆罕默德-礼萨·沙的权力，并在伊朗留下对西方的长期不信任。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: 1953 coup in Iran
Encyclopaedia Iranica: Coup d'etat of 1332 Š./1953
Wikipedia: 1953 Iranian coup d'état

summary.en: The National Liberation Front (FLN) launched coordinated attacks on 1 November 1954. France answered with mass troop deployments, torture and resettlement camps; after hundreds of thousands of deaths the Évian Accords led to Algerian independence on 5 July 1962.
summary.zh: 民族解放阵线于1954年11月1日发动协同袭击。法国以大规模派兵、酷刑和强制安置营回应；在数十万人死亡后，《埃维昂协议》促成阿尔及利亚于1962年7月5日独立。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Algerian War
Alistair Horne, A Savage War of Peace: Algeria 1954–1962 (1977)
Benjamin Stora, Algeria 1830–2000: A Short History (2001)

summary.en: Khrushchev’s programme sent hundreds of thousands of volunteers to plough the steppe of northern Kazakhstan and Siberia for wheat; harvests rose at first, but erosion and dust storms followed, and settlers changed Kazakhstan’s ethnic balance.
summary.zh: 赫鲁晓夫的计划派遣数十万志愿者开垦哈萨克斯坦北部和西伯利亚的草原种植小麦；初期收成增加，但随后出现水土流失和沙尘暴，移民也改变了哈萨克斯坦的民族构成。

sources.title: Michaela Pohl, The Virgin Lands between Memory and Forgetting (PhD diss., Indiana University, 1999)
Adeeb Khalid, Central Asia: A New History from the Imperial Conquests to the Present (2021)
Wikidata Q2006581

summary.en: Việt Minh forces under Võ Nguyên Giáp hauled artillery onto the hills around a French fortified valley and forced its surrender after 56 days. The defeat ended French rule in Indochina at the Geneva Conference.
summary.zh: 武元甲指挥越盟军队将火炮运上环绕法军谷地要塞的山头，经五十六天围攻迫使守军投降。此役使法国在日内瓦会议上结束了对印度支那的统治。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Battle of Điện Biên Phủ
Bernard B. Fall, Hell in a Very Small Place: The Siege of Dien Bien Phu (Lippincott, 1966)

summary.en: A war between communist North Vietnam with the southern National Liberation Front and the US-backed South Vietnam. US troop strength passed 500,000 in 1968 and peaked at about 543,000 in 1969; after the US withdrawal of 1973, Saigon fell in April 1975 and Vietnam was reunified.
summary.zh: 以越南北方及南方民族解放阵线为一方、美国支持的南越为另一方的战争。美军在越兵力于1968年超过五十万，1969年达到约54.3万的峰值；1973年美军撤出后，西贡于1975年4月陷落，越南实现统一。

label.en: US Marines land at Đà Nẵng
label.zh: 美国海军陆战队登陆岘港

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Vietnam War
Stanley Karnow, Vietnam: A History (Viking, 1983)
Fredrik Logevall, Embers of War: The Fall of an Empire and the Making of America's Vietnam (Random House, 2012)

summary.en: The Gold Coast became independent as Ghana under Kwame Nkrumah, one of the first sub-Saharan colonies to end European rule. At midnight Nkrumah declared that Ghana’s independence was meaningless unless linked to the total liberation of Africa; Accra became a hub of pan-Africanism.
summary.zh: 黄金海岸在克瓦米·恩克鲁玛领导下独立为加纳，是撒哈拉以南最早摆脱欧洲统治的殖民地之一。午夜时分恩克鲁玛宣告，除非与整个非洲的解放相联系，加纳的独立便毫无意义；阿克拉由此成为泛非主义中心。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Dominion of Ghana
Kwame Nkrumah, Ghana: The Autobiography of Kwame Nkrumah (1957)
Britannica: Ghana: Independence
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. VIII: Africa since 1935 (ed. A. A. Mazrui, 1993)

events.note: QID is the Dominion of Ghana (1957–1960), the state created on independence day.

summary.en: An R-7 rocket launched from the Soviet test range at Tyuratam (later Baikonur) in Kazakhstan put Sputnik 1, the first artificial satellite, into orbit. Its radio beeps, picked up around the world, opened the Space Age and spurred the United States to create NASA.
summary.zh: 一枚R-7火箭从苏联位于哈萨克斯坦秋拉塔姆（后称拜科努尔）的试验场升空，将第一颗人造地球卫星斯普特尼克1号送入轨道。它发出的无线电信号被世界各地接收，开启了太空时代，并促使美国成立国家航空航天局。

sources.title: NASA History: Sputnik and the Origins of the Space Age
Britannica: Sputnik
Wikipedia: Sputnik 1

events.note: Marker at Site 1 ("Gagarin's Start") of the Baikonur Cosmodrome.

summary.en: Belgium, France, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands and West Germany signed treaties in Rome creating the European Economic Community and Euratom. The EEC's common market became the core of what later developed into the European Union.
summary.zh: 比利时、法国、意大利、卢森堡、荷兰和联邦德国在罗马签署条约，建立欧洲经济共同体和欧洲原子能共同体。欧共体的共同市场成为日后欧洲联盟的核心。

sources.title: EUR-Lex: Treaty establishing the European Economic Community (1957)
Britannica: Treaty of Rome

events.note: Signed on the Capitoline Hill (Palazzo dei Conservatori).

summary.en: Seventeen African states, including Nigeria, the Congo and most of French West and Equatorial Africa, gained independence in 1960. In December the UN General Assembly adopted Resolution 1514 declaring colonialism a denial of human rights.
summary.zh: 1960年，包括尼日利亚、刚果以及法属西非和赤道非洲大部在内的十七个非洲国家获得独立。同年12月，联合国大会通过第1514号决议，宣布殖民主义是对基本人权的否定。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Year of Africa

UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. VIII: Africa since 1935 (ed. A. A. Mazrui, 1993)

summary.en: South African police opened fire on a crowd protesting the pass laws at Sharpeville, killing 69 people. The government banned the ANC and PAC, which turned to armed struggle; 21 March is now Human Rights Day in South Africa and the UN day against racial discrimination.
summary.zh: 南非警察向沙佩维尔抗议通行证法的人群开枪，打死69人。政府随即取缔非国大和泛非大，两者转向武装斗争；3月21日现为南非人权日和联合国消除种族歧视国际日。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Sharpeville massacre
Tom Lodge, Sharpeville: An Apartheid Massacre and Its Consequences (2011)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. VIII: Africa since 1935 (ed. A. A. Mazrui, 1993)

summary.en: Days after independence from Belgium, the Congo faced an army mutiny and the Belgian-backed secessions of Katanga and South Kasai. Prime Minister Lumumba was deposed and murdered in 1961; UN intervention, Cold War rivalry and rebellions ended with Mobutu’s coup in 1965.
summary.zh: 刚果脱离比利时独立数日后即遭遇军队哗变，以及比利时支持的加丹加和南开赛分裂。卢蒙巴总理于1961年被推翻并遇害；联合国干预、冷战角力和多次叛乱最终以1965年蒙博托政变告终。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Congo Crisis
Georges Nzongola-Ntalaja, The Congo from Leopold to Kabila: A People’s History (2002)
Ludo De Witte, The Assassination of Lumumba (2001)

events.note: Wikidata ends the crisis in 1966; most accounts close it with Mobutu’s coup of November 1965.

summary.en: Soviet irrigation schemes diverting the Amu Darya and Syr Darya to cotton fields caused the Aral Sea, once the world’s fourth-largest lake, to shrink to a fraction of its size, ruining fisheries and spreading salt dust.
summary.zh: 苏联将阿姆河与锡尔河水引去灌溉棉田，致使曾为世界第四大湖的咸海面积大幅萎缩，渔业崩溃，盐尘四散。

sources.title: Philip Micklin, “The Aral Sea disaster”, Annual Review of Earth and Planetary Sciences 35 (2007)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Aral Sea
Wikidata Q35883

events.note: End year 2014 marks the first complete drying of the eastern basin; the northern Small Aral has partly recovered since the Kokaral dam (2005).

name.zh: 石油输出国组织在巴格达成立

summary.en: At a conference in Baghdad, Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and Venezuela founded the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries to coordinate oil policy. Its power over prices peaked during the oil shocks of the 1970s.
summary.zh: 伊朗、伊拉克、科威特、沙特阿拉伯和委内瑞拉在巴格达会议上成立石油输出国组织，以协调石油政策。其对油价的影响力在1970年代的石油危机中达到顶峰。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: OPEC
D. Yergin, The Prize (1991)
Wikipedia: OPEC

name.zh: 加加林乘东方一号从拜科努尔升空

summary.en: Yuri Gagarin became the first human in space, launched from the Baikonur Cosmodrome on the Kazakh steppe aboard Vostok 1 for a single 108-minute orbit of the Earth.
summary.zh: 尤里·加加林乘东方一号飞船从哈萨克草原上的拜科努尔航天发射场升空，绕地球一周历时108分钟，成为进入太空的第一人。

sources.title: Asif A. Siddiqi, Challenge to Apollo: The Soviet Union and the Space Race (NASA SP-2000-4408, 2000)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Vostok
Wikidata Q182524

summary.en: Thirty-two independent African states signed the OAU Charter in Addis Ababa, hosted by Haile Selassie. The organisation backed liberation movements against colonial and white-minority rule while upholding inherited borders; 25 May is celebrated as Africa Day.
summary.zh: 三十二个独立非洲国家在海尔·塞拉西主持下于亚的斯亚贝巴签署《非洲统一组织宪章》。该组织支持反对殖民和白人少数统治的解放运动，同时维护殖民时期遗留的边界；5月25日被定为“非洲日”。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Organisation of African Unity
Charter of the Organization of African Unity (Addis Ababa, 25 May 1963)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. VIII: Africa since 1935 (ed. A. A. Mazrui, 1993)

name.zh: 第一颗原子弹爆炸成功

summary.en: China detonated its first atomic bomb on a tower at the Lop Nur test site in Xinjiang, becoming the fifth nuclear power.
summary.zh: 中国第一颗原子弹在新疆罗布泊试验场铁塔上爆炸成功，成为第五个拥有核武器的国家。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
Britannica: Lop Nur

summary.en: Nine days before the Tokyo Olympics opened, Japanese National Railways began services on the world's first high-speed railway, between Tokyo and Shin-Ōsaka, at up to 210 km/h. The 'bullet train' cut the journey from about 6.5 to 4 hours and inspired high-speed rail worldwide.
summary.zh: 东京奥运会开幕前九天，日本国有铁道开通了东京至新大阪之间的世界首条高速铁路，最高时速210公里。“子弹列车”将行程由约6个半小时缩短为4小时，并带动了全球高速铁路的发展。

sources.title: Britannica: Shinkansen
Central Japan Railway Company: About the Shinkansen
Wikipedia: Tokaido Shinkansen

events.note: Journey time fell to 4 hours at opening and to 3 hours 10 minutes in November 1965.

summary.en: North Vietnamese torpedo boats clashed with the USS Maddox on 2 August; a second reported attack on 4 August probably never happened. Congress's resulting Gulf of Tonkin Resolution authorised escalation of the war.
summary.zh: 8月2日北越鱼雷艇与美舰“马多克斯”号交火；8月4日所报告的第二次袭击很可能并未发生。随后国会通过《北部湾决议》，授权战争升级。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Gulf of Tonkin incident

summary.en: A shallow earthquake directly beneath Tashkent destroyed much of the old city and left some 300,000 people homeless, though relatively few died; the city was rebuilt as a Soviet showcase capital.
summary.zh: 一次震源极浅的地震发生在塔什干正下方，摧毁了大部分老城，约30万人无家可归，但死亡人数相对较少；该城随后被重建为苏联的样板城市。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Tashkent

summary.en: After massacres of Igbo in the north, the Eastern Region seceded as the Republic of Biafra under Odumegwu Ojukwu. A federal blockade caused mass famine; estimates of deaths, mostly civilian, range from about one to two million before Biafra surrendered in January 1970.
summary.zh: 北方发生针对伊博人的屠杀后，东区在奥朱古领导下宣布独立为比夫拉共和国。联邦封锁造成大饥荒；至1970年1月比夫拉投降，估计约一百万至两百万人死亡，多为平民。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Nigerian Civil War
John de St. Jorre, The Nigerian Civil War (1972)

name.zh: 首例人体心脏移植手术

summary.en: At Groote Schuur Hospital in Cape Town, Christiaan Barnard's team transplanted the heart of a young road-accident victim, Denise Darvall, into Louis Washkansky, who lived for 18 days. The operation made heart transplantation a worldwide clinical goal.
summary.zh: 在开普敦格罗特·舒尔医院，克里斯蒂安·巴纳德的团队将车祸遇难的年轻女子丹妮丝·达瓦尔的心脏移植给路易斯·沃什坎斯基，后者存活了18天。这次手术使心脏移植成为全球医学界追求的临床目标。

sources.title: Britannica: Christiaan Barnard

summary.en: The foreign ministers of Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand signed the Bangkok Declaration, creating the Association of Southeast Asian Nations to promote regional cooperation and stability.
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡和泰国外长签署《曼谷宣言》，成立东南亚国家联盟，以促进区域合作与稳定。

sources.title: The ASEAN Declaration (Bangkok Declaration), 8 August 1967
Nicholas Tarling (ed.), The Cambridge History of Southeast Asia, Vol. 2: The Nineteenth and Twentieth Centuries (1992)
Wikipedia: ASEAN Declaration

summary.en: During the Tết truce, communist forces attacked more than 100 towns across South Vietnam, including the US embassy in Saigon and the old capital Huế. A military failure for the attackers, it was a political turning point that eroded American support for the war.
summary.zh: 在春节休战期间，共产党军队对南越一百多个城镇发动进攻，包括西贡美国大使馆和古都顺化。进攻在军事上失利，却成为政治转折点，削弱了美国国内对战争的支持。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Tet Offensive
Stanley Karnow, Vietnam: A History (Viking, 1983)
Fredrik Logevall, Embers of War: The Fall of an Empire and the Making of America's Vietnam (Random House, 2012)
Wikipedia: Tet Offensive

events.note: Point is a generic location in southern South Vietnam; attacks struck more than 100 towns, notably Saigon and Huế.

summary.en: A severe cyclone drove a storm surge across the low islands and coast of East Pakistan on the night of 12–13 November 1970, killing an estimated 300,000–500,000 people, the deadliest tropical cyclone on record. Anger at the government's slow relief fed the movement that led to Bangladesh's independence.
summary.zh: 1970年11月12日至13日夜，一场强烈气旋引发的风暴潮横扫东巴基斯坦的低洼岛屿和沿海地区，估计造成30万至50万人死亡，是有记录以来最致命的热带气旋。政府救灾迟缓引发的愤怒推动了最终导致孟加拉国独立的运动。

sources.title: Britannica: Ganges-Brahmaputra delta cyclone of 1970
World Meteorological Organization: WMO Weather and Climate Extremes Archive
Wikipedia: 1970 Bhola cyclone

events.note: WMO lists it as the deadliest tropical cyclone on record (about 300,000 deaths); other estimates reach 500,000. Marker at Bhola Island.

summary.en: After Pakistan’s army cracked down in East Pakistan in March 1971, Bengali forces fought for independence; millions fled to India, which intervened in December, and Pakistani forces surrendered at Dhaka on 16 December.
summary.zh: 1971年3月巴基斯坦军队在东巴基斯坦实施镇压后，孟加拉人武装争取独立；数百万难民逃往印度，印度于12月出兵干预，巴军于12月16日在达卡投降。

name.en: Khmer Rouge rule and the Cambodian genocide
name.zh: 红色高棉统治与柬埔寨大屠杀

summary.en: After taking Phnom Penh on 17 April 1975, the Khmer Rouge emptied the cities and forced the population into agrarian labour camps. Execution, starvation and disease killed roughly 1.5–2 million people before Vietnam's invasion ended the regime in January 1979.
summary.zh: 1975年4月17日攻占金边后，红色高棉驱散城市居民，强迫全体民众进入农业劳动营。处决、饥饿和疾病造成约一百五十万至二百万人死亡，直至1979年1月越南出兵推翻该政权。

summary.en: North Vietnamese tanks crashed through the gates of the Independence Palace as the last Americans were evacuated by helicopter. The surrender of South Vietnam ended the war; Saigon was renamed Ho Chi Minh City in 1976.
summary.zh: 北越坦克冲破独立宫大门，最后一批美国人乘直升机撤离。南越投降，战争结束；1976年西贡改名为胡志明市。

summary.zh: 索韦托数千名黑人学生游行反对强制以阿非利卡语授课，警察向他们开枪，赫克托·彼得森等多人遇难。动荡蔓延全国，新一代青年投身解放运动；6月16日现为南非青年节。

summary.zh: 一次存在缺陷的安全测试导致苏联乌克兰切尔诺贝利核电站4号反应堆爆炸，放射性污染扩散至欧洲大部分地区。1986年约11.6万人被疏散，30公里隔离区至今仍在。

summary.en: Amid mass protests and an exodus of East Germans, the GDR's announcement of eased travel rules led crowds to force open the Berlin Wall's checkpoints on the night of 9 November. The event symbolised the end of the Cold War division of Europe and led to German reunification in October 1990.
summary.zh: 在大规模抗议和东德民众出逃潮中，民主德国宣布放宽出行限制，11月9日夜民众涌向柏林墙并迫使检查站开放。这一事件象征着冷战时期欧洲分裂的终结，并促成1990年10月的两德统一。

name.en: World Wide Web invented at CERN
name.zh: 万维网在欧洲核子研究中心诞生

summary.en: At CERN near Geneva, Tim Berners-Lee proposed a hypertext system for sharing information in March 1989 and, with Robert Cailliau, had the first web server and browser running by the end of 1990. Opened to the public in 1991 and released royalty-free in 1993, the Web made the Internet a mass medium.
summary.zh: 1989年3月，蒂姆·伯纳斯-李在日内瓦附近的欧洲核子研究中心提出一种共享信息的超文本系统，并与罗伯特·卡约于1990年底建成第一台网络服务器和浏览器。万维网1991年向公众开放，1993年免版税发布，使互联网成为大众媒介。

summary.en: After reawakening in April, Pinatubo on Luzon produced the second-largest eruption of the 20th century on 15 June 1991, as a typhoon passed. Forecasts by Philippine and US volcanologists allowed mass evacuations that saved thousands of lives; the sulphur cloud cooled the globe by about 0.5 °C.
summary.zh: 皮纳图博火山于4月重新活跃，1991年6月15日在台风过境时发生20世纪第二大规模的喷发。菲律宾和美国火山学家的预报促成了大规模疏散，挽救了数以千计的生命；喷出的硫化物云使全球气温下降约0.5°C。

summary.en: A Jewish teacher from Galilee whose preaching and reported healings drew followers in Roman-ruled Judaea and Galilee. He was crucified in Jerusalem under the prefect Pontius Pilate; his followers proclaimed his resurrection, and Christians venerate him as the Messiah and Son of God.
summary.zh: 来自加利利的犹太导师，其传道和所传的医治神迹在罗马治下的犹地亚和加利利吸引了众多追随者。他在总督本丢·彼拉多治下于耶路撒冷被钉十字架；门徒宣告他复活，基督徒尊他为弥赛亚和神之子。

label.zh: 伯利恒（据福音书所载出生地）

summary.en: A Greek-speaking Jew from Tarsus who persecuted the early followers of Jesus until a vision on the road to Damascus. He became the most influential missionary of early Christianity, founding churches across Anatolia and Greece; his letters form much of the New Testament.
summary.zh: 出身塔尔苏斯、讲希腊语的犹太人，曾迫害耶稣早期追随者，直到在前往大马士革途中见到异象。他成为早期基督教最具影响力的传教士，在安纳托利亚和希腊建立众多教会，其书信构成《新约》的重要部分。

summary.zh: 贵霜帝国最伟大的君主，以布路沙布逻（白沙瓦）为都，统治从阿姆河到恒河的广大地域。他护持佛教，传说与第四次佛经结集以及犍陀罗、秣菟罗艺术相关。

summary.zh: 刘备的结义兄弟，以忠义著称。镇守荆州，219年水淹七军威震华夏，旋因东吴袭取江陵败走麦城被杀；后世尊为“武圣”。

summary.zh: 汉室宗亲，织席贩履出身，与关羽、张飞、诸葛亮相辅，历经颠沛据有荆益，221年于成都称帝建蜀汉。

summary.en: Son of Ardashir I and second Sasanian shah. He defeated three Roman emperors—Gordian III, Philip the Arab and Valerian, whom he captured at Edessa—and recorded his deeds at Naqsh-e Rostam. He tolerated religious diversity and gave early support to the prophet Mani.
summary.zh: 阿尔达希尔一世之子，萨珊王朝第二代君主。他先后战胜三位罗马皇帝——戈尔迪安三世、阿拉伯人菲利普和在埃德萨被俘的瓦勒良，并在纳克什-鲁斯塔姆铭刻功业。他宽容多元宗教，曾支持先知摩尼。

summary.en: Widow of Odaenathus, she ruled Palmyra as regent for her son Vaballathus and, as Roman power faltered, seized Egypt and much of the eastern Roman Empire. Emperor Aurelian defeated her armies at Antioch and Emesa in 272 and took her captive.
summary.zh: 奥登纳图斯的遗孀，以儿子瓦巴拉图斯摄政的身份统治帕尔米拉，并趁罗马衰弱夺取埃及和东部大片领土。272年奥勒良皇帝在安条克和埃梅萨击败其军队并将她俘虏。

summary.en: Proclaimed emperor by the army at York in 306, Constantine won the West at the Milvian Bridge in 312 and the whole empire in 324. He legalised and favoured Christianity, convened the Council of Nicaea and founded Constantinople.
summary.zh: 君士坦丁306年在约克被军队拥立为皇帝，312年在米尔维安桥战役中夺得西部，324年统一整个帝国。他使基督教合法化并予以扶持，召开尼西亚公会议，并建立君士坦丁堡。

label.zh: 在埃博拉库姆（约克）被拥立为帝

summary.en: Ezana ruled Aksum at its height and became the first sub-Saharan monarch known to adopt Christianity. Trilingual inscriptions in Geʿez, Sabaean and Greek record his campaigns, including one against the Noba near Meroë. His birth and death years are unrecorded; the years shown are placeholders.
summary.zh: 埃扎纳在阿克苏姆鼎盛时期执政，是已知最早皈依基督教的撒哈拉以南君主。其吉兹语、萨巴语和希腊语三语铭文记载了他的征战，包括在麦罗埃附近对诺巴人的远征。其生卒年不见记载，此处所示年份仅为占位估计。

summary.en: In 399, already in his sixties, Faxian left Chang'an to seek complete monastic rules in India. He crossed the Taklamakan and the Pamirs, studied in the Ganges valley and Sri Lanka, and returned by sea via Java in 412; his Record of Buddhist Kingdoms is a key source for Gupta India.
summary.zh: 399年，年逾六旬的法显从长安出发赴天竺寻求完整戒律。他穿越塔克拉玛干沙漠和葱岭，在恒河流域和师子国（斯里兰卡）求学，412年经耶婆提由海路回国；其《佛国记》是研究笈多时代印度的重要史料。

summary.zh: 旃陀罗笈多二世击败西部总督（西萨特拉普），将笈多统治扩展至西印度；其在位时期被视为古典梵语文化的鼎盛期，中国僧人法显曾游历其境。

summary.en: Born to a Berber family in Roman Numidia, Augustine taught rhetoric in Carthage, Rome and Milan before his conversion. As bishop of Hippo for 35 years he wrote the Confessions and The City of God, shaping Western Christian thought; he died as the Vandals besieged his city.
summary.zh: 奥古斯丁出生于罗马努米底亚的柏柏尔家庭，曾在迦太基、罗马和米兰教授修辞学，后皈依基督教。他任希波主教35年，著有《忏悔录》和《上帝之城》，深刻影响西方基督教思想；在汪达尔人围城期间去世。

label.en: Imperial rhetor in Milan; baptised by Ambrose (387)
label.zh: 任米兰宫廷修辞学教师；387年受安布罗斯施洗

label.zh: 返回塔加斯特，建立修道团体

summary.en: Born in Basra, Ibn al-Haytham moved to Fatimid Cairo, where his Book of Optics combined mathematics with experiment to explain vision, reflection and refraction. summary.en: After expelling the Cham who had sacked Angkor in 1177, he was crowned in 1181 and became the greatest builder of the Khmer Empire: Angkor Thom, the Bayon, Ta Prohm, roads, rest houses and 102 hospitals. A devout Mahayana Buddhist, he also conquered Champa.
summary.zh: 1177年占婆攻陷吴哥后，他驱逐占婆军队，1181年加冕，成为高棉帝国最伟大的营建者：修建吴哥城、巴戎寺、塔布茏寺以及道路、驿站和一百零二所医院。他笃信大乘佛教，并征服了占婆。

summary.en: A Kurdish commander born in Tikrit who rose in Zengid service, became vizier of Fatimid Egypt and then united Egypt and Syria under his rule. He destroyed the crusader army at Hattin in 1187 and retook Jerusalem, then held the Third Crusade to a negotiated truce.
summary.zh: 生于提克里特的库尔德将领，在赞吉王朝效力中崛起，任法蒂玛埃及的维齐尔，后将埃及和叙利亚统一于自己治下。1187年在哈丁歼灭十字军并收复耶路撒冷，又迫使第三次十字军以和约收场。

summary.en: Temüjin rose from an outcast childhood to unite the steppe tribes in 1206, reorganised them into decimal military units under a law code, and launched conquests of the Jin, Western Xia and Khwarazm that began the largest contiguous land empire in history.
summary.zh: 铁木真幼年孤苦，后于1206年统一草原诸部，以十进制军事组织和札撒法令加以整编，并发动对金、西夏和花剌子模的征服，开创了历史上疆域最大的连续陆地帝国。
