summary.en: Korea's last dynasty, founded by Yi Seong-gye and ruling for five centuries. A Neo-Confucian state with a literati bureaucracy, it created Hangul, survived the Japanese and Manchu invasions, and was opened by unequal treaties before becoming the Korean Empire in 1897.
summary.zh: 由李成桂建立，是朝鲜半岛最后一个王朝，延续五百余年。以性理学立国、实行两班文官统治，创制了训民正音，历经壬辰倭乱与丙子胡乱，近代被迫签订不平等条约，1897年改称大韩帝国。

summary.en: A centralised kingdom south of the lower Congo River, Kongo adopted Catholicism after contact with Portugal in 1483 and exchanged ambassadors with Lisbon and the Vatican. The Atlantic slave trade and defeat at Mbwila in 1665 brought civil war; it became a Portuguese vassal in the later 19th century, and Portugal abolished the titular monarchy in 1914.
summary.zh: 刚果王国是刚果河下游以南的中央集权王国，1483年与葡萄牙接触后接受天主教，并与里斯本和梵蒂冈互派使节。大西洋奴隶贸易及1665年姆布维拉之败导致内战；19世纪后期沦为葡萄牙附庸，1914年葡萄牙废除其名义上的王位。

summary.zh: 迈索尔原为毗奢耶那伽罗属下的沃迪亚尔王国，在海德尔·阿里和蒂普苏丹时期成为军事强国；1799年后复辟的沃迪亚尔王室以土邦形式统治，直至并入印度。

summary.en: A Yoruba empire of the savanna north of the forest, Oyo built its power on cavalry and the trade between the coast and the Niger, holding Dahomey tributary for much of the 18th century. Internal revolt and the Sokoto jihad caused the abandonment of Oyo-Ile around 1835; a successor state survived at New Oyo.
summary.zh: 奥约是森林以北稀树草原上的约鲁巴帝国，以骑兵和沿海与尼日尔河之间的贸易为基础，18世纪大部分时间使达荷美纳贡。内乱与索科托圣战导致约1835年放弃奥约-伊莱，继承国在新奥约延续。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Oyo Empire
Robin Law, The Oyo Empire c. 1600–c. 1836 (1977)
Samuel Johnson, The History of the Yorubas (1921)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. V: Africa from the Sixteenth to the Eighteenth Century (ed. B. A. Ogot, 1992)

polities.note: Origins are traditional; Wikidata ends the polity in 1905, after British conquest. Capital coordinates mark the Oyo-Ile (Old Oyo) ruins in Old Oyo National Park; Wikidata’s Oyo-Ile coordinates fall at modern Oyo town.

image.file: Palace of Alaafin of Oyo circa mid-1900s.jpg

summary.en: A Malay maritime state that grew from Parameswara's settlement into the dominant entrepôt of the Straits. Its rulers adopted Islam, received Zheng He's fleets, and set the model of Malay kingship before the Portuguese conquest of 1511.
summary.zh: 由拜里米苏拉的聚落发展而来的马来海上国家，成为海峡地区首要的转口贸易港。其君主皈依伊斯兰教，接待郑和船队，奠定了马来王权的典范，1511年被葡萄牙征服。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Malacca Sultanate
Sejarah Melayu (Malay Annals), trans. C. C. Brown (1952)
Tomé Pires, Suma Oriental (1512–1515), trans. Armando Cortesão (Hakluyt Society, 1944)
Barbara Watson Andaya & Leonard Y. Andaya, A History of Malaysia (Palgrave, 3rd ed. 2017)
Wikipedia: Malacca Sultanate

capital.zh: 达卡尔，后为哈勒尔（1520年起）

summary.en: A Muslim sultanate of the Horn of Africa, heir to Ifat, based in the Harar plateau and the Zeila trade route. Under Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim it nearly conquered Christian Ethiopia (1529–1543); weakened by war and Oromo migrations, it moved to Aussa in 1577.
summary.zh: 阿达尔是非洲之角的穆斯林苏丹国，继承伊法特，以哈勒尔高原和泽拉商路为根基。在伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣领导下几乎征服基督教埃塞俄比亚（1529–1543）；因战争和奥罗莫人迁徙而衰弱，1577年迁往奥萨。

name.zh: 伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐

sources.title: Wikipedia: Adal Sultanate
Shihab al-Din ʿArab Faqih, Futuh al-Habasha (c. 1559)
Richard Pankhurst, The Ethiopians: A History (1998)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. IV: Africa from the Twelfth to the Sixteenth Century (ed. D. T. Niane, 1984)

polities.note: Capital coordinates are those of Harar; Wikidata places the sultanate further north-west.

summary.en: Founded by Lê Lợi after expelling the Ming, it reached its height under Lê Thánh Tông, who conquered Vijaya in 1471 and issued the Hồng Đức code. Later the Lê emperors were figureheads under the Mạc, Trịnh and Nguyễn lords until the Tây Sơn ended the dynasty.
summary.zh: 黎利驱逐明军后建立的王朝，在黎圣宗时期臻于鼎盛：1471年攻取毗阇耶，颁布《洪德法典》。后期黎帝成为莫氏、郑主和阮主控制下的傀儡，最终被西山朝终结。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Later Lê dynasty
Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư (Complete Annals of Đại Việt, 1479; 1697 ed.)
Keith W. Taylor, A History of the Vietnamese (Cambridge University Press, 2013)
Wikipedia: Later Lê dynasty early period

polities.note: Interrupted by the Mạc dynasty (1527–1533/92); the restored Lê (1533–1789) were largely nominal rulers.

image.file: Map of Later Lê dynasty during the reign of Lê Thánh Tông (1460-1497).png

capital.en: Zvongombe and later sites in the Dande and Mount Fura area
capital.zh: 兹冯贡贝及丹德—富拉山一带的后续王都

summary.en: Founded by Nyatsimba Mutota, the Mutapa state dominated the northern Zimbabwe plateau and Zambezi trade. The Portuguese, who called it Monomotapa, sought its gold; after defeat in 1629 the mwenemutapa became a Portuguese vassal, and the kingdom gradually lost ground to the Rozvi.
summary.zh: 穆塔帕王国由尼亚特辛巴·穆托塔创建，主宰津巴布韦高原北部和赞比西河贸易。葡萄牙人称之为“莫诺莫塔帕”并觊觎其黄金；1629年战败后穆塔帕王沦为葡萄牙附庸，王国逐渐让位于罗兹维。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Mutapa Empire
S. I. G. Mudenge, A Political History of Munhumutapa c. 1400–1902 (1988)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. V: Africa from the Sixteenth to the Eighteenth Century (ed. B. A. Ogot, 1992)

polities.note: Capital sites shifted; coordinates mark the Mount Fura (Mount Darwin) area approximately. Wikidata’s coordinates fall at Great Zimbabwe.

summary.en: From Gao on the Niger, Sonni Ali conquered Timbuktu and Djenné, and the Askia dynasty built the largest empire in West African history, with a professional army, river fleet and provincial governors. It collapsed after the Moroccan victory at Tondibi.
summary.zh: 索尼·阿里以尼日尔河畔的加奥为中心征服廷巴克图与杰内，阿斯基亚王朝建立了西非历史上最大的帝国，拥有职业军队、河上舰队和行省总督。汤迪比之战摩洛哥获胜后帝国崩溃。

name.zh: 阿斯基亚·穆罕默德一世
阿斯基亚·伊斯哈格二世

sources.title: Wikipedia: Songhai Empire
al-Sa'di, Tarikh al-Sudan (c. 1655), trans. J. O. Hunwick, Timbuktu and the Songhay Empire (2003)
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Tomb of Askia
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. IV: Africa from the Twelfth to the Sixteenth Century (ed. D. T. Niane, 1984)

summary.en: Founded by Kerei and Janibek, the khanate united the Kazakh nomads, later divided into the Great, Middle and Little Hordes, fought long wars with the Dzungars, and was gradually absorbed by Russia, which abolished the last khans by the 1840s.
summary.zh: 哈萨克汗国由克烈与贾尼别克建立，统一了哈萨克游牧部落，后分为大、中、小三个玉兹，与准噶尔长期交战，逐渐被俄国吞并，至19世纪40年代末代可汗被废。

sources.title: Martha Brill Olcott, The Kazakhs, 2nd ed. (1995)
Mirza Muhammad Haidar Dughlat, Tarikh-i Rashidi
Wikidata Q1433867

polities.note: Early khans’ reign dates are approximate. The end date 1847 (Wikidata) marks the death of Kenesary Khan.

summary.en: Established by Muhammad Shaybani’s Uzbeks on the ruins of the Timurid state, the khanate was ruled by Shaybanid and then Janid (Ashtarkhanid) khans, flourishing under Abdullah Khan II before declining into rule by Manghit atalyqs.
summary.zh: 布哈拉汗国由穆罕默德·昔班尼率领的乌兹别克人在帖木儿国家废墟上建立，先后由昔班尼王朝与札尼王朝（阿斯特拉罕王朝）统治，在阿卜杜拉汗二世时繁荣，后衰落并由曼吉特部的阿塔雷克掌权。

sources.title: R. D. McChesney, “Central Asia vi. In the 16th–18th centuries”, Encyclopaedia Iranica
History of Civilizations of Central Asia, vol. V (UNESCO)
Wikidata Q577668

capital.zh: 大不里士、加兹温，1598年起为伊斯法罕

summary.en: Founded by Shah Ismail I from a Sufi order of Ardabil, the Safavid state made Twelver Shi'ism Iran's official religion and fought the Ottomans for two centuries. It peaked under Abbas I at Isfahan; the Afghan capture of Isfahan in 1722 ended effective Safavid rule.
summary.zh: 由阿尔达比勒苏非教团出身的伊斯玛仪一世建立，萨法维王朝定十二伊玛目什叶派为伊朗国教，与奥斯曼争战两百年。阿拔斯一世在伊斯法罕时达到鼎盛；1722年阿富汗人攻陷伊斯法罕，萨法维的实际统治告终。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Safavid dynasty
Encyclopaedia Iranica: Safavids
Wikipedia: Safavid Iran

polities.note: Nominal Safavid shahs reigned under Nader's control until 1736.

summary.en: Rising from the small principality of Toungoo, Tabinshwehti and Bayinnaung reunited Burma and built a vast but short-lived empire. A restored Toungoo state ruled from Ava until Mon rebels sacked it in 1752.
summary.zh: 东吁王朝从小邦东吁崛起，莽瑞体与莽应龙重新统一缅甸，建立了庞大但短暂的帝国。复兴后的东吁王朝以阿瓦为都，直至1752年被孟族起义军攻破。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Toungoo dynasty
Victor Lieberman, Strange Parallels: Southeast Asia in Global Context, c. 800–1830, Vol. 1 (Cambridge University Press, 2003)
Hmannan Yazawin (Glass Palace Chronicle, 1832)
Wikipedia: Toungoo dynasty

polities.note: Start date disputed: Wikidata and Britannica date the dynasty from Mingyinyo's accession at Toungoo (1485/86; Britannica also allows 1531, Tabinshwehti's accession); 1510 marks Toungoo's break with Ava.

summary.en: Under the Spanish Habsburgs, from Charles I (Emperor Charles V) to Charles II, the Spanish monarchy ruled Castile and Aragon, much of Italy, the Low Countries and a vast American empire, and Portugal from 1580 to 1640. Its silver-financed hegemony faded in the 17th century, and Charles II's childless death led to the War of the Spanish Succession.
summary.zh: 在西班牙哈布斯堡王朝治下（从查理一世即查理五世皇帝到卡洛斯二世），西班牙君主国统治卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡、意大利大部、尼德兰以及广袤的美洲帝国，1580至1640年间还兼领葡萄牙。依靠美洲白银支撑的霸权在17世纪逐渐衰落，卡洛斯二世无嗣而终，引发了西班牙王位继承战争。

name.zh: 卡洛斯一世（即查理五世）

sources.title: J. H. Elliott, Imperial Spain, 1469–1716 (1963)
Britannica: Spain – History

name.zh: 哈布斯堡君主国（奥地利）

summary.en: The union of the Austrian, Bohemian and Hungarian crowns under the House of Habsburg began in 1526, when Ferdinand I inherited Bohemia and Hungary after the Battle of Mohács. Proclaimed the Austrian Empire in 1804 and reorganised as Austria-Hungary in 1867, the multinational monarchy broke apart at the end of the First World War.
summary.zh: 1526年莫哈奇战役后斐迪南一世继承波希米亚和匈牙利王位，奥地利、波希米亚、匈牙利诸王冠由此在哈布斯堡家族治下联合。1804年改称奥地利帝国，1867年重组为奥匈帝国，这个多民族君主国在第一次世界大战结束时解体。

sources.title: Pieter M. Judson, The Habsburg Empire: A New History (2016)
Britannica: House of Habsburg

polities.note: Wikidata's description spans 1282–1918 for Habsburg rule in Austria; its start date (1526) marks the composite monarchy used here.

capital.zh: 阿格拉；法塔赫布尔西格里；拉合尔；德里（沙贾汉纳巴德）

summary.en: Founded by the Timurid Babur, the Mughal Empire ruled most of South Asia by 1700, combining Persianate court culture with a vast revenue system; after Aurangzeb it fragmented, and the British deposed the last emperor in 1857.
summary.zh: 莫卧儿帝国由帖木儿后裔巴布尔创建，至1700年已统治南亚大部，融合波斯化宫廷文化与庞大的税收体系；奥朗则布之后帝国分崩离析，1857年英国废黜末代皇帝。

sources.title: John F. Richards, The Mughal Empire (New Cambridge History of India I.5, 1993)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Mughal dynasty
Wikidata Q33296

polities.note: Humayun was in exile 1540–1555 during the Sur interregnum.

image.artist: TRAJAN 117 This bitmap image was created with Windows Paint.

capital.zh: 莫斯科（1712年起为圣彼得堡）

summary.en: Beginning with Ivan IV's coronation as tsar, Muscovite Russia conquered Kazan and Astrakhan and expanded across Siberia. After the Time of Troubles the Romanov dynasty took the throne in 1613; Peter I transformed the state and proclaimed it the Russian Empire in 1721.
summary.zh: 自伊凡四世加冕为沙皇起，俄罗斯沙皇国征服喀山和阿斯特拉罕，并向西伯利亚全境扩张。“混乱时期”之后，罗曼诺夫王朝于1613年登上王位；彼得一世全面改造国家，并于1721年宣布其为俄罗斯帝国。

sources.title: Paul Bushkovitch, A Concise History of Russia (2011)
Britannica: Russia – History

summary.en: A sharifian dynasty from the Draa valley that led resistance to the Portuguese, the Saadis kept Morocco independent of the Ottomans. After Alcácer Quibir, Ahmad al-Mansur used ransom and sugar wealth to build the el-Badi palace and conquer Songhai.
summary.zh: 萨阿德王朝是来自德拉河谷的谢里夫王朝，领导抵抗葡萄牙人，使摩洛哥免于奥斯曼统治。阿尔卡塞尔基比尔战役后，艾哈迈德·曼苏尔凭借赎金和蔗糖财富修建巴迪宫并征服桑海。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Saadi Sultanate
Mercedes García-Arenal, Ahmad al-Mansur: The Beginnings of Modern Morocco (2009)
Britannica: Saʿdī dynasty

summary.en: Created by the Union of Lublin, the Commonwealth was an elective monarchy in which a powerful noble parliament, the Sejm, limited royal power. Once among Europe's largest states and known for religious tolerance, it was weakened by wars and the liberum veto and partitioned out of existence by Russia, Prussia and Austria in 1772–1795.
summary.zh: 波兰—立陶宛联邦依《卢布林联合》建立，实行选举君主制，强大的贵族议会（瑟姆）限制王权。它一度是欧洲面积最大的国家之一，并以宗教宽容著称，后因战争和“自由否决权”而衰弱，1772至1795年间被俄、普、奥三国瓜分殆尽。

name.zh: 齐格蒙特二世·奥古斯特
斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基

sources.title: Norman Davies, God's Playground: A History of Poland, vol. 1 (1981)
Britannica: Poland – History

image.file: Potęga Rzeczypospolitej u zenitu. Złota wolność. Elekcja R.P. 1573.jpg

capital.zh: 哥打格德，后迁卡尔塔苏拉

summary.en: The last great Javanese kingdom before Dutch dominance. Sultan Agung conquered most of Java and twice besieged Batavia (1628–29); later succession wars drew in the VOC, and the 1755 Treaty of Giyanti split it into Yogyakarta and Surakarta.
summary.zh: 荷兰称霸前爪哇最后一个强大王国。苏丹阿贡征服爪哇大部，并两度围攻巴达维亚（1628—1629年）；此后的王位继承战争引来荷兰东印度公司介入，1755年《吉扬蒂条约》将其分裂为日惹与梭罗。

sources.title: M. C. Ricklefs, A History of Modern Indonesia since c. 1200 (Palgrave, 4th ed. 2008)
Nicholas Tarling (ed.), The Cambridge History of Southeast Asia, Vol. 1: From Early Times to c. 1800 (1992)
Wikipedia: Mataram Sultanate

summary.en: A Fon kingdom on the Abomey plateau, Dahomey conquered the coastal ports of Allada and Ouidah in the 1720s and became a major participant in the Atlantic slave trade. It was renowned for its centralised administration and its female soldiers, and fell to France in 1892–94.
summary.zh: 达荷美是阿波美高原上的丰族王国，18世纪20年代征服沿海港口阿拉达和维达，成为大西洋奴隶贸易的重要参与者。它以中央集权的行政和女兵著称，1892–94年被法国征服。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Dahomey
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Royal Palaces of Abomey
Edna G. Bay, Wives of the Leopard: Gender, Politics, and Culture in the Kingdom of Dahomey (1998)
Robin Law, Ouidah: The Social History of a West African Slaving “Port”, 1727–1892 (2004)

polities.note: Foundation date approximate (early 17th century).

summary.en: The military government founded by Tokugawa Ieyasu that gave Japan some 250 years of peace through a balance between the shogun and some 260 domains, strict status order and controlled foreign relations, until it returned power to the emperor in 1867.
summary.zh: 德川家康建立的武家政权，通过将军与约二百六十个藩的平衡、严格的身份秩序以及受控的对外关系，使日本维持了约二百五十年的和平，1867年大政奉还天皇。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Tokugawa shogunate
The Cambridge History of Japan, Vol. 4: Early Modern Japan (1991)
Conrad Totman, A History of Japan (Blackwell, 2nd ed. 2005)
Wikipedia: Tokugawa shogunate

summary.en: The last great nomadic empire, the Oirat Dzungar state dominated the Ili valley, Tarim basin and Kazakh steppe, contested Tibet and Khalkha with the Qing, and was annihilated by Qing armies in 1755–1758.
summary.zh: 准噶尔汗国是最后一个强大的游牧帝国，卫拉特准噶尔部称雄伊犁河谷、塔里木盆地和哈萨克草原，与清朝争夺西藏和喀尔喀，1755—1758年被清军彻底消灭。

name.zh: 阿睦尔撒纳（反清自立者）

sources.title: Peter C. Perdue, China Marches West: The Qing Conquest of Central Eurasia (2005)
Thomas J. Barfield, The Perilous Frontier: Nomadic Empires and China (1989)
Wikidata Q1923401

summary.en: Manchu dynasty proclaimed by Hong Taiji in 1636 as successor to Nurhaci's Later Jin. It entered Beijing in 1644, expanded to Xinjiang, Tibet and Taiwan under Kangxi and Qianlong, then faced Western wars and rebellion until the 1911 revolution.
summary.zh: 皇太极1636年改后金为大清，1644年入关定都北京。康雍乾时期版图扩至新疆、西藏与台湾，近代屡遭列强侵略与内乱，1912年清帝退位。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
赵尔巽等《清史稿》卷1–25 本纪
Britannica: Qing dynasty

polities.note: The dynastic name Qing dates from 1636 (Hong Taiji), which Wikidata uses; Jiangshan-map's Qing period begins with the entry into Beijing in 1644.

summary.en: An Akan confederacy united around the Golden Stool under Osei Tutu, Asante became the dominant power of the forest zone of modern Ghana, trading gold, kola and captives. It fought a series of wars with Britain from 1824 to 1900 before annexation.
summary.zh: 阿散蒂是在奥塞·图图领导下以金凳子为核心联合起来的阿坎联盟，成为今加纳森林地带的霸主，从事黄金、可乐果与俘虏贸易。1824年至1900年间与英国多次交战，最终被吞并。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Asante Empire
Ivor Wilks, Asante in the Nineteenth Century (1975)
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Asante Traditional Buildings
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. V: Africa from the Sixteenth to the Eighteenth Century (ed. B. A. Ogot, 1992)

polities.note: Dates follow Wikidata (c. 1670 union; formal annexation 1902); independence from Denkyira dates from 1701. Osei Tutu’s accession date is uncertain (c. 1680–1695). Capital coordinates are Kumasi.

capital.zh: 赖格尔；萨塔拉；浦那（佩什瓦）

summary.en: From Shivaji’s hill-fort kingdom the Marathas expanded under the Peshwas into a confederacy dominating much of India in the 18th century; checked at Panipat in 1761, they recovered, but defeat in the Anglo-Maratha wars ended their power in 1818.
summary.zh: 马拉塔人从希瓦吉的山堡王国起家，在佩什瓦领导下扩张为18世纪称雄印度大部的联盟；1761年帕尼帕特之败使其受挫，此后虽有恢复，但英马战争的失败使其势力于1818年终结。

name.zh: 马达夫拉奥一世（佩什瓦）

sources.title: Stewart Gordon, The Marathas 1600–1818 (New Cambridge History of India II.4, 1993)
Encyclopaedia Britannica: Maratha confederacy
Wikidata Q83618

summary.en: Elector Frederick III of Brandenburg crowned himself King Frederick I in Prussia at Königsberg in 1701. Built on a strong army and bureaucracy, Prussia rose to great-power status under Frederick the Great and, under Wilhelm I and Bismarck, unified Germany in 1871; the monarchy ended in the revolution of 1918.
summary.zh: 1701年勃兰登堡选帝侯腓特烈三世在柯尼斯堡加冕为“在普鲁士的国王”腓特烈一世。普鲁士依靠强大的军队和官僚体系，在腓特烈大王治下跻身列强，又在威廉一世和俾斯麦领导下于1871年统一德意志；1918年革命终结了君主制。

name.zh: 腓特烈二世（腓特烈大王）

sources.title: Christopher Clark, Iron Kingdom: The Rise and Downfall of Prussia, 1600–1947 (2006)
Britannica: Prussia

summary.en: Created by the Acts of Union between England and Scotland in 1707, Great Britain became Europe's leading naval and commercial power, winning the Seven Years' War but losing thirteen American colonies. It merged with the Kingdom of Ireland on 1 January 1801.
summary.zh: 1707年英格兰与苏格兰依《联合法令》合并为大不列颠王国，成为欧洲首屈一指的海上和商业强国，赢得七年战争，却失去了北美十三殖民地。1801年1月1日它与爱尔兰王国合并。

sources.title: Union with Scotland Act 1706 / Union with England Act 1707
Britannica: United Kingdom

summary.en: Proclaimed by Peter the Great after victory over Sweden, the Russian Empire stretched from the Baltic and Black Sea to the Pacific and Alaska. It defeated Napoleon, abolished serfdom in 1861 and industrialised late; strained by the First World War, the monarchy fell in the February Revolution of 1917.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯帝国由彼得大帝在战胜瑞典后宣布建立，疆域从波罗的海和黑海延伸至太平洋和阿拉斯加。它击败拿破仑，1861年废除农奴制，工业化起步较晚；第一次世界大战使其不堪重负，君主制在1917年二月革命中被推翻。

sources.title: Dominic Lieven (ed.), The Cambridge History of Russia, vol. 2: Imperial Russia, 1689–1917 (2006)
Britannica: Russia – History

summary.en: Dynasty founded by Nader Shah, a Turkmen of the Afshar tribe who expelled the Afghans and Ottomans and was crowned on the Mughan plain in 1736. His campaigns reached Delhi, but after his assassination in 1747 the realm fragmented and his successors held only Khorasan until 1796.
summary.zh: 阿夫沙尔部落的土库曼人纳迪尔沙驱逐阿富汗人和奥斯曼人，1736年在穆甘草原加冕，建立此王朝。其征战远及德里，但1747年他遇刺后国家分裂，继承者仅保有呼罗珊至1796年。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica: Nader Shah
M. Axworthy, The Sword of Persia (2006)
Wikipedia: Afsharid dynasty

polities.note: Shahrukh's rule over Khorasan was interrupted and largely nominal.

capital.zh: 曼德勒（1857年起）；此前为阿瓦、阿摩罗补罗

summary.en: Founded by Alaungpaya, the last Burmese dynasty destroyed Ayutthaya, repelled Qing invasions and expanded into Arakan, Manipur and Assam, before losing three wars to Britain; Thibaw was deposed in 1885.
summary.zh: 由雍籍牙建立的缅甸末代王朝。它摧毁阿瑜陀耶、击退清军入侵，并向若开、曼尼普尔与阿萨姆扩张，后在三次英缅战争中战败，1885年锡袍王被废黜。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Konbaung dynasty
Victor Lieberman, Strange Parallels: Southeast Asia in Global Context, c. 800–1830, Vol. 1 (Cambridge University Press, 2003)
G. E. Harvey, History of Burma (Longmans, 1925)
Wikipedia: Konbaung dynasty

name.zh: 拉达那哥欣王朝（暹罗曼谷王朝）

summary.en: The Chakri kingdom founded by Rama I at Bangkok. Mongkut and Chulalongkorn modernised the state and ceded border territories, keeping Siam the only Southeast Asian country never colonised, until the 1932 revolution ended absolute monarchy.
summary.zh: 拉玛一世在曼谷建立的却克里王朝。蒙固王与朱拉隆功推行现代化改革并割让部分边地，使暹罗成为东南亚唯一未被殖民的国家，直至1932年革命结束君主专制。

sources.title: Chris Baker & Pasuk Phongpaichit, A History of Thailand (Cambridge University Press, 2nd ed. 2009)
David K. Wyatt, Thailand: A Short History (Yale University Press, 2nd ed. 2003)

polities.note: Prajadhipok reigned until 1935; his entry is truncated at the end of absolute monarchy.

summary.en: The Manghit dynasty took the title of emir in 1785; Bukhara became a Russian protectorate in 1868 after losing Samarkand, and the Red Army overthrew the last emir, Alim Khan, in 1920.
summary.zh: 曼吉特王朝于1785年改称埃米尔；1868年失去撒马尔罕后布哈拉成为俄国保护国，1920年红军推翻末代埃米尔阿利姆汗。

sources.title: Seymour Becker, Russia’s Protectorates in Central Asia: Bukhara and Khiva, 1865–1924 (1968)

summary.en: Turkmen dynasty founded by Agha Mohammad Khan, who made Tehran the capital and reunified Iran. In the 19th century it lost the Caucasus to Russia and faced growing British and Russian influence; the Constitutional Revolution limited royal power, and Reza Khan deposed the last shah in 1925.
summary.zh: 阿迦·穆罕默德汗建立的土库曼王朝，定都德黑兰并重新统一伊朗。19世纪将高加索领土割让给俄国，并受到英俄日益加深的影响；立宪革命限制了王权，1925年礼萨汗废黜末代国王。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Qajar dynasty
A. Amanat, Iran: A Modern History (2017)
Wikipedia: Qajar Iran

polities.note: Agha Mohammad Khan dominated Iran from 1789 but was crowned only in 1796.

summary.en: Ranjit Singh unified the Sikh misls into a Punjab state stretching from the Khyber Pass to Kashmir; after his death succession struggles weakened it, and two wars with the British ended in annexation in 1849.
summary.zh: 兰吉特·辛格将锡克各米斯尔统一为从开伯尔山口延伸至克什米尔的旁遮普国家；他死后王位之争削弱了国力，与英国的两次战争后于1849年被吞并。

sources.title: J. S. Grewal, The Sikhs of the Punjab (New Cambridge History of India II.3, 1990)

summary.en: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland, formed in 1801, led the Industrial Revolution and ruled the largest empire in history. After most of Ireland left in 1922 it became the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, fought on the winning side in both world wars and decolonised after 1945.
summary.zh: 1801年成立的大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国引领工业革命，统治了史上最庞大的帝国。1922年爱尔兰大部分地区独立后，它改称大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国，两次世界大战均属战胜方，1945年后逐步去殖民化。

sources.title: Union with Ireland Act 1800

summary.en: Founded by Gia Long after defeating the Tây Sơn, it ruled a unified Vietnam from Huế and named the country Việt Nam. France conquered it between 1858 and 1885, after which the emperors reigned under French protection until Bảo Đại abdicated in 1945.
summary.zh: 嘉隆帝击败西山朝后建立的王朝，以顺化为都统治统一的越南，并定国号“越南”。1858至1885年间被法国征服，此后皇帝在法国保护下名义在位，直至1945年保大帝退位。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Nguyễn dynasty

summary.en: Created by Usman dan Fodio’s jihad, the caliphate federated some thirty emirates across northern Nigeria and neighbouring lands under the sultan at Sokoto and the emir of Gwandu. It fostered extensive Islamic scholarship, including the writings of Nana Asmaʾu, before British conquest in 1903.
summary.zh: 索科托哈里发国由奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥的圣战建立，在索科托苏丹和关杜埃米尔之下联合尼日利亚北部及邻近地区约三十个酋长国。它孕育了丰富的伊斯兰学术，包括纳娜·阿斯玛的著作，1903年被英国征服。

summary.en: Forged by Shaka from the Zulu and neighbouring chiefdoms, the kingdom became the dominant power between the Drakensberg and the Indian Ocean. It defeated Britain at Isandlwana but was broken up after the war of 1879 and annexed to Natal in 1897.
summary.zh: 祖鲁王国由恰卡整合祖鲁及邻近酋邦而成，成为德拉肯斯山与印度洋之间的霸主。它在伊散德尔瓦纳击败英国，但1879年战后被肢解，1897年并入纳塔尔。

summary.en: Rebel theocratic state led by Hong Xiuquan, who claimed to be Christ's younger brother. Rising at Jintian in Guangxi, it held the lower Yangtze from Nanjing for over a decade before the Xiang Army took Tianjing in 1864.
summary.zh: 洪秀全以拜上帝会起事所建，1851年金田起义，1853年定都天京，据长江中下游十余年，1864年天京陷于湘军。

summary.en: After the 1857 rebellion the British Crown took over the East India Company’s territories, ruling directly or through some 560 princely states until independence and partition in 1947.
summary.zh: 1857年起义后英国王室接管东印度公司领地，通过直接统治或约560个土邦进行间接统治，直至1947年印巴独立与分治。

name.zh: 维多利亚女王（1876年起兼印度女皇）

summary.en: Proclaimed in 1861 under the House of Savoy, the kingdom completed unification with Venetia (1866) and Rome (1870). Victor Emmanuel III appointed Mussolini prime minister in 1922; after defeat in the Second World War, a referendum in 1946 replaced the monarchy with a republic.
summary.zh: 意大利王国于1861年在萨伏依王室治下宣告成立，1866年并入威尼托、1870年并入罗马，完成统一。1922年维克托·伊曼纽尔三世任命墨索里尼为首相；第二次世界大战战败后，1946年全民公决以共和制取代君主制。

sources.title: Christopher Duggan, The Force of Destiny: A History of Italy since 1796 (2007)
Britannica: Italy – History

summary.en: The modern imperial state created by the Meiji Restoration. It industrialised rapidly, won wars against China (1895) and Russia (1905), colonised Taiwan and Korea, and expanded across Asia until its defeat in 1945; the 1947 constitution replaced it.
summary.zh: 明治维新后建立的近代帝国。它迅速实现工业化，先后战胜清朝（1895年）与俄国（1905年），殖民台湾与朝鲜，并在亚洲各地扩张，1945年战败，1947年新宪法施行后终结。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Empire of Japan

The Cambridge History of Japan, Vol. 6: The Twentieth Century (1988)

polities.note: Hirohito reigned until 1989; his entry is truncated at the 1947 end of the Empire.

summary.en: A federal monarchy of German states under the King of Prussia as emperor, proclaimed at Versailles in January 1871. It became an industrial and scientific leader and built a colonial empire, but defeat in the First World War brought revolution and the abdication of Wilhelm II in November 1918.
summary.zh: 德意志帝国是以普鲁士国王为皇帝的德意志各邦联邦君主国，1871年1月在凡尔赛宣告成立。它成为工业和科学的领先者并建立了殖民帝国，但在第一次世界大战中战败，引发革命，威廉二世于1918年11月退位。

sources.title: Christopher Clark, Iron Kingdom (2006)
Britannica: Germany – History

polities.note: Wikidata dates the empire from 1 January 1871 (the new constitution); the imperial proclamation was on 18 January 1871.

summary.en: The state built by Samori Ture in the upper Niger basin, with a standing army, arms workshops and an Islamic administration. Fighting the French from 1882, it migrated eastward into present-day Côte d’Ivoire before Samori’s capture in 1898.
summary.zh: 瓦苏卢帝国是萨摩里·杜尔在尼日尔河上游建立的国家，拥有常备军、兵器作坊和伊斯兰行政体系。自1882年起与法国作战，后东迁至今科特迪瓦境内，1898年萨摩里被俘后灭亡。

sources.title: Wikipedia: Samorian State
Yves Person, Samori: une révolution dyula (1968–1975)
UNESCO General History of Africa, Vol. VII: Africa under Colonial Domination 1880–1935 (ed. A. Adu Boahen, 1985)

summary.en: Founded by Muhammad Ahmad, who proclaimed himself the Mahdi in 1881 and drove out Turco-Egyptian rule, the state was governed from Omdurman by his successor, the Khalifa ʿAbdallahi. Anglo-Egyptian forces destroyed its army at Omdurman in 1898.
summary.zh: 马赫迪国家由1881年自称马赫迪并驱逐土耳其—埃及统治的穆罕默德·艾哈迈德建立，其继承人哈里发阿卜杜拉希以恩图曼为中心治国。1898年英埃联军在恩图曼摧毁其军队。

name.zh: 穆罕默德·艾哈迈德（马赫迪）

summary.en: King Gojong proclaimed himself emperor in 1897 to assert Korea's independence from Qing China. Despite modernising reforms, the empire became a Japanese protectorate in 1905 and was annexed in 1910.
summary.zh: 1897年高宗称帝，宣示朝鲜脱离清朝而独立。尽管推行了光武改革，大韩帝国仍于1905年沦为日本保护国，1910年被日本吞并。

summary.en: Korea was governed as the colony of Chōsen by a Japanese Governor-General from 1910 until Japan's defeat in 1945. The period saw industrial development for Japanese ends, forced assimilation policies and wartime labour mobilisation.
summary.zh: 1910年至1945年日本战败期间，朝鲜作为日本殖民地“朝鲜”由朝鲜总督统治。这一时期出现了服务于日本的工业开发、强制同化政策与战时劳动力征用。

summary.en: Republic founded after the Xinhai Revolution. The Beiyang government in Beijing fragmented into warlord cliques until the Nationalist Northern Expedition (1926–28) made Nanjing the capital; after war with Japan and civil war, the government retreated to Taiwan in 1949.
summary.zh: 辛亥革命后建立。北洋政府时期军阀割据，1928年国民党北伐后定都南京；历经抗日战争与内战，1949年国民政府迁往台湾。

summary.en: The Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, formed by Bolshevik-ruled republics in 1922, was a one-party communist state that industrialised under Stalin at enormous human cost. It bore the heaviest losses in defeating Nazi Germany, rivalled the United States as a superpower in the Cold War and dissolved in 1991.
summary.zh: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟于1922年由布尔什维克统治的各共和国组成，是一党执政的共产主义国家，在斯大林治下以巨大的人的代价实现工业化。它在打败纳粹德国的战争中承受了最惨重的损失，冷战中与美国并列为超级大国，1991年解体。

summary.en: Republic proclaimed in 1923 from the Anatolian core of the Ottoman Empire after the War of Independence. Atatürk's reforms created a secular state with a Latin alphabet and new civil code; multi-party politics began in 1946, and Turkey joined NATO in 1952.
summary.zh: 独立战争后于1923年在奥斯曼帝国的安纳托利亚核心地区宣布成立的共和国。阿塔图尔克的改革建立了世俗国家，采用拉丁字母和新民法；1946年开始多党政治，1952年加入北约。

summary.en: Founded by army officer Reza Khan, proclaimed shah in 1925, who pursued centralisation, secularisation and modernisation. His son Mohammad Reza Shah, restored to full power by the 1953 coup, launched the White Revolution reforms but was overthrown in the revolution of 1978–79.
summary.zh: 军官礼萨汗于1925年称王建立，推行中央集权、世俗化和现代化。其子穆罕默德-礼萨·沙借1953年政变恢复全部权力，推行“白色革命”改革，但在1978—1979年革命中被推翻。

summary.en: Puppet state set up by Japan in Manchuria after the Mukden Incident, with the deposed Qing emperor Puyi as figurehead. It was dissolved after the Soviet invasion and Japan's surrender in August 1945.
summary.zh: 九一八事变后日本在东北扶植的傀儡政权，以溥仪为元首，都新京。1945年苏军进入东北、日本投降后瓦解。

summary.en: Kingdom proclaimed by Abdulaziz ibn Saud in 1932 after three decades of conquest across central Arabia and the Hejaz. As custodian of Mecca and Medina and, from 1938, a major oil producer, it became one of the most influential states of the Middle East; it remains an absolute monarchy.
summary.zh: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·伊本·沙特经三十年征战统一阿拉伯半岛中部和汉志后，于1932年宣布成立王国。作为麦加和麦地那的守护者以及1938年后的主要产油国，它成为中东最具影响力的国家之一，至今仍为君主专制国家。

summary.zh: 巴基斯坦于1947年作为南亚穆斯林的家园建立，分为东西两翼；1971年东翼独立为孟加拉国，此后国家在文官与军人统治之间交替。

summary.zh: 1949年10月1日毛泽东在北京宣告成立。毛泽东时代之后，1978年起改革开放，发展为世界主要经济体。

summary.en: Established by referendum after the 1979 revolution, the Islamic Republic combines elected institutions with clerical guardianship under a Supreme Leader. It fought the 1980–1988 war with Iraq and has since been shaped by regional rivalries, nuclear disputes and international sanctions.
summary.zh: 1979年革命后经公民投票建立，伊斯兰共和国将民选机构与最高领袖领导下的教法学家监护制度相结合。它经历了1980—1988年两伊战争，此后受到地区对抗、核问题争端和国际制裁的深刻影响。
